zum Controller:
Ich hab es mit Raspi probiert - funktioniert.
An ESP8622 oder ESP32 und Arduino aber nicht - ich verstehe es leider (noch) nicht, die I2C funktioniert - aber nicht mit diesen TFT. Ich vermute, dass die Define's der gängigen Bibliotheken einfach nicht auf die internen Ports passen - leider gibt das Datenblatt keine Belegung der Platine her.
Schade, gerade die Minibauweise der ESP wären für diesen Micro-Anzeiger ideal.
(Raspberry Zero noch nicht probiert, das wäre so da kleinste in der Richtung)

zum Produkt selbst:
Die Bildschirme sind zwar winzig und bei 128x64 sind max. 16 Text-Zeichen auf 8 Zeilen möglich - reicht aber für die meisten Projekte. Pixel einzeln ansteuerbar macht auch Grafiken möglich.
Anzeige ist scharf und sauber ablesbar.
Im Größenvergleich zu den "freigebenen" Arduino und Raspi aber zu klein.

3/5 - funktioniert gemäß der Beschreibung. Nicht mehr, aber auch nicht weniger.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Beinärmel TCA, zu 80 % Nylon, made in China – zu kleine Größe M
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Meinerseits sind die Beinlinge als Ersatz für klassische lange Unterhosem im Winter gedacht, wofür sie grundsätzlich geeignet sind. Der Stil im sportlichen, modernen Design ist wesentlich ansprechender als der von typischer Unterwäsche. Dazu sind sie leicht und vor allem dünn, jedoch nicht unmerklich auf der Haut. Ich empfinde sie nicht als sonderlich angenehm zu tragen, aber ihren Zweck, zu wärmen, erfüllen sie.
Das An- und Ausziehen funktioniert problemlos, ein einfaches Über- und Abstreifen. Beim Auspacken umgibt sie der bekannte Synthetikgeruch im tolerierbaren Rahmen.
Das Hauptproblem mit dem Produkt liegt bei mir in der bestellten Größe. Gewöhnlich trage ich Herrengröße XL, die Größe M bei diesem Produkt passt im unteren Bereich, jedoch ist sie für mich im oberen Bereich zu straff. Das Gummi oben drückt, was beim Sport definitiv hinderlich ist. Wer ausgeprägte Oberschenkel hat, sollte eher eine Nummer größer Wählen.

Weil ich die Beinärmel auch bei längerem Tragen nicht wirklich angenehm empfinde und sie in meinem Fall oben zu eng anliegen, gebe ich nur drei Punkte.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: This is certainly a heavy duty D ring. I bought 2 sets for the front and rear bumpers of my Jeep Wrangler Unlimited JK. The first set are a perfect fit because the hole drilled through the pin for the R clip is in direct alignment with the thumb piece when tightened. It looks clean. On the second set, the hole drilled through one of the pins is not in direct alignment with the thumb piece. So upon tightening it, the R clip and the thumb piece are offset and doesn't look clean. The hole alignment through the pin might be a QA/QC issue for Rhino to address. Upon contacting them about this issue online, they were quick to send me a replacement pin. Kudos to Rhino for great customer service.

Les T-Shirts TCA Superlight sont particulièrement appréciés pour leur confort et leur légèreté. Voici un aperçu de leurs principales caractéristiques et avis :

Points Positifs :

Confort et Légèreté :

Rapidité de Séchage :

Points Négatifs :

Fragilité du Tissu :

Prix :
Bien que les T-shirts offrent un bon rapport qualité-prix pour leur fonctionnalité, certains trouvent le prix légèrement élevé comparé à d'autres options sur le marché.

Conclusion :

Les T-Shirts TCA Superlight sont une excellente option pour ceux qui cherchent des vêtements de sport à la fois légers et performants. Leur capacité à évacuer l'humidité et leur confort en font des choix idéaux pour les séances d'entraînement par temps chaud. Malgré un prix un peu élevé et une certaine fragilité du tissu, ils restent un excellent choix pour les sportifs et les personnes actives.

En conclusion :

This looked like good 12ga wire, and exactly what I needed for a Ham Radio End Fed Longwire antenna. The roll is exactly 100 feet, by splitting into the two separate wires I ended up with 200 ft of 12ga wire. I needed 134ft+- for the antenna. I took the 100ft length and added the extra 34ft by soldering the ends, and sealing with heatshrink tubing. I also bought The 1:64 Balun (Actually it's a UnUn), attached it as shown in the picture, and hoisted it up a 18ft clothesline pole with a nylon rope, and ran the wire over to a tree on the other side of the yard, looped it through a insulator attached to a eyebolt, and ran it across to the other side of the yard to another tree. The wire was too short to reach the tree, so a piece of nylon rope finished the run to the eyehook screwed into the tree. I cut the antenna wire for the low end of 80 meters, and it has a less than 2 SWR upto 3.845 mhz and less than 2 SWR for 7, 14, 21, 28, 29, & 50 mhz for 6 meters. Any spots a little off, my Icom 7300 has a built in tuner that does the job. First contact on 40 meters from Lavel Quebec (I'm near Barrie On) was a solid 5/9. So, if your looking for a decent wire that will work as an antenna, this may work for you as well.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Recensione tecnica: AZDelivery Adattatore per Breadboard ESP-01S
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
L'Adattatore per Breadboard ESP-01S di AZDelivery è un piccolo dispositivo che facilita l'utilizzo del modulo WiFi ESP8266-01S su una breadboard. Permette di collegare il modulo ai pin della breadboard senza bisogno di saldature, semplificando notevolmente la prototipazione di progetti elettronici basati su ESP8266.

Caratteristiche:

Compatibilità: Progettato specificamente per il modulo ESP8266-01S.
Facilità d'uso: Consente di collegare il modulo ESP8266-01S a una breadboard senza bisogno di saldature.
Prototipazione rapida: Perfetto per la prototipazione rapida di progetti elettronici basati su ESP8266.
Connessioni stabili: Fornisce connessioni stabili e affidabili tra il modulo e la breadboard.
Dimensioni compatte: Design compatto che occupa poco spazio sulla breadboard.
Materiale: Realizzato in materiale plastico resistente.
Vantaggi:

Semplifica il processo di prototipazione: Elimina la necessità di saldatura, rendendolo ideale per principianti e hobbisti.
Risparmia tempo: Permette di assemblare circuiti elettronici più velocemente.
Riduce gli errori: Eliminando la saldatura, si riducono le possibilità di errori di connessione.
Aumenta la flessibilità: Facilita la modifica e la sperimentazione di diversi circuiti.
Prezzo accessibile: Un'opzione conveniente per chi si avvicina all'elettronica con ESP8266.
Svantaggi:

Durata limitata: Le connessioni ad incastro potrebbero non essere resistenti come le saldature a lungo termine.
Non adatto a progetti permanenti: Non è consigliabile per progetti elettronici destinati a un uso prolungato o in ambienti gravosi.
Compatibilità limitata: Funziona solo con il modulo ESP8266-01S.
In generale, l'Adattatore per Breadboard ESP-01S di AZDelivery è un'ottima scelta per chi desidera semplificare la prototipazione di progetti elettronici basati su ESP8266. È facile da usare, conveniente e consente di risparmiare tempo e ridurre gli errori. Tuttavia, è importante tenere conto dei suoi limiti in termini di durata e compatibilità.

Consiglio: Se si necessita di una soluzione più permanente o per progetti più complessi, si consiglia di saldare direttamente il modulo ESP8266-01S sulla breadboard o di utilizzare un PCB dedicato.

I ordered 3 sets of these hinges for exterior doors, and they appear to be very high quality. The steel is a bit thicker than the usual cheap ones that come on pre-hung doors, and the corners have a smaller radius. As such, I did a little trimming the hinge recesses to make sure they would fit and have sufficient room without the door binding. I feel these hinges provide will also add a little more security due to being stronger. I purposely selected this hinge hole pattern since many of the previous hinge holes were too close to the inside edge to grasp well and others had been stripped using long screws. Two of the holes on each hinge wing align with the previous offset holes in the old hinges, which was address with some glue and 1/4" dowel rods to make new mounding holes. So, color me impressed, at the price of $13 for a set of three stainless steel hinges, I will be looking at these to replace all my interior door hinges also when needed.

Die Verarbeitung des Sets ist erstklassig. Das Edelstahlmaterial ist robust, leicht zu reinigen und sieht in meiner Küche elegant aus. Die Schalen sind stabil und machen das Handling von Zutaten und Paniermehl zu einem Kinderspiel. Dank der tiefen Form bleibt alles an Ort und Stelle, ohne zu kleckern.

Besonders praktisch finde ich, dass die Schalen stapelbar sind, was die Aufbewahrung erleichtert. Dieses Set hat meinen Kochalltag deutlich erleichtert und ist eine unverzichtbare Ergänzung für jede Küche.

Insgesamt bin ich sehr zufrieden mit dem Navaris Panier-Set. Es kombiniert Funktionalität, Qualität und eine durchdachte Gestaltung. Klare Kaufempfehlung für alle, die Wert auf eine professionelle Panierstraße legen!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: does not stand behind their warranty
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I am utterly disappointed and infuriated with this company and their so-called "lifetime warranty" because it's a lie.

I purchased a pair of arm sleeves, attracted by their bold promise of a lifetime warranty, although it seems that they are not advertising it anymore, but it doesn't matter because basic contract law dictates that if I bought the item under the auspices of a lifetime warranty, then they cannot materially change the terms unilaterally. Nevertheless, this would turn out to be a sucker's deal.

Recently, one of the sleeves started unraveling at the seams, clearly a manufacturing defect. No big deal, right? I thought the lifetime warranty would have my back.

Wrong.

When I reached out to their customer service, hoping to get a replacement as per their advertised warranty, I was met with stonewalling and excuses. First, they claimed that due to the age of my purchase, I would have to contact Amazon in order to get refund (even though I never requested one). When I suggested that I just want a replacement under the lifetime warranty, they flatly refused and said that it could not be done, with no explanation.

This company has not only failed to honor their warranty, but has also demonstrated a complete lack of integrity and customer care. Their product quality is abysmal; the arm sleeves fell apart after minimal use, clearly unable to withstand even the slightest stress.

Do not be fooled by their flashy website or their empty promises of a warranty. This company is nothing, but a dishonest seller peddling subpar products with a side of deceptive marketing. Save yourself the frustration and money; look elsewhere. This company does not deserve your hard-earned money, and they certainly don't deserve anyone's trust.

Die ergonomisch geformten Griffe bieten einen sicheren und komfortablen Halt, was die Handhabung erleichtert und das Risiko von Unfällen minimiert. Zudem verfügt die Krallenschere über eine Sicherheitssperre, die verhindert, dass sie unbeabsichtigt geöffnet wird, wenn sie nicht in Gebrauch ist.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I love this tool, it's one of my favorites for electrical stuff. It does this ratchet action that works quite well. The only drawback is the dies are made out of metal, so they can sometimes marr the plastic on cheaper connectors. If you use Wirefy brand connectors, you won't have that problem- but if you try to buy some $10-dollar-special connectors, they will likely be damaged by this tool. I think it couldn't hurt to add some sort of hard rubber or something on the die to avoid the tool messing up the plastic jacket on connectors.

This tool also goes on reasonable sales often, so keep an eye out for that too maybe.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Recensione Tecnica: Modulo Sensore di Rilevamento Linea KY-033 TCRT5000 (5 pezzi)
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Il modulo sensore di rilevamento linea KY-033 TCRT5000 è un componente elettronico versatile ed economico che permette di rilevare la presenza o l'assenza di una linea scura su una superficie chiara.

Caratteristiche:

Sensore TCRT5000: Il sensore è basato sul chip TCRT5000, che include un LED infrarosso e un fototransistor. Il LED emette luce infrarossa che viene riflessa dalla superficie. La quantità di luce riflessa che raggiunge il fototransistor dipende dalla presenza o meno della linea scura.
Regolazione della sensibilità: Il modulo dispone di un potenziometro per regolare la sensibilità del sensore. Questo permette di impostare la soglia di luce riflessa che determina l'attivazione del segnale di output.
Uscita digitale: Il modulo fornisce un segnale di output digitale (alto o basso) che indica la presenza o l'assenza della linea scura.
Facilità d'uso: Il modulo è facile da utilizzare, con soli tre pin per l'alimentazione, la terra e il segnale di output.
Compatto: Il modulo è compatto e leggero, con dimensioni di 42 x 10,5 mm, che lo rendono ideale per progetti con spazio limitato.
Basso consumo energetico: Il modulo consuma una bassa corrente, rendendolo ideale per applicazioni a batteria.
Applicazioni:

Robot segui-linea: Il modulo è comunemente usato nei robot segui-linea per seguire una linea nera su una superficie bianca.
Rilevamento di ostacoli: Il modulo può essere utilizzato per rilevare la presenza di ostacoli su un nastro trasportatore o su una linea di produzione.
Controllo di porte automatiche: Il modulo può essere utilizzato per attivare l'apertura di una porta automatica quando una persona si avvicina.
Progetti di domotica: Il modulo può essere utilizzato in svariati progetti di domotica, come l'accensione o lo spegnimento di luci al passaggio di un oggetto.
Vantaggi:

Basso costo
Facile da usare
Compatto e leggero
Basso consumo energetico
Versatile
Svantaggi:

Distanza di rilevamento limitata (circa 1-2 cm)
Sensibilità alla luce ambientale
Non adatto per superfici irregolari o riflettenti
In generale, il modulo sensore di rilevamento linea KY-033 TCRT5000 è un'ottima scelta per una varietà di applicazioni di rilevamento di linea. È un componente economico, versatile e facile da usare che offre un buon rapporto qualità-prezzo.

Consigliato a:

Hobbyisti ed appassionati di elettronica
Studenti e maker
Sviluppatori di robot e sistemi di automazione
Professionisti che lavorano con la sensoristica
Non consigliato a:

Applicazioni che richiedono una lunga distanza di rilevamento
Applicazioni in ambienti con luce ambientale intensa
Superfici irregolari o riflettenti
Conclusione:

Se siete alla ricerca di un sensore di linea economico, affidabile e facile da usare, il modulo KY-033 TCRT5000 è un'opzione da tenere in seria considerazione. Offre una combinazione unica di caratteristiche che lo rende adatto a una vasta gamma di progetti.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Perfekter Behälter für Tierfutter und mehr
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Wir haben den Belle Vous Großen Kunststoff Lebensmittelbehälter mit 5L Fassungsvermögen erworben, um das Pellet-Mix-Futter für unsere Kaninchen zu lagern, und sind sehr zufrieden damit.

Der Behälter ist äußerst praktisch und hält etwa 3 Kilo Futter. Besonders beeindruckt hat uns die luftdichte Versiegelung des Deckels, die dafür sorgt, dass das Futter zuverlässig vor Feuchtigkeit geschützt bleibt und der Geruch in der Box eingeschlossen wird.

Positive Punkte:

Großes Fassungsvermögen: Ideal für die Lagerung größerer Mengen, ob Tierfutter, Getreide oder Reis.
Luftdichter Deckel: Schützt den Inhalt vor Feuchtigkeit und erhält die Frische.
Inklusive Messbecher: Erleichtert das Portionieren.
Negative Punkte:

Der Kunststoff könnte etwas robuster sein, besonders wenn der Behälter oft bewegt wird.
Insgesamt ist dieser Behälter eine hervorragende Wahl für alle, die eine zuverlässige und geruchsneutrale Lagerlösung suchen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Perfekter Schutz und stilvolle Aufwertung für Ihre Fernbedienung!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich bin begeistert von der kwmobile Hülle für meine Fernbedienung, die kompatibel mit Toshiba und Insignia NS-RCFNA-21, CT-RC1US-21, CT95018 / Fire TV ist. Diese Hülle hat meine Erwartungen in jeder Hinsicht übertroffen und ich freue mich, eine 5-Sterne-Bewertung zu schreiben!

#### Design und Material
Die Hülle besteht aus hochwertigem Silikon, das sich angenehm weich und griffig anfühlt. Die leuchtend rote Farbe ist nicht nur ein echter Hingucker, sondern macht die Fernbedienung auch leichter auffindbar. Das Material ist robust und flexibel, sodass es die Fernbedienung perfekt umschließt und vor Stößen, Kratzern und alltäglichem Verschleiß schützt.

#### Passgenauigkeit
Die Passform der Hülle ist absolut perfekt. Sie sitzt wie eine zweite Haut auf der Fernbedienung und lässt alle Tasten und Anschlüsse frei zugänglich. Das präzise Design ermöglicht eine nahtlose Nutzung der Fernbedienung, ohne dass man die Hülle entfernen muss. Alle Tasten lassen sich problemlos bedienen, und das Wechseln der Batterien ist kinderleicht.

#### Schutz und Funktionalität
Diese Hülle bietet hervorragenden Schutz vor Beschädigungen und Schmutz. Besonders beeindruckt hat mich, dass sie auch einen gewissen Stoßschutz bietet, was besonders in einem Haushalt mit Kindern oder Haustieren von Vorteil ist. Die strukturierte Oberfläche verhindert, dass die Fernbedienung aus der Hand rutscht, was die Handhabung insgesamt sicherer macht.

#### Einfache Reinigung
Ein weiterer Pluspunkt ist die einfache Reinigung der Hülle. Das Silikonmaterial lässt sich leicht abwischen und bleibt somit stets in einem sauberen Zustand. Staub und Schmutz lassen sich mühelos entfernen, was die Langlebigkeit der Hülle zusätzlich erhöht.

#### Fazit
Die kwmobile Hülle für Fernbedienungen kompatibel mit Toshiba und Insignia NS-RCFNA-21, CT-RC1US-21, CT95018 / Fire TV ist ein Muss für jeden, der seine Fernbedienung optimal schützen und gleichzeitig optisch aufwerten möchte. Die Kombination aus hervorragender Passform, Schutz und stilvollem Design hat mich vollkommen überzeugt. Ich kann dieses Produkt uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen und vergebe daher fünf Sterne!

Vielen Dank, kwmobile, für dieses großartige Produkt!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Schutz vor UV-Strahlen, verrutsch nicht und passend auch für lange Arme
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich habe mir dies Ärmel zugelegt, weil ich meine Arme vor UV-Strahlung beim Radfahren und Wandern schützen will. Bei meinen Südostasien-Reisen habe ich oft gesehen, dass lokale Guides diese Ärmel tragen, um sich vor der Sonne zu schützen, während die Touristen (und ich selbst auch) sich eher ungeschützt der brütenden Sonne aussetzen.

Ich bin 1,92 m groß und habe sehr lange und dünne Arme und hatte daher Zweifel, ob die Ärmel passen würden. Größe L bedeckt meine ganzen Arme von Mitte des T-Shirt-Ärmels bis knapp zum Handgelenk. Super! Die Ärmel halten gut dank der Silikon-Beschichtung am oberen Ende.

Ich finde die diversen Anwendungsmöglichkeiten super, da sie ermöglichen, dass man sich vor Kälte und vor UV-Strahlen schützen kann. Gerade bei Wanderungen, die am frühen Morgen starten, wärmen sie und man kann sie dann abnehmen und platzsparend verpacken.

Ob der UV-Schutz hält was er verspricht, ist schwer zu sagen. Da muss man wohl Vertrauen in den Hersteller haben.

Ces t-shirts, d’une qualité irréprochable, sont comme une seconde peau. Légers et ajustés, ils épousent parfaitement les contours du corps. Leur finition est d’une précision remarquable, sans le moindre fil mal cousu. Les couleurs, bien que légèrement ternes, sont plaisantes et ajoutent à l’ensemble une satisfaction indéniable.
Ils sont confectionnés dans un tissu de polyester, garantissant une excellente dissipation de l’humidité grâce au système Quickdry. Ce dernier assure une absorption optimale de la transpiration. Le tissu, d’une douceur inouïe, est extensible pour s’adapter à tous les besoins. La coupe est très ajustée, donc pour ceux qui préfèrent une tenue plus ample, il est conseillé de choisir une taille au-dessus.
Ces t-shirts résistent sans problème à un lavage, qu’il soit à l’eau froide ou chaude. Comme vous avez pu le constater dans la vidéo, les coutures sont plates, évitant ainsi toute irritation de la peau. Il est toutefois recommandé de les laver avant la première utilisation pour éliminer au maximum les résidus chimiques de la fabrication.
Le logo, discret, ne gêne en rien, ce qui est appréciable pour ceux qui ne souhaitent pas se transformer en homme-sandwich.
Cependant, comme c’est souvent le cas avec le polyester, ce tissu est fragile. Donc, si vous vous aventurez dans les bois, faites attention de ne pas l’accrocher. C’est là le seul inconvénient de ce type de tissu.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Comodidad y funcionalidad para la práctica del deporte
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Los shorts deportivos TCA Tech para niños están diseñados para ofrecer comodidad y rendimiento en actividades físicas. Construidos con materiales ligeros y transpirables, estos pantalones cortos son ideales para los jóvenes atletas que necesitan movilidad y seguridad mientras practican deportes como el fútbol.

Aspectos positivos
⚽ Tela ligera y transpirable: Estos shorts están fabricados con una tela ligera y transpirable, lo que los hace perfectos para actividades físicas intensas. La tela permite una excelente ventilación, manteniendo a los niños frescos y cómodos durante sus entrenamientos y partidos de fútbol.
🔒 Bolsillos con cremallera: Equipados con dos bolsillos con cremallera fusionados, estos pantalones cortos proporcionan una máxima seguridad para los objetos de valor. Los bolsillos aseguran que los artículos se mantengan en su lugar sin importar la actividad, evitando pérdidas y ofreciendo tranquilidad tanto a los niños como a los padres.
💧 Tecnología TCA D.R.Y.: La tecnología TCA D.R.Y. está diseñada para absorber el sudor de la piel y permitir que se evapore rápidamente en la superficie del tejido. Esto mantiene los shorts secos, ligeros y cómodos en todo momento, incluso durante sesiones de ejercicio intenso.
👖 Recomendación de talla: Dado que estos pantalones cortos tienen un corte ajustado, se recomienda pedir una talla más grande para asegurar un ajuste cómodo. Para obtener información detallada sobre tallas, se puede consultar la guía de tallas proporcionada en la galería de imágenes del producto.

Aspectos para tener en cuenta
📏 Corte ajustado: El corte ajustado puede no ser del agrado de todos los niños, especialmente aquellos que prefieren ropa más holgada. Es crucial seguir la recomendación de pedir una talla más grande para evitar incomodidades.
🧼 Mantenimiento y cuidado: Como con cualquier prenda deportiva, es importante seguir las instrucciones de cuidado para mantener la funcionalidad de la tecnología TCA D.R.Y. y la durabilidad de los bolsillos con cremallera. El lavado inadecuado puede afectar la longevidad de estas características.

En definitiva, los shorts deportivos TCA Tech para niños son una excelente opción para jóvenes atletas que buscan comodidad y funcionalidad en sus actividades deportivas. Con su tela ligera y transpirable, bolsillos seguros con cremallera y tecnología avanzada de absorción de sudor, estos pantalones cortos ofrecen un rendimiento superior en cualquier actividad física. Asegúrate de seguir la recomendación de tallas para garantizar un ajuste cómodo y disfrutar de todos los beneficios que estos shorts tienen para ofrecer.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: ben fatto ma la soluzione non risulta molto gradita al destinatario
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Premetto che era da tempo che volevo provare a usare un tappetino refrigerante per animali domestici. Ho un cane di taglia grande (35 kg, simil labrador) e d'estate in città si raggiungono temperature molto alte. Questo inverno abbiamo commesso l'errore di acquistare diverse cucce che non hanno un lato estivo ma sono ricoperte di pile (mi segue in ufficio e varie abitazioni) e il cane ci soffre. Fatta questa doverosa premessa, cercavo qualcosa da sovrapporre alla cuccia per mantenere più fresco il mio animale domestico.
In effetti non posso dire che adori questo tappetino rinfrescante, ci sale solo se non ha alternative. Ho letto che a volte serve molto tempo perchè ne capiscano e apprezzino l'effettiva utilità quindi spero che in futuro vada meglio (per ora ho dovuto coprirlo con un lenzuolo e temo che abbia perso parte della sua funzione).
Non mi è ben chiaro secondo quale meccanismo dovrebbe "attivarsi" con la pressione del peso corporeo tuttavia l'ho testato di persona e sicuramente la superficie è più fresca di altri materiali, quindi bene. Il materassino rinfrescante risulta anche sufficientemente spesso e morbido per essere usato da solo in quegli animali che ne sono predisposti (non la mia che ha bisogno di un materasso ortopedico).
Sicuramente ho apprezzato il fatto che il materiale sia robusto, facile da pulire con una spugna, resistente anche se il mio cane tende a scavare, e comodo da piegare e riporre.
Il prezzo è nella media di questi prodotti di fascia alta (ci sono opzioni simili decisamente più economiche). Il tappetino è realizzato in modo molto curato, rifinito a contrasto sui bordi, con logo stampato e in generale l'impressione è quella di una buona fattura. Non è sicuramente un primo prezzo. Tuttavia, visto che molti animali alla fine non gradiscono la soluzione, valuterei le politiche di reso prima dell'acquisto nel caso sia la vostra prima volta.
Le misure sono correttamente riportate in descrizione. Per il mio cane risultano un po' troppo piccole se dovesse sdraiarsi solo sul materassino in gel ma per l'uso che ne faccio (ovvero sopra una cuccia più grande) vanno bene. In generale secondo me la versione 60x90 è più adatta a una taglia media.
Il colore, un bel blu con inserti azzurri a contrasto, è fedele a quello in foto.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Scomodo, adatto solo per crocchette piccole, realizzato in plastica senza marcatura "BPA-free"
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Contenitore di dimensioni (AxLxP) 26x18x40cm circa, completo di base con "dosatore" e cassetto/ciotola estraibile, realizzato in materiale plastico leggero e inodore, prodotto in Cina.
Dico subito che questo prodotto mi ha deluso molto: può essere in qualche modo utilizzabile (questo sostanzialmente è l'unico aspetto positivo che ho notato), ma solo nel caso in cui si hanno zero pretese in termini di qualità e comodità.
Riassumo i dettagli che non mi hanno assolutamente convinto:
• sul materiale plastico non è presente alcuna marcatura (ad esempio "BPA-free") o indicazione dell'idoneità al contatto con alimenti
• l'apertura in cui cadono le crocchette è di circa 10x3cm: può sembrare grande ma all'atto pratico è adatta solo per le crocchette piccole, mentre quelle grandi semplicemente si incastrano ostruendo completamente il passaggio, quindi va bene esclusivamente per il cibo dei gatti o dei cani di taglia piccola
• l'ermeticità del contenitore nel suo complesso è mediocre: accettabile sul coperchio superiore, molto dubbia nella parte inferiore con l'apertura - non la migliore soluzione per conservare a lungo una gran quantità di cibo per animali
• il meccanismo "dosatore" è un disastro: fatto in plastica leggera (è quasi certo che non durerà a lungo), con una quantità diversa di crocchette erogate ad ogni pressione e cassetto/ciotola che non permette di vedere il contenuto fino a quando non viene estratto - dosare risulta impossibile e il contenitore perde gran parte della sua utilità, diventando anzi solo un ingombro e perdita di tempo
• il buco nella parte inferiore del contenitore trasparente non si può chiudere, la logica suggerirebbe che il contenitore delle crocchette possa essere staccato dalla sua base per essere trasportato e riempito (senza perdite dal buco, ovviamente), ma in questo caso non è così
In conclusione, a mio parere si tratta di un oggetto progettato male, scomodo, e di bassa qualità per quanto riguarda i materiali: non lo consiglio.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Would probably slow down/deter most thieves
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: The ball lock itself looks solid enough that you would have to make quite a bit of noise to cut it/break it. Nothing is thieves proof, but that one would slow them down a little or cause enough commotion to discourage them from stealing your trailer. *Note that the lock can easily be lock picked as it is a rather simple lock*. The little 1/4” coupler lock is kind of a joke. It’s not really a lock and can easily be open with a flat head screwdriver. A good padlock would do a better job as it is harder/louder to cut or open. Overall, if you install a GPS tracker sticker on the trailer and a camera in an obvious location on your lot, coupled with the ball hitch lock, it would probably deter most thieves. The goal is not to stop them from stealing it, since that hardly can be done, but to discourage them from taking your trailer rather than the next door one.

Der Navaris Automatische Futterautomat hat sich als wahrer Lebensretter in meinem chaotischen Alltag mit meiner Katze erwiesen!

**Praktisch und zuverlässig:** Die Programmierung von bis zu vier Mahlzeiten pro Tag ist kinderleicht und der Timer funktioniert einwandfrei. Egal ob ich länger arbeiten muss oder anderweitig beschäftigt bin, meine Samtpfote wird pünktlich mit 4 Portionen über den Tag verteilt versorgt.

**Perfekte Portionsgröße:** Der 1,6 Liter Behälter fasst genug Futter für mehrere Tage und die Portionskontrolle verhindert, dass meine verfressene Mieze sich überfrisst.

**Angenehme Geräuschkulisse:** Die akustische Benachrichtigung ist ein nettes Extra, das meine Katze zuverlässig zum Futternapf lockt. Das Gerät selbst ist angenehm leise und stört mich nicht im Alltag.

**Leicht zu reinigen:** Sowohl der Futterbehälter als auch der Napf lassen sich einfach herausnehmen und reinigen – ein großes Plus für die Hygiene.

**Fazit:** Der Navaris Futterautomat ist eine absolute Empfehlung für alle Katzenbesitzer, die ihrem Liebling eine zuverlässige und bequeme Fütterung mit 4 Portionen über den Tag verteilt ermöglichen möchten. Ein tolles Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis und eine echte Erleichterung im Alltag!

Ho ordinato questi pantaloncini per mio figlio di 12 anni, un vero appassionato di basket.

Appena arrivati, hanno fatto subito un'ottima impressione. Il tessuto è leggero e morbido al tatto, perfetto per l'estate e per correre senza sentirsi appesantiti. La taglia scelta (12-14 anni) si è rivelata azzeccata, né troppo larga né troppo stretta, e il cordoncino in vita permette di regolarli facilmente per una vestibilità perfetta. Il tessuto, inoltre, è resistente a frequenti lavaggi.

A mio figlio piace la libertà di movimento che questi pantaloncini offrono. Sono davvero comodi e non limitano i movimenti. Le tasche con cerniera sono abbastanza capienti per contenere piccoli oggetti come chiavi o monetine, e la chiusura lampo evita che si perdano.

Dopo diverse settimane di utilizzo, posso dire che questi pantaloncini sono resistenti. Le cuciture sono ben fatte.

Pro:
• Leggerezza e traspirabilità
• Vestibilità comoda e libertà di movimento
• Tasche con cerniera
• Tessuto resistente ai lavaggi

Contro:
• Per ora non ho trovato difetti

I pantaloncini sono un buon prodotto, soprattutto considerando il prezzo. Sono comodi, pratici e resistenti, ideali per fare attività sportive.

The size is good and the straps are wide and hold the ice pack securely. The ice pack is extremely cold at first - painfully so after about 5 min. This can be mitigated by layering a towel between the ice pack and clothing or by leaving the ice pack at room temp for about 15 min before using. What is greatly disappointing is the leak at the seam. There is no visible hole or puncture in the fabric, yet somehow the gel is seeping out. Perhaps there is an interior lining that is compromised. Therefore I am not sure that I can effectively patch it. I did not notice this defect until after the return window closed. I have gel packs from Nexcare - they are at least 15 years old and have never leaked - but they are the smaller rectangular size (4x 12 or so) , and I was looking for something larger. CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Deflation kit does NOT release air at the set PSI
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I gave 2 stars because the tire pressure gauage was half decent. However, the deflation kit doesn't work at all. The spring loaded system with internal O ring just doesn't let out air anywhere close to where you set it. I followed instructions to the T.

The tolerances on the adjustment nut and threads are super wobbly.

The internal spring and O ring system is inconsistent. Where you tighten the nut, compressing spring, vs when the tire pressure pushes the spring out to release air beyond the O ring are different. I tried finessing it for 30 mins to no prevail.

Even when I got close, the air doesn't stop. Immediately. Because it's spring loaded, the air continues to slowly leak. And when it gets close to the preset, air release becomes Very slow.

Might just be bad design. Lot of other vendors with same type of product. Haven't tried any other brand versiona but I not going to.

I'm returning product and will try out the kit where the valve is actually removed. I just wasn't sure I wanted to be removing the valve off and on.

I recently added the Rhino USA Trailer Hitch Pin to my towing setup, and it's been a game-changer for my peace of mind. As someone who loves to tackle DIY projects, I appreciate products that are both functional and easy to use, and this hitch pin fits the bill perfectly.

First off, the installation was simple and quick. The locking mechanism is solid, and I love the added security it provides. Knowing that my trailer is safely secured is a big relief, especially when towing heavy loads like my boat.

One of the standout features is the weatherproof design. The pin's protection against dust, mud, and gunk is a significant plus, especially since I often travel through rough terrains. This durability means I don't have to worry about the elements affecting its performance.

However, I did notice that the key insertion can be a bit tricky at times, especially if there’s dirt buildup. A quick clean usually solves this, but it’s something to be aware of if you're frequently in muddy environments.

The Rhino USA Trailer Hitch Pin has exceeded my expectations in terms of security and build quality. It's a reliable addition to my towing gear, ensuring my trailer stays firmly attached during all my travels.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: An OK Water Bottle with Opportunities
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Bought this bottle in March 2024 to increase my water intake. I used the infusion bar a few times and it works fine, but I ultimately chose to use it as a straight water bottle. After 3 months of daily use, I am pleased that the water bottle has held up to regular use and the dishwasher without cracks or discoloration. However, the lid has issues. Firstly, the mouth of the lid has sharp edges from the casting, which could cut one's lips while drinking. (Time to break out the modeling files to smooth them down, but I shouldn't have to do this.) Secondly, the lid refuses to close after a few months, which isn't a big deal for me since I use it at home at my desk, but may be a deal-breaker for some who travel. My last (minor) gripe is that, when flipped open, the lid ends up in a position that makes it slightly awkward for drinking while holding the bottle using the hand grips...and it ends up there no matter how I screw it on. The good news is I am drinking more water, but I wish this bottle were a little better.

Hiermit wird Abhilfe geschaffen. Der Messerblock ist schwer genug, damit er beim Handhaben nicht permanent droht, umzufallen. Der Drehmechanismus ist gleichermaßen leichtgängig wie stabil, so dass man immer optimalen Zugriff auf das benötigte Messer hat. Ohne Zweifel eine der BESTEN Anschaffungen für meine Küche in den letzten Jahren.

I have a lot of kit in oils, inks, acrylics and so on, and I have both expensive and cheap branded gear, from Michael Harding and Old Holland to ProArte, Hobbycraft and Staples. So I know I've taken a gamble with 5 pens at this low price.
These pens started off poor and got worse.
As you go down to the finer tips the ink flow rate reduces, and this was the case when they were first used. This means your lines are more grey than black with the finer tips, and lines are not solid nor consistent.
I've used them only a few times to make early drawings for pen and ink pieces, and after little while the finer tips have simply dried out. I'm uncertain why, and I note I don't leave caps off or leave them in the sunlight... and I've not used them anywhere near enough for it to be that they've run out of ink.
My guess is that the tips are a poor quality or design, in part proven by the low flow rate, but also by their feel... they have next to no springiness and you feel they might break and crack under just a little pressure... and this makes me question their porosity, which would explain the early low flow rate (and them then prematurely drying out and failing).
If they had lasted longer perhaps the price might be justified. After all a grey ink pen is still usable. When they stop working this quickly I can only say, don't waste your money... they're not worth it and they aren't expensive enough to bother sending back. God I really hate Amazon sometimes.

It also shows all sticks in pictures with holes in the middle, and not all of them have it. Be mindful of that. It took us 2 hours just to decipher the instructions.

F (1x) - tent fabric WITHOUT the sticks (although it shows kinda with them)

H (x1) - small stick "dressed up" with fabric

I (1x) - small stick "naked"

J (3x) - big stick "dressed up" with fabric

K (x2) - big stick naked

Use two of the small naked sticks for F (the tent fabric).

Design: Die Radhose sieht sportlich und modern aus.

Fazit:

Die Radhose bietet hohen Komfort, eine ausgezeichnete Passform und ist atmungsaktiv. Sie ist ideal für Radsportler, die auf lange Fahrten gehen. Lediglich kleine Verbesserungen könnten sie perfekt machen. Insgesamt eine empfehlenswerte Wahl für jeden Radfahrer.

Si può utilizzare anche diluendo leggermente con acqua, tra una mano e la successiva meglio aspettare 12 ore. Per le parti più piccole ho utilizzato un pennello. La tinta è inodore quindi ho potuto lavorare in sala con le finestre aperte. Dopo 2 ore è fuori polvere. Non macchia né il pavimento né gli abiti o le mani. Io comunque ho utilizzato dei teli e dei guanti. Per proteggere i mobili ho utilizzato la finitura trasparente della medesima marca. In alternativa si può usare la cera. Il risultato finale è andato oltre ogni aspettativa.

Posteriormente è presente una piccola stanza con chiusura a zip, mentre sui fianchi possiamo usare le tasche di dimensioni adeguate per uno smartphone. CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Soft, truly waterproof, and pup approved
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: This is a great dog blanket! It's the perfect size to fit my couch and the charcoal color is unobtrusive and also blends with my dog's fur color. It's also very soft and comfy on both the smooth fleece side and the sherpa side. And it is truly waterproof. I tested both sides of the blanket and not a speck of water went through. I first tested the sherpa side by pouring some water on and leaving it for 10 minutes. The water remained beaded the entire time and wiped away easily. No moisture on the reverse side. So when I tested the smooth side I used my fingers to push the water into the fleece to see if any soaked in liquid would seep through. I also puddled more water on to make sure it would hold an actual potty. After 10 minutes there was absolutely no moisture on the reverse and again I was able to soak up and wipe away the liquid to the point that it was dry to the touch where the water had been. Needless to say I'm really impressed and confident the blanket will protect my furniture well.

I use my trailer for various purposes, from towing my boat to hauling equipment for home projects, and knowing that it's secure when I'm not around is invaluable.

The bright color of the lock is another feature I appreciate. It acts as a visual deterrent, signaling to would-be thieves that this trailer is well-protected. The peace of mind this adds is worth every penny.

If I had to nitpick, the only minor downside would be the initial stiffness of the lock mechanism. However, a bit of lubricant solved this issue quickly.

In essence, the Rhino USA Trailer Hitch Coupler Lock Kit has proven to be an excellent investment for keeping my trailer safe. Its solid build, ease of use, and deterrent factor make it an essential item for anyone looking to secure their trailer effectively.

Really soft bristle brushes like the sort you use for toddlers don't get through his thick hair. The Ninabella has enough flex in the bristles, and the clever spiral springy design, to avoid pulling. Die Shirts sind leicht, was sie ideal für intensive Workouts macht. Sie sind so konzipiert, dass sie Sie nicht belasten oder Ihre Bewegungsfreiheit einschränken, egal wie intensiv Ihr Training ist.

Ein weiteres herausragendes Merkmal dieser Tops ist ihre Atmungsaktivität. Sie sind so konzipiert, dass sie Schweiß effektiv ableiten und Ihnen helfen, während des Trainings trocken und kühl zu bleiben. Dies trägt zu einem angenehmen Trainingserlebnis bei und hilft Ihnen, Ihre Leistung zu maximieren.

Die Tops sind sowohl als Laufoberteile als auch als Fitnessstudio-T-Shirts einsetzbar. Dies macht sie zu einem vielseitigen Kleidungsstück, das für eine Vielzahl von Aktivitäten geeignet ist.

Das Set enthält zwei Tops in den Farben Schwarz und Dunkelblau. Beide Farben sind klassisch und vielseitig, sodass sie zu fast jeder Sportbekleidung passen.

Die Tops sind in der Größe XL erhältlich, was eine bequeme Passform für die meisten Männer gewährleistet. Sie sind so konzipiert, dass sie eine schmeichelhafte Silhouette bieten und gleichzeitig genügend Bewegungsfreiheit für alle Arten von Übungen bieten.

Insgesamt sind die Shirts eine hervorragende Wahl für jeden aktiven Mann. Sie bieten eine Kombination aus Leichtigkeit, Atmungsaktivität und Stil, die sie zu einem unverzichtbaren Bestandteil jeder Sportgarderobe machen. Ich kann sie uneingeschränkt empfehlen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Hunde Schwimmweste Größe S - gute Qualität, gibt Sicherheit!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Unser Hund liebt es zu schwimmen, doch manchmal überschätzt er sich im Spiel. Besonders wenn es um Bälle geht, kann seine Fixierung dazu führen, dass er Erschöpfungssignale übersieht, was uns Sorgen bereitet. Um solche Situationen zu vermeiden, haben wir uns entschieden, diese Schwimmweste zu testen.

Die Weste passt gut, da wir sie anhand der Angaben vermessen haben. Dennoch hätte ich mir vor der Bestellung eine Größentabelle gewünscht, um die Entscheidung zu erleichtern. Eine Bild mit Kategorisierung mit Größen und nach Hunderassen in XS, S, M, L usw. wäre sehr hilfreich gewesen.

Die Verarbeitung der Weste ist sehr gut und sie sitzt gut am Hund. Sie lässt sich schnell anziehen. Die ersten Tests im See haben gezeigt, dass die Weste weder beim Schwimmen noch beim Spielen stört. Unser Hund kommt gut damit zurecht und wir haben ein sicheres Gefühl dabei. Besonders positiv sind der Haltegriff und die Möglichkeit, den Hund anzuleinen.

Ich kann die Schwimmweste weiterempfehlen.

For starters I will say I live in SE Texas, and we get pretty hot down here. I mainly wanted something to cover my arms so I don't tan or burn. Since I'm pretty light complected I either tan, or I'll either burn. I don't want to do either so I looked for sleeves. These claim to provide a cooling effect. Of course I was skeptical. I usually like black but black tends to absorb heat more so wasn't sure how well it'll work if I got black. So I chose the light blue colour. As far as uv protection, it's hard to say but I'm assuming it is protecting my arms since I've neither burned or tanned. I have no car so Mom and I walk to work (22 minutes to and from) and I work 4-5 days a week and I've been using them since I got them (about 2 or 3 months now?) and I will say they have NOT LOST their hold!! I'm extremely surprised that they are still nice and tight and hacent been worn out or started to roll down my arms yet! So I'd say they have great durability in that aspect! I have seen a few threads starting to snag a long my wrists but it's not too bad. The material isn't so thin and cheap that it'll unravel from a lose thread. Theure also pretty long. My arms are quite short so I can literally slide these all the way up my shoulder and still have it cover my hand and fingers. It's stretchy but will keep it's hold around your arm. If you have plus size arms or big muscles, it'll probably fit you tight and be too uncomfortable to wear for long periods of time. Now onto the cooling factor. I will say it does AND doesn't work. Does it keep you cool? Yes and no. Yes if there is a breeze/some wind. It'll keep you cool. Especially if you walk into a place with a you'll feelt the cooling INSTANTLY! Does it keep you cool when there is no wind? No, no it does not. BUT it also WILL NOT make you hotter. Unlike a sweater, hoodie or normal long sleeve shirt that will make you hotter when wearing in this summer heat, these sleeves do not make you hotter. You can wear them and feel comfortable. And again when you get that wind, ooohh baby do you feel some coolness! So again yes and no to the cooling effect. But take this with a grain of salt since this is MY experience we're talking about. And again I live in SE Texas. So for others they might feel more of a cooling effect than me depending on the area they live in and the humidity etc. But all in all these are great. The compression is nice as well. I say these are pretty decent to try out! And the prices aren't too bad either! I will definitely be buying more from this brand!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Convient, compact and stands up to wind (with some cavaets)
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
We live in Florida and have generally taken one of those big (10 to 13 ft) canopies. You know the huge ones that are big and unwieldy? Over the years we've lost a couple to wind (even if we had them tied down with sand weights).

This thing is super compact and easy to setup. Our first outing with it was at Ft. Lauderdale beach for the air show. It was windy and we had to experiment (following the suggestions of others) but we were able to quickly and easily make it super sturdy. Here are my suggestions:
1) Buy a good quality folding beach shovel.
2) Make sure the four stretched out ends are stretched out REALLY far - it's going to feel weird but you want it to be a tight fit.
3) Make sure those four sand bags ends are 8-10 inches below the level of the sand. Otherwise they will just slide across the sand under the tension. But if you slightly bury them they will stay in place even under the strain of the wind.

Buy this thing - you won't regret it!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Solid jars with a sturdy rack
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This dispenser set comes with a sturdy stand that easily supports the 3 jugs even when full of water. The jugs come with silicone plugs and plastic spigots. The spigots are painted silver and look metal, but they are completely plastic. They are held in place with a plastic nut that squeezes the silicone gasket to prevent any leaks. When the spigot is attached tightly enough, they are watertight and will not leak. If you haven't attached it tight enough it will drip. It can then be tightened by rotating the spigot to clamp it down.

The jars have glass lids that just sit on top with no gasket or insulation to seal the lid onto the top of the jug and hold it in place. They are just held in place by gravity. The jugs have a pebble exterior on an octagon shape. This pebbled exterior helps you to grip and hold on to the jug when carrying it. Not only is it a nice design feature, but I really appreciate the extra grip that it provides.

The jugs are solid and have a decent weight. They are glass, so will need to be handled with care. This is a great set for a party, wedding, or other event where people will be serving their own drinks. The three jugs allow you to have a larger quantity of beverages available with multiple flavors if desired.

Ho recentemente acquistato il set di borse ghiaccio Magic Gel per ginocchio, spalla e schiena, e posso dire che è stato un vero toccasana per i miei dolori muscolari e articolari.

Panoramica
Ho scelto queste borse ghiaccio perché il caldo estivo può essere davvero opprimente, cercavo un modo efficace per ridurre l'infiammazione e trovare sollievo dai dolori. Il set Magic Gel ha superato le mie aspettative, offrendo sia crioterapia che termoterapia in un unico prodotto versatile.

Design e Qualità
Materiale: Le borse sono realizzate in gel di alta qualità con un'elevata percentuale di glicerolo, che impedisce al gel di diventare un blocco di ghiaccio solido. Questo le rende sempre pronte all'uso, mantenendo la loro flessibilità anche quando sono molto fredde.
Dimensioni: Ogni unità misura 28 x 14 cm, una dimensione perfetta per coprire aree come ginocchio, spalla, schiena, e altro ancora.
Strap Velcro: Le cinghie elastiche regolabili con chiusura in velcro sono una caratteristica eccezionale. Mantengono le borse saldamente in posizione, consentendo di regolare la pressione e lasciare le mani libere.

Funzionalità
Crioterapia e Termoterapia: Ho utilizzato le borse sia per la crioterapia che per la termoterapia. Le ho messe nel freezer per ottenere un impacco freddo e nel microonde per un impacco caldo. Entrambi i metodi sono stati efficaci per alleviare i dolori muscolari e le infiammazioni.
Versatilità: Ho usato queste borse per trattare vari dolori e infortuni. La versatilità di questo prodotto è davvero notevole, rendendolo un compagno indispensabile per chiunque soffra di dolori cronici o occasionali.

Benefici e Risultati
Sollievo Immediato: Ho trovato un sollievo immediato dopo aver applicato le borse ghiaccio sui muscoli affaticati e sulle articolazioni doloranti. La sensazione di freschezza allevia immediatamente il dolore e l'infiammazione.
Recupero Rapido: Studi medici dimostrano che l'uso di impacchi di ghiaccio accelera la guarigione dagli infortuni e riduce il dolore muscolare. Dopo solo pochi utilizzi, ho notato un miglioramento significativo nel mio recupero post-allenamento.
Flessibilità: Anche quando congelate, le borse rimangono flessibili, adattandosi perfettamente al corpo. Questo è particolarmente utile per ottenere un trattamento uniforme e confortevole.

Utilizzo e Manutenzione
Facilità d'Uso: Utilizzare queste borse è semplicissimo. Basta infilarle nella tasca della fascia e fissarle attorno alla zona interessata con il velcro. Sono comode da indossare e permettono di continuare le attività quotidiane senza restrizioni.
Manutenzione: Le borse sono riutilizzabili e facili da pulire. Dopo l'uso, le ho semplicemente asciugate e riposte nel freezer per il prossimo utilizzo. La plastica PVC resistente agli strappi e a prova di perdite assicura una lunga durata.

Conclusione
Il set di borse ghiaccio Magic Gel è un acquisto eccellente per chi cerca sollievo dai dolori muscolari e articolari. Offrono un sollievo immediato, sono versatili e facili da usare, e la qualità del materiale garantisce una lunga durata. Consiglio vivamente questo prodotto a chiunque voglia migliorare la propria qualità di vita con un trattamento efficace e conveniente.
Pratico e maneggevole, utile per contusioni, un po' lungo il tempo che serve a ghiacciarlo rispetto al tempo dell'uso. In complesso un buon acquisto. L'ideale sarebbe averne due.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: They last, are comfortable and sit well
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I'm using these on and off since three years. I have a natural B, but some dresses and outfits just need more to sit right. These work perfectly for that and move fairly naturally. And some days I just want a bit more curve just because. Once they warm up to my body they don't slide, and even a full day isn't a problem. I've traveled with them on, and it's been comfortable. Beware that they are not concave, so they will not fully conform to any existing breast especially if you buy too big.

Because they sit securely (on me at least), I can get away with a sports bra as well, they haven't moved at all while exercising. YMMV of course.

My recommendation is to take care of your skin underneath, with lotion or whatever else works for you. On a very hot day with lots of sweat I give my babies a good massage, baby lotion and general skincare. Never a problem, just something to be careful about.

Aber es bleibt festzuhalten, dass die Hülle auf meinen Kindle Paperwhite (5. Generation aus 2012) nicht passt - obwohl auch in der Produktbeschreibung steht "[...] für Modelle bis 2017 [...]".

Habe die Hülle nur deswegen behalten, weil sie perfekt (auch die Ausschnitte für die Anschlüsse sitzen richtig) auf meinen nagelneuen Kindle Paperwhite (11. Generation) passt ... auch wenn ich das aufgrund der Produktbeschreibung nicht ganz verstehe.

Aber auch von der irreführenden Beschreibung abgesehen bin ich von der Hülle nicht wirklich begeistert. Schon im (angeblichen) Neuzustand zeigen sich auf der Rückseite leichte Abriebspuren. Am Rand gibt's dann auch noch einen feinen, aber haptisch deutlich wahrnehmbaren, umlaufenden Grat.

Gut, das ist bei einer Silikon-Hülle jetzt keine Katastrophe - aber für den selbstbewussten Preis will man eigentlich nichts von den hier beschriebenen Eigenschaften sehen ...

Deswegen reicht das nur für zwei Punkte. Sorry, aber das geht definitiv viel besser ...

My two girls ages 7 and 9 rode these for about 2 miles in total, and now ride pedal bikes without training wheels!

The one thing I do not like, but remedied by buying simple quick release bike bolt clamps easily found on Amazon.
The bolts used to tighten down on the clamp for the handlebar fork and the seat post are not the best. Like me others noted you just can't tighten them enough or like me you break the bolt trying. But like I said, the quick release bolts work so much better.

What else can I say. They bikes are super light and fit easily in the back of wagon or mid size SUV, and probably would as well in a full size car.

The trick is to find a nice path relatively flat , but a slight downslope throughout. It gives the kids a chance to just ride and work on balance without thinking about pushing themselves along.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich habe die runde Yogamatte von Navaris gekauft, weil ich für Mobility- und Animal Flow-Einheiten mehr Bewegungsspielraum haben wollte, als ihn die übliche rechteckige Mattenform erlaubt. Mit 120cm Durchmesser ist die Matte auch groß genug, um z.B. in verschiedene Richtungen rückwärts zu rollen aber auch groß genug um klassische Übungen auszuführen, ohne auf dem Laminat zu landen.

Sie dämpft gut, ist aber nicht zu weich, sodass man nicht einsinkt. Ganz wichtig für mich: die Matte rutscht weder unter meinen Füßen, noch auf dem Laminat, sondern bleibt an Ort und Stelle. Wie sie sich beim Training mit Schuhen verträgt, habe ich nicht ausprobiert, ich nutze sie nur barfuß.
Darüber hinaus hat sie praktisch keinen Eigengeruch, auch am Tag der Lieferung musste ich sie nicht auf dem Balkon auslüften o.ä.

Einen kleinen Kritikpunkt habe ich jedoch: anders als bei handelsüblichen rechteckigen Matten ist bei dieser kein Trage- oder Klettband beigelegt. Wenn man sie einrollt, rollt sie sich wieder halb auf, das sieht in unserem Sportutensilienkorb nicht so schön aus. Deshalb habe ich mir ein zusätzliches Klettband beim Amazon bestellt, jetzt kann ich sie nach dem Training gut verstauen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Rock solid, doesn't rust, honestly awesome
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
So.. I never thought I'd be impressed by a shower caddy. Like.... Who cares, right?

I have two of these. One for 3.5 years and one for 3 years. I'd buy another one if I had any more showers to put them in.

The mounting system is absolutely rock solid. It uses a large, clear, adhesive panel that the rack snaps into. I've got it pretty loaded and it doesn't move a millimeter.

The metal hasn't discoloured at all, and aside from the mild film that covers everything in the shower, it looks as good as new.

The little metal hangers that come with it are handy for shower puffs and we use a pair side by side to hold our razor. Tip: To keep the razor hooks anchored in place, jam a bit of zip tie under the clip to add tension where it hangs off the edge of the caddy. (Note: In the photo we've added a couple of metal hangers from the second caddy.)

The only place this falls short is when you're low on shampoo and start to store the bottle upside down. They tend to slide and tumble because the metal rack doesn't provide much friction. Not a big deal, but not perfect.

Very easy product to recommend!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: 5 Sterne - Perfekte Fußballshorts für aktive Jungen!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich habe diese funktionalen schwarzen Fußballshorts für meinen Sohn gekauft und bin absolut begeistert von der Qualität und dem Design.

Zunächst möchte ich betonen, dass die Empfehlung, eine Größe größer zu bestellen, absolut richtig war. Die Shorts sind schmal geschnitten, und die größere Größe passt meinem Sohn perfekt. Die Größentabelle am Ende der Bildergalerie war sehr hilfreich, um die richtige Wahl zu treffen.

Das Leistungsgewebe ist leicht und atmungsaktiv, was die Shorts ideal für sportliche Aktivitäten macht. Mein Sohn trägt sie hauptsächlich zum Fußballtraining, aber sie sind auch perfekt für andere Outdoor-Aktivitäten. Selbst bei intensiven Spielen bleibt er dank der TCA D.R.Y. Technologie trocken und bequem, da der Schweiß effektiv von der Haut abgeleitet wird und schnell verdunstet.

Besonders praktisch finde ich die zwei fusion-geschweißten Reißverschlusstaschen. Sie bieten einen sicheren Aufbewahrungsort für Wertsachen wie Schlüssel oder kleine Geldbeträge. Das gibt mir als Elternteil ein gutes Gefühl, da ich weiß, dass nichts verloren gehen kann, egal wie wild das Spiel wird.

Insgesamt sind diese Fußballshorts von TCA eine großartige Investition. Sie sind funktional, bequem und durchdacht gestaltet. Mein Sohn liebt sie und trägt sie bei jeder Gelegenheit. Ich kann sie jedem empfehlen, der auf der Suche nach hochwertigen Sportshorts für Kinder ist!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Your Last Line of Defense in the Swamp of Doom!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
So, you’re diving into a swampland that’s practically a mosquito buffet? Grab the Tough Outdoors Mosquito Pants! These babies boast net bug mesh, giving you solid protection against those pesky insects while they buzz around like they’re auditioning for a horror movie. Sure, they won’t give you a perfect shield, but they definitely help keep the mosquitoes at bay.

These pants let you leap over swampy pits or duck under branches, and while you might feel like a gazelle, let’s be honest: agility only gets you so far when the bugs are plotting your demise. You might end up looking stylish, but you’re still a well-dressed target.

And the durability? They’ll hold up against mud and water, but don’t expect them to save you from crocodiles or any lurking swamp monsters. You might look slightly less like a mud monster, but that won’t stop the real threats out there.

If you’re considering these pants for a mosquito-infested adventure, know that they do provide some useful protection—not a 10 out of 10, but definitely helpful for keeping those bugs at bay. Five stars for making you look good while swatting away mosquitoes and navigating a wild environment—but don’t count on them to fend off everything lurking in the swamp!

Utilizzo la custodia da circa un anno e devo dire che sono rimasta molto soddisfatta del suo rendimento nel tempo.
Inizialmente, la custodia si è dimostrata robusta e protettiva, mantenendo il mio telefono al sicuro da graffi e piccoli urti grazie al materiale in silicone TPU di buona qualità. Il design con il laccetto è stato particolarmente utile, permettendomi di tenerlo comodamente al polso durante le attività quotidiane.
La custodia ha resistito bene all'uso quotidiano intenso, tuttavia, negli ultimi mesi ho notato che ha cominciato a ingiallirsi leggermente. Questo è comprensibile dato che la utilizzo tutti i giorni, ma è l'unico segno di usura visibile dopo un anno di utilizzo costante.
Nonostante questo, la custodia continua a svolgere efficacemente il suo lavoro di protezione per il mio OnePlus Nord. È facile da pulire e mantiene una presa salda sul telefono, senza compromettere l'accesso alle porte e ai pulsanti.

Questa scelta si rivela, segnatamente, molto comoda per chi abbisogni di raffreddare l'acqua tramite dei cubetti di ghiaccio.

La ciotola per il cibo è, invece, caratterizzata da un sistema tradizionale e non include alcun distributore automatico.

La bottiglia e la ciotola in alluminio sono comodamente rimovibili, al fine di un migliore lavaggio delle componentistiche.

I can however tell you that the box is very well built. Real wood, nice finish and quality hinges. It would look good anywhere. In a fancy room or in one like mine.

This is one of those purchases that you're not gonna be happy to make but you will be happy with having a really nice way to remember your best friend.

Although I bought this cover in January 2024, it was in preparation for a trip I was taking in April of 2024. It was a road trip that lasted 6 weeks. Mostly good weather, only 1 or 2 days of rain. By the time we got back home the tape on the seams that keep everything waterproof had failed.

First of all if you’re planning on using this in Myrtle Beach, you can’t. During the peak summer months they don’t allow beach tents. I did not know this and was annoyed. So we drove to Surfside beach 15 min south of where we stayed. Nice beach BTW. Less crowded.

Anyway, I watched the instruction video like three times as this thing kept getting knocked over with the wind. Tried using all four pols, then two. I was about to pack the thing up to return it when I watched the video one last time. When they say OVERFILL the sacks, OVERFILL THE SACKS!!!!!! The sand was hot and I figured what I did was enough. Nope! Spread the tent out, OVERFILL the sacks, place two or four poles, depending on how windy it is. Stretch the sacks out again, and for good measure put more sand in.
After I did that it held beautifully.

I did take one star off because when I did get it set up and started relaxing under the great shade it provided, it started to rain 😠. This thing is NOT water proof like beach umbrellas are. Rain drops hit it and it splattered into several drops. So we couldn’t wait out the rain under it at all, like I have in the past with beach umbrellas.

So pros, you get A LOT more shade for your whole family.
Cons, it takes a few more minutes to set up, not all beaches let you use them, and they aren’t water proof.
All good.would recommend this.

He pedido estas camisetas deportivas y debo decir que me han encantado. El paquete viene con dos camisetas, una negra y una azul oscuro. La ligereza de la tela es lo primero que se nota; es increíblemente fresca y cómoda, lo que la hace perfecta para actividades físicas intensas o para los días más calurosos. La calidad del material es evidente tanto al tacto como en su rendimiento durante el uso, proporcionando una sensación cómoda.

Las costuras son otro punto fuerte. Están muy bien hechas y no hay signos de hilos sueltos o puntadas débiles, lo que añade a la durabilidad de la prenda. En cuanto al diseño, es sutil pero moderno. Las pequeñas líneas que adornan la camiseta no son muy perceptibles a simple vista, pero aportan un toque de sofisticación que la distingue de otras camisetas deportivas básicas unicolor. En conjunto, esta camiseta combina funcionalidad y estilo de manera excelente, haciendo que sea una buena elección para el ejercicio y el uso diario.

Buena relación calidad-precio, sin duda un producto recomendado.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Sehr angenehm zu tragen und sitzt bei mir perfekt
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Dies ist eine Bewertung eines kostenlosen Produktes im Rahmen eines Produkttests. In meinen Bewertungen bin ich völlig frei und beschreibe meine persönlichen Erfahrungen mit dem jeweiligen Produkt.

Kurzfassung:
Bislang kann ich rein gar nichts Negatives sagen – im Gegenteil! Ich mag sie! Die Hose trägt sich sehr angenehm und sitzt bei mir perfekt.

Langfassung:
Die Lieferung kam zügig und war ordentlich in einer Folientasche verpackt.

Erster Eindruck: sehr positiv! Die Nähte sind sauber vernäht und nirgends steht auch nur ein Fitzelchen Faden ab.

Verarbeitung / Ausstattung: Die Tasche besitzt insgesamt 3 Taschen: je eine offene an den Beinen (die mir erst gar nicht auffielen) und eine mit Reißverschluss hinten. Die Beintaschen sind relativ groß bemessen, so dass sogar ein großes Smartphone bequem reinpassen würde. Die Tasche hinten erscheint auf den ersten Blick sehr klein, da ein kurzer Reißverschluss (12cm) vernäht wurde. Aber das täuscht! Die Tasche hat innen eine Höhe von ca. 9 cm und eine Breite von 25-28cm. Alles ist sauber verarbeitet.

Tragekomfort: Natürlich gibt es die üblichen Druckstellen (Bund, Beinabschlüsse), aber die gibt es bei jeder Radhose. Schließlich sollen die gummierten Beinabschlüsse und der Bund dafür sorgen, dass die Hose da bleibt, wo sie soll. Und das tun sie perfekt ohne zu behindern.
Die Polsterung ist sehr gut aber nicht unangenehm. Sie schützt wo sie soll und gibt „Freiheiten“ wo nötig.
Die Hose in Größe „L“ sitzt bei mir (1,91cm, 87kg) perfekt und trägt sich sehr angenehm. Ich hatte die Hose inzwischen bei mehreren Gelegenheiten im Einsatz – u.a. auf einer Tagestour mit dem MTB in den Alpen. Speziell auf dieser Tour trug ich die Hose den ganzen Tag unter meiner O’Neal MTB-Shorts und bemerkte die Radhose erst abends wieder beim Ausziehen!

Pflege: Das übliche bei Sportbekleidung: Waschen bei 30°C, kein Trockner (ist auch nicht nötig, da sie relativ schnell trocknet), keine Reinigung etc. Also alles machbar.

Fazit: Die Hose würde ich mir sofort (wieder) kaufen!

I pantaloncini atletici per ragazzi proposti da TCA si presentano come un capo d'abbigliamento funzionale per le attività fisiche giovanili. Realizzati con un tessuto leggero e traspirante, questi indumenti mirano a offrire comfort durante l'esercizio. La struttura aderente potrebbe richiedere l'acquisto di una taglia superiore per garantire una vestibilità ottimale.

Tra gli aspetti positivi, si evidenzia la presenza di tasche con chiusura lampo, un dettaglio pratico per riporre in sicurezza piccoli oggetti personali. L'elastico in vita marchiato TCA promette di mantenere i pantaloncini in posizione durante il movimento.

Tuttavia, la necessità di ordinare una misura più grande potrebbe risultare scomoda per alcuni acquirenti. Inoltre, la descrizione di "prestazione d'élite" potrebbe generare aspettative elevate che non sempre corrispondono all'esperienza reale dell'utente medio.

Recap.
In conclusione, questi pantaloncini sportivi sembrano offrire una soluzione adeguata per l'attività fisica dei ragazzi, pur presentando alcune limitazioni. La loro funzionalità appare nella norma, senza particolari elementi di spicco.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Useful device but requires 5V supply not 3.3V and the wrong current range option was supplied
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This is a very convenient way to achieve current measurement on an Arduino or similar. The board requires a 5V supply, which can be sourced from the Arduino, and generates an analogue output. Note that the analogue output voltage goes up to close to 5V so it's not suitable for direct connection to an analogue input on an Arduino Due or similar 3.3V platform. A couple of resistors will easily reduce the voltage to a range that can be measured by the Arduino or an attached separate ADC if you want more accuracy.

The main problem for me is that I ordered the 5A current range version but they supplied the 30A versiom, which is unsuitable for the current that I need to measure fairly accurately (up to about 3A). So I'll return and re-order from another seller on Amazon.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
First off, these are fantastic shelves. Look good, super sturdy, can hold lots of stuff, the hooks kinda snap on so they don’t move around every time you put something on or take it off. The only reason I took a star off is because removing the adhesive panels is a Herculean task. With a lot of effort, patience, strong nails, and possibly the loss of your fingerprints, you can take them both off in about 30 minutes. So if you’re in an apartment, don’t leave this till the last second or you WILL be panicking. Blow dryer didn’t help either, if anything it made the adhesive stick more. That said, am I buying a new set of adhesive strips for the apartment I’m moving into?

Da una parte perchè questo prevede l'uso di ben 3 pile AAA ma dall'altro rende questo oggetto più simile ad un giocattolo per giunta scomodo se pensate che vi toccherà portarvi dietro le pile, doverle ricaricare e procurarvi pile e caricatore. Certo potreste tranquillamente rinunciare alla torcia tanto di fatto non ha tutta questa rilevanza e francamente non ce l'avrei nemmeno messa. Torcia a parte, è provvisto di taglia cintura, ha una funzione da sirena e ha la base magnetica.
Tutte funzioni discutibili che in realtà spiegano il prezzo sovradimensionato ma che mostrano un'evidente inutilità nella maggior parte dei casi.
Avrei preferito decisamente di più un attrezzo solido, robusto e magari non in plastica dato che per il genere di plastica che ha, in caso di incendio mi sa che è il primo oggetto a squagliarsi.

I measured their height, best I could, and calculated that I needed one between 90cm and 1m. I got a 95cm Live Infinitely ball, August 2023. I had to add more air a couple times, but easily got it to be firm enough for sitting ergonomically correct and stable. I can sit on it for a longer time, than a chair, without trouble. It has been great!

I have a second desk, where I do my work, and the chair there, with a pillow was fine, but I have a really big project starting soon and will need to sit there for longer time. I just ordered a second 95cm ball and it is way…WAY BIGGER! Much too high to sit on comfortably.

It is not more inflated. They are equally firm when pushing or sitting on them. They are different sizes. (See photo.)

Which of the two balls is actually the 95cm one?

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Great Value for a Stylish, Functional Card Holder!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I recently purchased the kwmobile Card Holder for my iPhone and have been very pleased with its performance. The wallet is well-made and crafted from synthetic leather that looks far more expensive than its actual cost. There is a fair range of colors to choose from, allowing for some personalization.

The wallet comfortably holds two cards, which is perfect for my needs as I use it to carry my driving license and debit card. However, trying to fit a third card would be a stretch. One standout feature is the strong magnet, which holds the wallet securely to my phone. I use an official iPhone 13 Mini Leather MagSafe Case and feel confident that the wallet won't come apart. In fact, it even sticks comfortably to the front of my fridge!

There are a couple of minor drawbacks. Firstly, the wallet arrived in a plastic bag rather than a nice presentation box as depicted in the product images. Additionally, the front of mine had a small scratch upon delivery and it was slightly bent which I put down to being delivered in a pastic bag. Also, it can be quite difficult to remove a card from the wallet. A useful trick I've found is to turn one card over if it is embossed, allowing you to use the embossed area to push the card up and out.

Overall, I would recommend this wallet, especially if you're using a MagSafe case or a phone with built-in MagSafe. The minor issues I encountered are not deal-breakers considering the wallet's value for money. One star off for the lack of presentation and the scratch, but otherwise, it's a very good buy!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Perfekte Sicherheit und Komfort für aktive Hunde im Wasser
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Als stolzer Besitzer eines aktiven Hundes, der gerne Zeit im Wasser verbringt, war ich auf der Suche nach einer zuverlässigen Schwimmweste, die nicht nur Sicherheit, sondern auch Komfort bietet. Die Dog Life Jacket in Limettengrün hat sich dabei als eine ausgezeichnete Wahl erwiesen und erfüllt alle meine Erwartungen:

1. Sicherheit im Wasser:
Die Schwimmweste bietet meinem Hund eine ausgezeichnete Auftriebsunterstützung, sodass er sich sicher im Wasser bewegen kann, ohne zu ermüden. Das ist besonders wichtig, wenn wir zusammen am See oder am Strand sind.

2. Hochwertiges Material und Verarbeitung:
Die Weste ist aus strapazierfähigem und hochwertigem Material gefertigt, das nicht nur robust ist, sondern auch gut verarbeitet wurde. Es gibt keine losen Nähte oder andere Mängel, was für die Langlebigkeit spricht.

3. Passgenauigkeit und Komfort:
Die Weste passt meinem Hund perfekt und lässt sich dank der verstellbaren Gurte optimal anpassen. Sie bietet ausreichend Bewegungsfreiheit, sodass sich mein Hund auch wohl fühlt und nicht eingeschränkt wird.

4. Praktische Details:
Besonders praktisch finde ich die Grifflasche am Rücken der Weste, die es ermöglicht, meinen Hund im Wasser schnell und einfach zu greifen. Die leuchtend grüne Farbe sorgt zudem für eine gute Sichtbarkeit, was die Sicherheit weiter erhöht.

5. Leicht zu reinigen:
Die Schwimmweste lässt sich nach dem Gebrauch einfach mit klarem Wasser abspülen und ist schnell trocknend, was die Pflege erleichtert.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: MUY BUENA TABLA DE CORTAR PARA OLVIDARSE DE LAS DE PLÁSTICO
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Anteriormente teníamos tablas de cortar de plástico, y estábamos algo preocupados porque después de varios usos, se van marcando todos los cortes, y además, generan microplásticos (o eso dicen) que no deben ser muy buenos para la salud... Así que tiramos las antiguas a la basura, y compramos esta. Y realmente, estamos muy satisfechos de la compra. Las razones:
✅ Se ve una tabla de calidad. Robusta. Y de buena madera, que es lo que queríamos principalmente.
✅ Muy buen tamaño.
✅ Tiene un pequeño surco alrededor para que cuando cortes productos que dejan líquido, no se escape todo al marmol de la cocina o a la mesa. Muy práctico.
✅ Fácil limpieza.
✅ Relación calidad-precio, muy competitivo.

Como puntos a tener en cuenta:
⚠️ Yo le añadí en la parte de abajo cuatro adhesivos pequeños para que no resvalase, y la hora de cortar, quedase mejor sujeta al marmol. Ahora resulta más práctica.
⚠️ Este tipo de tablas hay que tener un poco más de cuidado a la hora de limpiarla, y especialmente a la hora de secarla, para que no se vayan estropeando. Pero aún así, el cuidado es mínimo... tampoco requieren de un gran esfuerzo, más allá de que no queden húmedas por mucho tiempo.

En resumen, 100% satisfecho del producto y de la compra.

This thing is a gamechanger. I'd used several combinations of carbon fiber brushes and wet brushes and somehow always ended up with debris in the grooves still. Since I got this guy I never wonder if I got a bad record when I listen to it. I start with my carbon fiber brush and then use this guy, then use two sprays of Lasermedia cleaning solution and wipe off with a microfiber cloth/brick, and finish off with another use of this. I'm finally getting the clean, high fidelity sound that I started buying records for without the static and the noise from debris.

I think most people run it along the grooves several times, but I tend to run it from the label to the outside of the disc instead. It seems to do a great job lifting stuff from the surface of the disc, as well as the top of the grooves. If you have some debris really stuck in there then running it sideways could help you to get in there, but at that point I'd probably recommend another clean with the spray and microfiber, or a run through a record cleaner.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Nice winter work gloves, but couple of concerns
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Outer glove is a woven nylon/spandex sturdy and stretchy. I like that the opening extends a little further up your wrist and is form-fitting - great for keeping the opening under your shirt or jacket sleeve (so no snow slips inside). The palms and fingertips are coated with a flexible, fairly-thick nitrile. Pretty thick, completely covered, but not sure how puncture resist really is. ( I guess the vendor isn’t either, as their puncture and abrasion ratings are different on the gloves, in the product photo, and in the product information!) The glove lining is fairly-thick microfiber fleece, which feels warm right now, but will be curious to see if they really keep my hands warm in 23 degree weather.
I do have a few concerns with these gloves: The lining is not fully attached to the outer glove. And the gloves are quite tight. As a result, the lining has a tendency to pull out of the fingers when you remove the gloves. Also, I wish that the gloves were more waterproof - the parts that aren’t covered by the nitrile do not keep out moisture - so they aren’t great for working in the snowy season. I was surprised to see that the edge sewing around the wrists are already unraveling, right out of the package.
Overall, these gloves are comfortable, a little smaller (tighter) than I expected, and are decent work gloves. Not particularly heavy-duty.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Work well - but cage nuts are a very tight fit
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
These are decent quality sets of screw/plastic washer/cage nut, with M6 thread as used in most UK and European 19" rack mount kit, both audio and IT.

The screws look smart in use and the plastic cupped washers protect your valuable kit from getting scratched by the screws. However, the cage nuts are as tight as a very-tight-thing in the standard 7.5mm square holes found in racking strips. No chance at all of following the optimistic instructions from the Youtube guys, effortlessly slotting their cage nuts in place with either bare fingers or a gentle prod from a screwdriver. I don't think I'm particularly weak, but I had to lean really hard on a flat-blade screwdriver to persuade the second little lug on the cage nut to go through the hole in the racking... and woe betide your racking (and possibly your fingers) if the screwdriver slips! Once it's in place it's not going anywhere, of course, and you do get used to the amount of force required, but still... it doesn't exactly scream "precision engineering".
