CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Material is ABS plastic NOT cast iron - Single Converter Not a Pair
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
At first glance, the PowerPress Kettlebell handle converter caught my eye as an easy way to expand my home workout routine without breaking the bank on actual kettlebells. But before I delve into the good stuff, let's address the elephant in the room: the material description error. The material is listed as "cast iron", that’s flat-out wrong. It's entirely plastic, likely ABS based on the "ABS construction" phrase used in one of the images. The only metal is a small hinge pin and some internal pins around where the dumbbell bar sits and the locking clip.

Despite being almost entirely made of plastic, it feels surprisingly solid, at least with the 25-pound dumbbells I've used so far. It certainly handles that weight like a champ. My guess is that the 100-pound weight limit listed might be pushing it, but for anyone using moderate weights (around 50 pounds or less), it should hold up just fine. Overall, this has met my expectations, giving me the ability to quickly convert my dumbbells to kettlebells, expanding my exercise selection and enhancing my workout routines. All at an affordable price point.

One other thing I should point out for potential buyers is that in one of the pictures here it shows someone using two handle converters for lunges. However, keep in mind that this is a single handle, not a pair. If you want to do exercises like that, you'll need to purchase two units. So, the bottom line? If you're looking for a budget-friendly way to add some kettlebell exercises to your routine without taking up any extra space, this PowerPress handle converter is a pretty good option. Just be aware of the material discrepancy and the single-unit purchase, and you'll be well on your way to swinging your way to fitness.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Good ESP32 board, but beware of ESP32 versions
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
They're an ESP32 board which works very well in my setup. I'm using ESP-IDF and making use of a couple of GPIO pins and the onboard Wi-Fi. Seems very reliable.

My only quibble is with the version of the ESP32 chip used on these boards. I first bought one dispatched from AZ-Delivery in Germany as the dispatched-from-Amazon UK version had a longer delivery time. However, this was delayed probably due to customs, and as Amazon UK later had stock, I re-ordered dispatching from Amazon.

The Amazon supplied board had a version 3 ESP32 chip, which meant that e.g. Secure Boot V2 was supported.

The board from AZ-Delivery themselves has a version 1 ESP32 chip, meaning that Secure Boot V2 is not supported.

Whether this matters depends on your application and whether you want to use features that are only available on ESP32 chip version 3.

Nevertheless, I'm happy with both boards.

Designs themselves are very fun and creative.

Instructions ask users to memorize a reference of 30+ different symbols and folds. The author doesn't explain what any of the folds are, such as "mountain fold." Instead of reading an explanation of each design step, I have to constantly turn back to the symbols and folds reference every other step.

The instructions for specific designs frequently show symbols or mention folding techniques that aren't even mentioned in the reference. For example, in the images I posted, there are "=" and "+" symbols in a design step, and these don't exist in the symbols reference. Instructions are so bad I'd rather watch a video.

Also, this product comes in a box that's at least 5 times as big as its contents.

Avevo deciso di cambiare l'ottima custodia acquistata cinque anni fa per il mio LG G7 prima di regalarlo a mio fratello. Anche perché dopo avergli personalmente sostituito la batteria e installato una ROM Pixel Experience basata su Android 13 il telefono si presenta come fosse appena acquistato, con un'aspettativa di vita di ulteriori cinque anni (almeno). Per cui avevo deciso di pensionare l'attuale custodia che più volte lo ha salvato da improvvide cadute, ma non trovandola più della stessa marca ho dirottato su questa. Però non appena ricevuta e dopo averla provata mi son reso immediatamente conto che la qualità, purtroppo, è molto distante da quella della precedente. Inoltre il fatto che non vi sono tasti solidali al corpo della custodia ma delle forature che permettono di premere quelli del telefono rendono fastidiosa, oltre che poco funzionale, la pressione degli stessi. Per cui alla fine l'ho restituita e ho mantenuto la vecchia custodia. Anche perché tutto sommato è ancora in buono stato.

Why mention that it has optocoupler isolation, when, in fact, the control circuit and the supply for the relays have common supply. This doesn't qualify as opto-isolation, even with the possibility of using a separate positive supply for the relays' coils (available through the jumper). To qualify as a full opto-isolated device, the optocoupler should be controlled over a circuit that has no common signals with the controlled circuit, at all.
There are a lot of cheap Chinese suppliers that are using this hype, trying to sell something that performs the same as a similar circuit without any optocouplers included. It just sounds better for the person that doesn't understand electronics.

Lieferung & Verpackung: Der Mikrocontroller selber kommt ungepolstert in einer dünnwandigen Pappbox, Amazon verschickt mittlerweiler in der Kartontasche, dementspechened war die Pappbox komplett zusammengedrückt als sie hier ankam.
Zum Controller: Der Mikrocontroller schien äusserlich keinen Schaden genommen zu haben. Das Sketch hochladen per USB/TTL Modul funktionierte dann leider nur ein einziges Mal. Bei allen weiteren Sketch Hochladeversuchen hing der Upload dann jedesmal bis zum Fehler timeout. Ich habe alles mögliche durchprobiert, nichts hat geholfen. Am Ende versuchte ich es noch mit einem Bootloader flash, was auf den ersten Blick Hoffnung versprach, da es mir danach wieder möglich war einen neuen Sketch hochzuladen. Allerdings nur einmal.
Das selbe Spielchen habe ich dann noch mit einem zweiten USB/TTL Modul probiert, aber das gleiche Problem. Der MikroController scheint einen Defekt zu haben.
Beim AZDelivery Telefonsupport war heute (Montag) nach mehrmaligen Anrufen auch niemand zu erreichen.

Nachtrag:
Ich habe mich noch einmal per Email an den AZDelivery Support gewendet, worauf ich sehr zeitnah eine Rückmeldung erhalten habe. Der Support hat mir recht unkompliziert einen neuen MikroController zugesandt. Das Sketch Uploaden hat diesmal auf Anhiep funktioniert.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Pierde temperatura por la tapa de plástico, aunque cumple con su función
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
CONTENIDO:
1 caja (medidas aproximadas: 23 x 9,5 x 9,5 cm) que incluye en su interior:
-1 taza de acero inoxidable con asa. 560ml.
-1 tapa de plástico con apertura deslizante y goma para cerrar de forma hermética.

PROS:
-Empaque simple pero adecuado al producto.
-Taza de acero inoxidable de gran capacidad (560ml) con interior pulido y exterior esmaltado en azul oscuro con pintitas blancas.
-La tapa es de plástico libre de BPA, con una tapeta deslizante que permite beber sin que se pierda demasiada temperatura del interior.
-Cerrada, la taza mantiene su temperatura interior durante ocho horas, sea esta fría o caliente.
-La temperatura interior, sea fría o caliente, no traspasa al exterior, es decir, por caliente que esté el agua en su interior la taza puede cogerse por el asa o en su contorno sin peligro de quemaduras.
-A diferencia de las botellas de acero inoxidable que solo pueden usarse con agua, esta taza puede contener té, café, zumo, leche,...
-El diseño no tiene un solo desperfecto.
-Aunque es mejor lavar a mano, puede meterse en el lavavajillas.
-El precio actual de venta (15,99€) está en línea de productos similares.

CONTRAS:
-Aunque la taza cumple con su función, no mantiene la temperatura tanto tiempo como las botellas de acero inoxidable.
-Con el uso la goma de la tapa se gastará y dejará de ser estanca.

EN DEFINITIVA:
La taza cumple con su función, cabe en el reposavasos del coche, tiene una considerable capacidad y el diseño es discreto pero vistoso.
Avoid!! Product looks ok but a horrible smell that makes it unusable and throw away from your home immediately

When I got this plunger, I filled up the sink, opened the drain, and started pumping with the plunger on the drain. The first thing that happened was that a bunch of gross goo blasted out of the overflow drain. This increased the water flow out the main drain, because a clogged overflow drain is like when you take a soda bottle and turn it upside down. The water has a hard time flowing out smoothly if there is no way for air to easily get in behind the water in the bottle. Then I filled up the sink again and plunged the main drain, which boosted the flow even more. Now the water just flows right out. Anyway, the thing has really good suction and pressure.

Conjunto de seis portapapeles de plástico que son verdaderamente prácticos en ciertas ocasiones en las que debemos de realizar anotaciones en una hoja y necesitamos movernos de un lado para otro.

Estos portapapeles como dije están fabricados de plástico, éste es trasparente y semiflexible y tiene unas medidas de 22,5 com x 32,3 cm. En él podemos sujetar perfectamente folios de tamaño A4 o de un tamaño más pequeño. Es un artículo que resulta muy útil en ciertos trabajos, como puede ser en una oficina, en una academia, para un entrenador de cualquier equipo, etc.

En sus laterales tiene una regla. La regla del lateral izquierdo mide en cm y la del derecho en pulgadas, y sus marcas llegan hasta los 25 cm y 10 pulgadas respectivamente. En ocasiones, nos hace falta una regla que no tenemos a mano, por lo que éstas medidas pueden venir muy bien.

En la parte superior del portapapeles, tenemos una abrazadera de hierro, que tiene un baño de color plata, y en sus esquinas tiene unos protectores de plástico de color negro. Dicha abrazadera será la que usaremos para fijar el folio, y tiene fuerza más que suficiente para sujetar bien el folio y que éste no se mueva. Incluso podemos aguantar un buen puñado de folios.

En cuanto a la terminación de la base de plástico de este portapapeles, decir que las esquinas son redondas y la terminación de todo el perfil es muy buena, suave y sin desperfectos, por lo que no hay peligro de cortarnos.

El único aspecto que me genera un poco de duda de este producto, es la propia base de plástico, la cual no la veo, o me da la sensación, de que no es muy resistente, por lo que habrá que ver cómo aguanta el paso del tiempo y como resiste ante posibles golpes que le podamos dar.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Buen diseño y muy funcional, pero falla el control de calidad
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
El primero tuvimos que devolverlo porque la tapa de madera venía rota, como despegada una lasca. Por dentro, las planchas de proteccion venían rotas como de haberlo abierto mal, lo que me hizo pensar que se trataba de alguna devolución que han intentando colar de nuevo. Devolvimos por una nueva y esta que ha llegado ahora tiene alguna marquita en el cristal como de haberse rozado con un material abrasivo, con lo que afea un poco porque se encuentra en la parte 'frontal' de cara al usuario y se nota bastante. En cualquier caso ya no queremos marearnos más ni devolverla de nuevo.

El producto es muy bonito y encaja a la perfección en nuestra cocina, nos resulta muy cómodo y funcional. El asa en la parte superior del recipiente es fundamental a la hora de manipularla cuando está llena, además de bonita, de imitación a piel. Aunque parece que se fuese a romper el sistema del asa, por ahora funciona sin problema. La base de madera/bambú es muy ligera y de aspecto endeble, pero también hace su función de forma correcta. Hubiera agradecido que viniese lacada o con algún tipo de protección ante la humedad, pues no es raro que caiga agua en la base de madera durante las manipulaciones y esta se humedece, quedando las marcas de los cercos de agua cuando se seca. No he hecho la prueba, pero si fuese alguna bebida con color, estoy seguro de que absorbería el color de manera irreversible.
El grifo es bastante estándar, puedes encontrar el mismo grifo exacto en diferentes productos similares. Muy fácil de instalar y de operar. Sin embargo, un día empezó a gotear sin motivo aparente y no dejaba de hacerlo por mucho que lo intentáramos. Resultó preocupante porque igual que empezó a gotear, tras vaciar y volver a llenar el tanque, dejó de hacerlo, inexplicablemente.

Para mi se trata de un producto que no es tan premium como luce. NAVARIS debería poner más foco en los controles de calidad pues, para ser una empresa alemana, deja mucho que desear. Son detalles muy tontos que perjudican mucho al producto y a la marca: Tapa rota, marcas permanentes en el cristal, madera en crudo en contacto con líquidos, No sé si volvería a comprar algo de ellos, aunque con este dispensador estamos bastante contentos quitando los defectillos esos.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: La silicona del producto es muy resbalosa.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
He comprado esta funda esperando que tenga buen agarre. El producto menciona "Función especial Antideslizante" pero para mi es todo lo contrario. Esperaba que la silicona sea adherente como la de una funda marca Apple, pero es todo lo contrario.

Este es mi ranking de fundas de la más adherente a la menos adherente (que yo haya probado):

[Silicona "blanda" funda marca Apple > Material de la Spigen Thin fit > TPU regular > Silicona "dura" funda marca kwmobile]

----------------

Pros:

- recorte en los botones de encendido y volumen.
- calza muy bien
- diseño / look
- slim
- precio

Contras:

- la silicona del producto es muy resbalosa e incrementa las probabilidades de que se caiga el teléfono con respecto a otras fundas en el mercado. Por lo tanto esto hace que la funda se vuelva un problema en el día a día. La silicona es mucho menos adherente que el TPU.

Since my wife and I don't keep our vehicle registration and insurance papers in the car all the time we needed something that was easy to handle. The old plastic holder we had was starting to break so my wife was on a mission to find something new. The challenge was finding something small enough to fit in our center console. This one is nicer than the plastic one we had and is small enough to fit. We also needed something slim that wouldn't take up all the space. This one fit that criteria too. One other review included a video showing the measurements which we found to be very helpful, so we did the same. The quality is in between the plastic sleeve we had before and the larger holders out there. Not sure how long it will last, but we think it'll last longer than the old one, which was about 6 years. Of course your mileage may vary. We also liked that it folded so our papers weren't visible if it was left out on the counter. As you can see our registration and insurance fit well, and there's another sleeve for a business card or two. If you need to fit more than that this one probably won't work for you. Our registration was printed on a standard 8 1/2 inch by 11 inch piece of typing paper. We folded it in half and trimmed a little off the bottom so it fit a little better. The only thing we are concerned about is longevity. If you want something small and thin this one will work well.

La quantité et la diversité permet de trouver l'élément adapté en fonction de ce qu'on doit accrocher. Le pot est également pratique pour stocker et ranger les divers tendeurs. Grazie al programma Amazon Vine ho recentemente potuto scegliere il set di 6 portapenne esagonali e devo dire che sono rimasto molto soddisfatto della loro versatilità e funzionalità, un'aggiunta eccellente a qualsiasi stanza della casa, finora avevo la scrivania invasa da portapenne e barattoli usati per lo scopo che raccoglievano pennarelli, penne matite e pennelli, da oggi grazie a questa soluzione di archiviazione personalizzata ho guadagnato spazio prezioso con i mei strumenti da disegno che ora appaiono organizzati in modo pratico.

È vero il prezzo non è proprio economico ma viene giustificato toccando con mano, la qualità dei materiali utilizzati è evidente fin dal primo sguardo. Realizzati in plastica ABS di alta qualità, questi portapenne sono davvero robusti. Temevo vedendoli inclinati che raccogliessero male gli strumenti invece al contrario l'inclinazione rende ben visibile il pennarello che stiamo cercando e lo porge all'utilizzatore facendo guadagnare tempo.

Ciò che rende davvero unico questo set di portapenne inoltre è la sua flessibilità e personalizzabilità. I vasi staccabili possono essere uniti insieme o utilizzati separatamente, interessante anche se non la utilizzerò la possibilità di montare i vasi a parete con i fogli adesivi e le viti incluse.
Naturalmente oltre a essere un ottimo organizzatore per cancelleria e forniture d'ufficio, i vasi possono essere utilizzati per riporre cosmetici, trucchi, pennelli, smalti, rossetti o gioielli ecc. Questo li rende ideali per mantenere ordinati e puliti vari oggetti, contribuendo a creare uno spazio più organizzato e piacevole.
Concludo dicendo che il set portapenne è davvero una scelta intelligente per l'organizzazione dei vostri spazi, buoni i materiali di alta qualità per questo consiglio vivamente a chiunque come me si ritrovi con una scrivania o un tavolo da disegno ingombro da tempo e voglia mettere finalmente un pò di ordine.

I would not pay £27 for this bin. The inside is a simple plastic bin, and the outside is a shroud that isn't actually attached, and has a flip lid that spins on two plastic pins.

There is some deer on the front.

Why exactly this is worth 27 I am not sure, but I do know that bins tend to be very expensive. However for 15 I have a kitchen bin that is full size with a flip lid, and for about 30 I bought a kitchen bin that is also full size but has a push switch that clicks the lid open.

This is considerably less plastic, and less complexity because the lid spins in the middle, and we have a tiny plastic weight underneath to keep it facing the right way around. There's no additional excitement, and in fact in some ways I find it less useful because big things don't fit in properly because of the flip lid, and the inside has to be carefully managed because things can actually fall outside the inside bin, but inside the outside bin.

It does have carry handles on the inside, but not on the outside, so if you lift it to move it around, you will take away the shroud and the bin will be left over!

In conclusion, while there were some issues with the predrilled holes, I'm ultimately very satisfied with the Navaris Cat Hammock Bed/Window Perch. CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Fallo de medidas en la construcción
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Adquirido a través de Amazon Vine, disponible por 20,99€.

No lo he montado sobre pared todavía. Al desembalarlo, me dió una buena primera impresión por el peso y firmeza de materiales. Pero al comenzar a ensamblarlo para hacer las fotografías, me llevé una decepción.

Cuesta mucho encajar las piezas y me temo que ha habido un error en las medidas durante su manufactura. Al montarlo como se indica en las instrucciones, la base, al presionarse para que encaje, incluso se dobla. Se ve en la foto que no llega al final la base al hacer el ángulo de 90° con la parte de atrás. Montarlo por dentro, como indican las instrucciones, pasa esto. Y montándolo por fuera, tampoco encaja bien, incluso peor.

Por otro lado, se puede ver también en la foto que la pieza más fina destinada a sujetar los tarros por la parte superior es demasiado ancha, le sobra como 1-2mm. Por lo que tiene holgura y también se combará cuando la atornille.

Será funcional, pero ha habido un fallo bien de diseño, durante la manufactura y definitivamente de control de calidad. Por ello, al montarlo, no va a quedar todo lo bien que debería y va a costar esfuerzo y posibles modificaciones caseras.

Si estuviera bien hecho, consideraría bien precio los 20€. Pero lo que me ha llegado, considero que no los vale.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Recensione BELLE VOUS Borraccia con Cannuccia e Tracolla - Bottiglia Plastica
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ho ricevuto questo prodotto attraverso il programma Amazon Vine per rilasciare una recensione onesta e imparziale. Il prodotto è arrivato nuovo e intatto, sigillato. La spedizione è stata effettuata a cura di Amazon ed è gratuita se si ha Prime.
Uso questo genere di bottiglie e borracce da vari anni perché cerco di produrre il meno possibile rifiuti in plastica: l'acqua viene giornalmente filtrata in casa con le apposite caraffe e poi aggiunta alla bottiglia da portare in ufficio o in palestra, ecc. Ovviamente non si tratta di un termos vero e proprio, però aiuta a mantenere freschi acqua, succhi con ghiaccio e tisane fredde, the, energy drink, e volendo anche al caldo caffè e tisane, ecc.. Il materiale utilizzato - acciaio - è di ottima qualità e la chiusura tiene molto bene e non lascia uscire il liquido. Si spera sempre che questa caratteristica duri nel tempo. Attenzione: non lavare in lavastoviglie. Si consiglia di lavare la borraccia in acqua calda con una goccia di detergente per piatti neutro. Evitare agenti chimici aggressivi e spazzole.
La bottiglia è molto robuste ed è dotata di diverse varianti di coperchio. Così puoi adattarlo alle tue esigenze individuali.
Puoi usare questa bottiglia per bevande fredde e calde. Tuttavia, io stesso l'ho usato solo per bevande fredde ed è stato assolutamente fantastico lì. Anche quando la temperatura è calda, l'acqua è rimasta fredda per un tempo relativamente lungo e ha un sapore gradevole. Cosa che, come è noto, non si può dire delle bottiglie di plastica.
Allego qualche foto così che possiate vedere ciò che vi arriva dopo l’ordine.
Se nelle prossime settimane dovessi riscontrare delle problematiche degne di nota, sarà mia cura aggiornare la recensione.
Ringrazio il programma Amazon Vine che mi ha offerto in prova questa.

Belle Vous Schwarzer Fahrradständer Boden - Passend für 8-11 cm Breite Fahrradreifen - Tragbarer Fahrradständer Mountainbike & Rennrad - Für den Innen- und Außenbereich, Haus oder Garage

Der Ständer kommt als Bausatz. Alle Teile sind gut verpackt.
Der Zusammenbau ist dann teilweise doch knifflig, weil der Bügel etwas zu sehr gebogen ist. Ein dauerhaftes Korrigieren per Muskelkraft ging nicht. Also muss der Zusammenbau unter etwas Spannung erfolgen, was das saubere Einführen der zweiten Schraube erschwert. Jeder Schrauber weiß aus Erfahrung, dass ein Zusammenbau unter Spannung nie gut ist. Aber gut – es funktionierte letztlich, wobei ein zweites kleines Problem zu lösen war, denn die „cambered gaskets“, die die Anpassung der Bügelenden an die Rundung der Grundstangen machen und laut Bedienungsanleitung vor dem Zusammensetzen auf die Bügelenden geschoben werden sollten, passen nicht drauf. Also müssen diese Gaskets beim Zusammenschrauben zwischen Bügel und Haltestange jongliert werden. Die Schrauben ziehen es dann zusammen.

Beim Anschrauben des kippfähigen Radstabilisators wäre die Verwendung von Unterlegscheiben sicher nicht schlecht gewesen. Vielleicht rüste ich sie noch nach.

Ansonsten funktioniert der Ständer gut. Beim Einstellen des Rades muss aber darauf geachtet werden, dass das Fahrrad sauber in gerader Flucht steht und das Vorderrad wirklich mittig in dem Stabilisator.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
i purchased one of these about a year ago for my front gate to act as an additional security measure for my sons motorbike. a locked gate is always a deterrent!! however the numbers are now wearing off and not easy to read under limited street lights,

So, i opted to buy this pack of two, one to replace the original and one as a spare.
And frankly these are not as good as the original.
Setting up a new combi number was easy but turning the four dials is very difficult, Someone with less than nimble fingers will NOT be able to turn these dials, they are incredibly stiff, even after spraying them with WD40 I, with my strong fingers, am finding them [the combi dials] difficult to twist/rotate
The black paint/coating looks like it will wear and breakdown very quickly quickly making it difficult to read the numbers in night lighting

i get the impression these are either cheap Chinese knock offs or a new manufacturer has been employed to cut costs. either way they are not a patch on the original lock purchased a year ago

very disappointed, if the dials would rotate readily it would not have bothered me so much!!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Ein stilvoller Weggefährte für jede Gelegenheit
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Die Belle Vous Thermoskanne aus Edelstahl ist nicht nur ein Blickfang - das Fassungsvolumen von 800 ml ist ein goldener Mittelweg zwischen Mobilität und ausreichender Flüssigkeitszufuhr für unterwegs. Nach meinem ersten Testeinsatz präsentiert sich die Kanne als ein dichter Begleiter für alle, die Wert auf Stil und Funktion legen.

Diese Thermoskanne sticht sofort ins Auge. Ihr lebhaftes Pink verleiht ihr eine fröhliche Ausstrahlung, die durch das matte Finish noch unterstrichen wird. Die Doppelwandigkeit und Vakuumisolierung halten, was sie versprechen: Getränke bleiben lange heiß oder kalt. Ob für eine heiße Schokolade an einem kalten Wintertag oder ein erfrischendes Wasser nach einem sommerlichen Lauf – die Kanne hält das Versprechen der Temperaturbeständigkeit.

Beim Auspacken fiel mir sofort das integrierte Sieb im Ausguss auf, ein cleveres Detail, das die Kanne vielseitig einsetzbar macht. Loser Tee oder sogar Fruchtinfusionen können ohne zusätzliches Zubehör direkt in der Flasche zubereitet werden. Dieses Feature ist ein echter Mehrwert für Tee-Liebhaber und Freunde der aromatisierten Hydration.

Die Sorge um auslaufende Flüssigkeit in der Tasche ist dank der zuverlässigen Verschlusstechnik unbegründet. Im Test erwies sich die Kanne als auslaufsicher, was Vertrauen in ihre Funktionalität schafft, die sich im weiteren Einsatz bestätigen muss.

Mein Fazit: Die Belle Vous Thermoskanne erhält eine 5-Sterne-Bewertung. Sie vereint Ästhetik mit praktischer Anwendung und innovativen Funktionen. Ihr Fassungsvermögen ist optimal, die Dichtigkeit geprüft, und das eingebaute Sieb eröffnet neue Möglichkeiten des Genusses unterwegs. Ein Must-Have für alle, die im hektischen Alltag nicht auf ihren Lieblingstee verzichten wollen oder einfach nur sicherstellen möchten, dass ihre Getränke zuverlässig die gewünschte Temperatur behalten.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Primer día de uso y el visor deja de funcionar, no se puede reemplazar la batería. ligero goteo
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
El motivo de valorar con 2 estrellas este termo es debido a que el primer día de uso el visor ha dejado de funcionar, y eso implica que la batería no está cien por cien estanca, ¿y si luego contamina el contenido?. Otro motivo es que esta batería no se puede reemplazar. Se lo pregunté al vendedor y él me confirmó que no se podía acceder a la batería.

De acuerdo que luego el termo cumple con su función, pero si el motivo de la compra es que tiene ese visor, y te gusta por ello, pues debes saber que en realidad se trata de una funcionalidad totalmente inútil.

Aclarado este motivo debo indicar que este termo de 280ml, que es el equivalente a una taza de desayuno, funciona correctamente y se mantiene estanco a no ser que le des la vuelta y lo agites enérgicamente, entonces gotea ligeramente.

Tiene una altura de 19 cm y por tanto es compacto para llevar en tu mochila y bolso de uso diario, pero vigila que siempre vaya en posición vertical. La boca tiene un diámetro de 4cm y por tanto permite beber directamente del termo sin necesidad de usar un vaso o taza. La base es de goma, lo que facilita su estabilidad.

En cuanto al precio, 14,49€ en el momento de esta reseña, me parece elevado ya que el termo ha demostrado que no cumple con un mínimo de calidad de fabricación.
No puedo recomendar su compra, pero la decisión es tuya.
Espero que la reseña os haya resultado útil.

La cover è esteticamente molto bella, tuttavia presenta alcune funzionalità non correttamente implementate.

Nella descrizione si specifica la presenza delle funzioni "Wake up" e "Sleep", che però non funzionano correttamente.

Attivando la funzione di sleep-mode sul dispositivo, il display rimane acceso quando si chiude la cover e in standby quando la si apre da standby, in sostanza non fa quello che dovrebbe.

Per attivare/disattivare lo schermo è necessario premere ogni volta il tasto di accensione posto sul retro del dispositivo, rendendo l'utilizzo scomodo.

Ho contattato l'assistenza KW Mobile per risolvere il problema, ma l'unica soluzione proposta è stata la restituzione del prodotto, che ho dovuto effettuare.

È un peccato, perché la cover si presentava davvero bene.

Un'ulteriore pecca è il materiale del case nero, realizzato in plastica dura anziché in morbido TPU.

Essendo a diretto contatto con il Kobo, temo che nel tempo possa usurare la scocca del dispositivo.

In definitiva, la cover non è consigliata a causa delle funzionalità non funzionanti e del materiale del case non ottimale.

Spero che questa recensione sia stata utile.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Nice thickness! Comfy! Didn’t shed or get matted when washed!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I absolutely LOVE this!

This comes in a nice product box.

This is an oversized hoodie (a blanket hoodie), so it’s BIG. Depending on your size will depend on how big. I am 5’9 and average weight for my height. It fits me nicely where it’s big but comfy. It’s supposed to be big and oversized to give the effect of a blanket, but also wear like a hoodie with the arms. It’s soft and really comfortable. The hood fits nicely where it’s big and covers my whole head but my head isn’t drowning in it!

I’ve gotten quite a few different wearable hoodies like this. A lot of them are similar with thickness, look, and seem sewn together well. But I’ve gotten a few that either were extremely thin and/or the stitching didn’t seem too great. I’m happy to say this is one of the good one - nice thickness to keep me warm. I got this during the winter. I sit outsides some mornings and nights and can wear this outside in the winter with a regular sweater underneath and I’m nice and cozy. There’s a nice big pocket on the front that opens on each side.

I’ve washed it and it didn’t shed or get matted at all, so I’m happy about that!

Overall, I’m extremely happy with this! It’s comfy and warm. It’s cute! It feels like nice, durable quality. There isn’t a bad thing to say about this! I definitely recommend it!

This recipe book stand is brilliant. I had to return another one I'd ordered because it wouldn't stand up, it wasn't adjustable and the page holders were useless. It was a shane because it was a beautiful cast iron one and when I ordered this, I did so reluctantly because it doesn't have that rustic quality. However, I needn't have worried. It looks far nicer in the kitchen than the pictures give it credit for, it's fully adjustable and is secure and the page holders are firm and secure. You can put any size book on it, hardback or paperback and the page holders actually do their job and can be moved around. The end of each one has a fixed silicone cover so you can't rip your pages either. You could put a phone or tablet on it too, although I bought this because I got fed up of using my phone because the screen kept turning off. The longest I can set my phone screen on for without switching off is 10 mins (Samsung S22 ultra), which I understand is for security reasons, but if I'm in my house cooking, it's not like I'm going to lose it or have it stolen is it? A set of five graded Polishing Compound Blocks.
Here are the grades which are on the Amazon web site if you look for them.

-Red Rogue block grit: 500.
-Emery black block grit: 800.
-All-Purpose blue block grit: 1500.
-White diamond block grit: 2000.
-General green block grit: 2500.

If none of this makes any sense you probably don't need them!
I tried them on a leather stropping wheel and they finished off my chisel sharpening very well.
The blue general block was all I needed for the well looked after chisels.
I gave the red (500 coarse) a go at taking marks off the chisels and it cleaned them up with little scratching at this grade.
In a perfect world you start with red and work your way to green through the graded colours.
These are an excellent starting set at a good price.
You can get very specialised on polishing pastes and blocks.
These should suit most people who are general users.

**Geruchsneutral und robust: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**

Das Produkt hat mich positiv überrascht, da es vollkommen geruchsneutral ist und eine außerordentliche Stabilität aufweist. Die Möglichkeit, es in drei verschiedenen Neigungswinkeln einzustellen, macht es äußerst vielseitig und anpassungsfähig.

**Fußmassage und Komfort: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**

Besonders hervorzuheben sind die Fußmassagerollen, die eine entspannende Massage bieten, insbesondere wenn das Produkt schuhlos verwendet wird. Dadurch fühlt sich die Nutzung angenehmer an. Dies macht das Produkt weniger geeignet für den Einsatz im Büro, aber umso mehr für den persönlichen Gebrauch zu Hause oder im Homeoffice.

**Angemessener Preis und langlebige Konstruktion: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**

Der Preis von 24€ erscheint mir angemessen für die gebotene Qualität und Funktionalität. Selbst unter Druck verformt sich das Plastik nicht, was die Langlebigkeit des Produkts unterstreicht.

**Fazit: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**

Insgesamt bin ich äußerst zufrieden mit diesem Produkt. Es überzeugt durch seine Geruchsneutralität, Robustheit und vielseitige Neigungseinstellung. The water did seem to run off the material and not soak through and you could not feel any from the inside. Having said this, the spray we did was more like a light rain would be. Expectations of it being waterproof in a heavy downpour would be very low.
Our son has used the sleeping bag whilst camping with friends and he said he found if extremely comfortable and warm.
As for the price, yes it is a bit more expensive than some on the market, but for the warmth and comfort of it, we feel it is worth the price.

My boyfriend and I moved 1,000 miles again from Oregon back to CA. We used a large POD for most of our stuff (I thought the largest size wud be about 5 feet longer than it is), & we still left a lot of stuff back at our old house.

So he went back up to take as much as he could in his car. (Not impressed with size of the POD, as well as being lifted up & down so much that everything shifted a lot & all our stuff got dinged, scratched, stained, etc.) So I started looking for a rooftop carrier, & I was seriously frightened at the lack of quality control or testing, that pretty much every single product review was terrible! Dangerous in a lot of cases where they ripped, leaked water in, & flew off their rooftops while driving. I had almost given up on finding any good quality carrier & that it wasn’t worth the risk of an accident.

At the last few hrs of the day before he’d have to receive it & pack up, I deduced that the bright green & black Rhino one was the best and pretty much only choice. I was really nervous about something dangerous happening, but my boyfriend said it was really good quality & he updated me that it was working great as he drove back down.

No issues at all, & we got the most of the rest of our stuff he could fit. We still had to donate, sell, drop off at a sorting facility, & put on the curb. So I was really glad we could keep more things I needed & didn’t want to have to replace. Moving after 8 years is crazy & I’m still replacing things we had to leave behind, but this carrier is the best & worked great!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Finiture non al top, ma l’anti appannamento funziona quindi comunque promosso
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Il prodotto da subito non mi ha fatto una grande impressione, un pó perchè il packaging lascia un pó il tempo che trova, non è altro che una bustina in plastica, un pó perchè arrivano senza pellicole di protezione del policarbonato che fa da lente protettiva.

Nonostante tutto però il prodotto è arrivato senza particolari problemi, parti difettose o graffi sulla lente.

Il prodotto ha finiture non eccezionali, la parte che aderisce alla pelle è formata da un sottile strato di materiale trasparente gommoso che tende a cedere, così facendo riesce a conferire una buona comodità al prodotto una volta indossato anche per diverso tempo.

La parte antifog è demandata a delle prese d’aria nere poste nelle estremità superiori ed inferiori dell’occhiale, guardandola appena scartata non mi dava molta fiducia, ma anche qui poi utilizzandola devo dire che fa il suo lavoro rendendo veramente difficile che l’occhiale si appanni.

A livello di resa ottica devo dire nulla da segnalare, non ho rilevato alterazioni della vista anche indossandoli per diverso tempo.

La maschera trall’altro lascia anche diverso spazio vuoto intorno agli occhi di modo da permettere di indossare degli occhiali sotto di essa, almeno nel mio caso che utilizzo degli occhiali da lettura abbastanza piccoli.

In conclusione mi sento di consigliare il prodotto soprattutto per le sue capacità antiappannanti, avrei migliorato le finiture e le cuciture come si vede dal video, ma diciamo che le cose importanti ci sono e funzionano bene, trall’altro ad un prezzo adeguato considerato che la confezione comprende due maschere.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Bungee Bonanza: Belle Vous Cord Assortment Review
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Let's face it, bungee cords are the ultimate handy helpers around the house, garage, or even on outdoor adventures. And this 30-piece set from Belle Vous has me saying "bungee brilliant!" Here's why:

Variety is the Spice of Life (and Securing Cargo): With 30 cords in various sizes (ranging from 18 to 75 inches), you've got a bungee for pretty much any task. Securing a tarp on a camping trip? No problem. Bungee-ing down luggage on your bike rack? Easy peasy. Even keeping the shed door shut on a windy day? These cords have got you covered.

Quality Counts: They seem well-made, with strong hooks and stretchy cords that hold their tension well. Plus, they come in a handy storage container, which is great for keeping them organized (although I personally prefer hanging mine on a magnetic tool holder for quick access – each to their own!).

Satisfaction Guaranteed: The fact that they come with a money-back guarantee if you're not happy is a nice touch. It shows that the company is confident in their product, and it gives you peace of mind when trying them out.

Things to Consider:

Storage: While the container is handy, some might prefer alternative storage methods like hanging them up.
Specific Needs: If you have very specific bungee needs, you might want to consider buying individual cords in the exact sizes you require.
Overall:

This Belle Vous bungee cord assortment is a great buy for anyone who likes to be prepared. The variety of sizes, good quality, and satisfaction guarantee make it a solid choice. So, whether you're a seasoned outdoorsman or just someone who likes to keep a few bungees around for everyday tasks, this set is definitely worth considering. Just remember, you can never have too many bungee cords!

🪵Son vasos de bambú barnizado. CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Great Concept with Room for Tweaks
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Pros:
- The 15-degree angle of the board itself is ideal.
- The overall width of the board accommodates various stances and provides excellent stability.
- The material of the board is extremely durable and sufficient for doing loaded squats

Cons:
- The foot positioning angles need refinement. The provided options (15, 30, and 40 degrees) are a fantastic idea but don't allow for the natural variance in squat stances. I often find myself awkwardly positioned between two settings to achieve a more comfortable squat stance.
- Incremental adjustments would vastly improve this product's versatility and effectiveness.

In summary, I love the concept of this squat wedge block, particularly the sturdy build and 15-degree angle, which feels perfect for my workouts. However, four stars because the limited increments in foot angle positions could be better optimized to accommodate personal squat preferences. With some enhancements to the angle options, this could easily become a five-star piece of equipment.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Fits Gaggia portafilter as well as others
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I love the wood color, it’s heavy enough that it will not slide when tamping. However, since it is designed to fit any 58mm portafilter, the cut out at the end is deep enough to accept portafilters with thicker handles. My standard Gaggia has a thick black handle but is thinner steel where it meets the basket. This means MY portafilter would sit in it and angle down. It would still work: when you tamp, the handle would tilt up to level as you hold the handle.
But I decided to cut a piece of sticky back felt (for bottoms of table legs not to scratch floors) and then stuck a black sticky grommet dot on that too and then my portafilter is perfectly flat (and no one sees the grommet). See my picture.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Portapapeles versátil perfecto para ciertas profesiones
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Producto llegado a casa en perfecto estado. Una solución estupenda para poder transportar los papeles de un lado a otro y poder escribir sin necesidad de buscar una mesa para poner las hojas. Mi trabajo me obliga a tener que llevar papeles en la mano muchas veces, y escribir algo mientras voy caminando o no tengo una mesa cerca es agotador.

Llevaba tiempo en busca de un producto como este y lo mejor es que son un total de 6 portapapeles. Gracias a esto, puedo tener alguno en casa y otros en el trabajo.

Son muy elegantes, transparentes. Están hechos de plástico. He de decir que se siente bien en la mano, es un plástico brillante que es un poco elástico pero lo suficientemente robusto para poder escribir sin que se doble. Por tanto, cero problemas. Habrá que ver el resultado que dará en el futuro este plástico, ya que tiene pinta de que se raya con facilidad.

Las hojas se sujetan muy bien en el gancho superior, de color plata. En las fotos se ve que ese enganche tiene dos protectores negros. Pensé que serían de goma, pero son de plástico. Sin embargo, estoy contento con ello porque al quitar los papeles, no deja ninguna marca.

En cuanto a las medidas del portapapeles, son las siguientes: 22,6 cm de ancho y 32,3 cm de alto, y un grosor de unos 2-3 mm. A la izquierda aparecen los centímetros como si de una regla se tratara, y al lado derecho lo mismo pero en pulgadas (inch.). Como curiosidad que me ha encantado, tiene un gancho por detrás que se levanta y me permite colgarlo en un lugar cualquiera, como en la pared.

Para terminar, tengo que decir que use durante muchos años un portapapeles de este estilo cuando era pequeño para hacer los deberes, por lo que aparte del uso en el trabajo, también puede resultar útil para los peques de la casa.
Bien

Overall, these racks are a really awesome, inexpensive solution to a lack of storage in a shower, or even a cabinet.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Unreliable suction, but remember, it is suction cups as apposed to screw fixed
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
The handles are well made, appear to be strong, are easy to install, and are great if you live in a rented accommodation as no drilling is required for installation.

But the frustrating thing is that the suction is unreliable; in some instances, it has supported me in climbing in and out of the bath and prevented me from slipping; other times, it has come away from the wall. Therefore, I would advise installing both handles closely together; that way, if one fails, you have the option to grab the other and hope that it stays attached to the wall.

I would advise regularly removing the handles for cleaning, but removing and reinstalling also allows for a new vacuum to be created to hopefully strengthen the hold of the handles to the wall.

For the cost, I think they are okay, but ensure that you understand that the handles aren't going to be as good or as strong as the ones you drill into the walls.

Yet again Amazon packaging has surpassed itself...... this 6mm MDF drawing board arrived in a box more than twice the size of the object. It arrived in a 5foot box with about 2 feet of the usual brown paper packaging you always get in Amazon packaging. The problem with that is the drawing board must have been tossed and bounced around inside the huge box and bashed all the edges of the drawing board, fortunately not on the left hand side of the board so a T square can still be used on it, should I keep it?
Okay the board itself well its 66 x 59 cm so big enough for an A2 drawing, it's made from 6mm MDF so nice flat surface, devoid of any grain or anything to form lumps in your drawings and its lightweight. It has two metal lift clamps that lock your paper securely into place on one side and a really big elastic band to secure the bottom of your paper and it has a carrying handle.
Okay problems apart from the packaging and getting damaged.... it is unfinished and the edges are razor sharp, I ended up slicing my thumb open on the handle when opening the packaging when it arrived. I have since gone round all the edges with a bit of sandpaper and removed the sharp edges.
Okay is it worth the price?...... being a joiner I realise I could buy a 2400x1200mm sheet for half the price of this, but its convenience I reckon if it was £15 then yeh I think it would be worth it, but £20.99 and its unfinished edges, sharp and the risk of soft kids hands being sliced open then no I think its dangerous and needs attention being drawn to these problems
Okay my dilemma will I keep it, I don't think so, £21 and all the issues mentioned I think not

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Sono 12 BARATTOLI che ricordano il vetro, ma sono completamente in PLASTICA PET, sia il tappo che il barattolo, sono privi di BPA, quindi non tossici.

Sono inodore, ma li sconsiglio per riporre liquidi o alimenti oleosi, che possono macchiare la superficie trasparente e lasciare un odore persistente. Difatti li stiamo utilizzando per cibi secchi, come frutta secca, pasta, riso, legumi, biscotti e caramelle.

Essendo TRASPARENTI lasciano intravedere il contenuto e grazie alle 12 ETICHETTE NERE e al PENNARELLO BIANCO, ci siamo divertiti a scrivere i nomi del contenuto, così da poterli riutilizzare sempre per lo stesso alimento.

FACILI DA PULIRE A MANO, ma va evitata la lavastoviglie.

Ogni BARATTOLO ha una capacità di 500 ml, sono bellissimi da vedere quando tutti insieme, perché i cibi all'interno creano un muro di colori.

I COPERCHI sono ermetici, non ho notato perdite e conservano bene la freschezza del contenuto.

Un paio li ho utilizzati per la mia collezione di mattoncini colorati, per un effetto multicolor.

Y es más: he iniciado el proceso de devolución. Así, sin mas contemplaciones.

Creo que el truco no está en la forma del desatascador, a simple vista idéntico a otros del chino, sino en el diseño interno del acordeón de la campana. Otra cosa no se me ocurre.
En fin, perfecto para lo que yo necesitaba.

Vor einigen Monaten habe ich einen ähnlichen Glasbehälter testen dürfen. Ich fand die Form so süß, dass ich unbedingt dieses 3er Set von BELLE VOUS bestellen musste. Es kam sehr gut und in Styropor verpackt an, sodass es in einem einwandfreien Zustand war. Die Bambusdeckel schließen dich, da sie einen Gummiring haben. Man sollte sich im Klaren sein, dass sie nicht zur längeren Aufbewahrung von Flüssigkeiten geeignet sind. Schließlich handelt es sich bei den Deckeln um Bambus, sprich Holz.

Dafür sehen sie wirklich bezaubernd, dekorativ und nostalgisch aus. Hierin lassen sich sehr gut trockene Dinge, sei es Lebensmittel, Kleinigkeiten, die sonst verstreut herumliegen, Bastelsachen, etc. gut verstauen. Auf den Deckeln sind kleine Ringe befestigt, die eher einen dekorativen Charakter haben als zum Transport von A nach B, vor allem wenn sie mit schweren Dingen gefüllt sind. Man riskiert, dass der Deckel sich dann beim Tragen des Rings löst. Ich hingegen, bewahre gerne und gerade in der Weihnachtszeit meine Plätzchen darin. So bleiben sie frisch, sind Staub geschützt und sehen total chic aus. Was mir ebenfalls sehr gut gefällt ist, dass sich die Rillen im Innern des Glases befinden und nicht außerhalb. Auf diese Weise lassen sie sich besser reinigen.

Wünschenswert wäre, dass sich entweder alle 3 Gläser gleichen oder jedes Glas eine andere Form hat.

Ich habe kürzlich ein 2-stöckiges Organizer-Set für unter den Spülenbereich gekauft, um endlich Ordnung in die Küchenschränke und -regale zu bringen. Die Maße von B18,5 x L37,5 x H38 cm und die Tragfähigkeit von 3 kg pro Etage schienen perfekt, um meine Putzmittel und andere Utensilien übersichtlich und zugänglich zu verstauen.

Die Organisatoren sind aus langlebigem PP-Kunststoff und Edelstahl gefertigt, was sie nicht nur robust und verschleißfest macht, sondern auch rostfrei, wasserdicht und leicht zu reinigen. Dank der rutschfesten Pads am Boden haben sie einen sicheren Stand, was mir zusätzliches Vertrauen in das Produkt gibt.

Besonders beeindruckt war ich von der schnellen und einfachen Montage, die mit der beiliegenden Anleitung ein Kinderspiel war. Ich habe einen der Organisatoren unter dem Waschbecken in der Küche und den anderen im Bad platziert, aber ich kann mir vorstellen, dass sie auch in der Speisekammer, im Büro oder anderen engen Räumen nützlich wären. Die ausziehbaren Schubladen sind ein Highlight, da sie den Zugriff auf die gespeicherten Artikel erleichtern.

Diese Organisatoren sind wahrhaftig vielseitig einsetzbar. Ich nutze sie, um eine Vielzahl von Gegenständen zu verstauen, von Gewürzflaschen und Dosen in der Küche bis hin zu Toilettenartikeln und Reinigungsmitteln im Bad. Die Netzschubladen bieten nicht nur ausreichend Stauraum, sondern ermöglichen auch eine gute Übersicht über die gelagerten Artikel.

Die Geld-zurück-Garantie gab mir zusätzliche Sicherheit beim Kauf, aber ich muss sagen, dass ich vollkommen zufrieden bin. Die Qualität, Funktionalität und das Design der Organisatoren haben meine Erwartungen übertroffen. Sie haben nicht nur für Ordnung gesorgt, sondern auch das Aussehen meiner Schränke verbessert. Ich würde dieses Organizer-Set jedem empfehlen, der seinen Unter-Spülenbereich oder andere kleine Räume effizient und stilvoll organisieren möchte.

Update:
Kleines Problem tritt auf wenn man die NodeMCU bei Batteriebetrieb (ohne USB-Verbindung) in den "deepsleep"-Modus schickt. Dann leuchtet während des Deepsleep die OnBoard-LED dauerhaft und verbraucht somit zusätzlich Strom.

Da die LED an GPIO 01 (TxD) sitzt, lässt sie sich auch nicht einfach abschalten (jedenfalls ist es mir mit Micropython nicht sinnvoll gelungen).

Mit

led = Pin(1,Pin.OUT)
led.on()
...
led.init(Pin.OUT, pull=Pin.PULL_HOLD)
esp32.gpio_deep_sleep_hold(1))
deepsleep(time)

bleibt zwar die LED aus, verhindert aber auch zuverlässig ein Aufwachen/Reboot aus dem Deepsleep-Modus... Außerdem verhindern bereits die ersten Zeilen die Kommunikation über die UART-Schnittstelle (keine Ein-/Ausgabe mehr über REPL).

In meinem Anwendungsfall kann ich aber mit den 18mA im deepsleep leben...

I got this on the off chance it might be useful. My intended use is dog walking in spring/summer as usually Im carrying a backpack for the dog/my water bottles, which results in a sweaty back. The idea of having this on the waist instead appeals a great deal especially as I already use a dog pouch on a belt for treats so can combine.
I also attach my dog lead to the belt to walk hands free, so the lead would be attached to this new belt too.

Overall construction is very good, feels solid with good stiching. The belts nice and wide so wont dig in if theres weight on it.
Theres a number of small zip pockets, which will be useful for odds/ends
The belt itself is elasticated so has a nice bit of give in it, which is great so it wont end up rubbing the hips like my current one can. The plastic buckle, usually a weak point, is nice and thick, seems quite stong so Im not worried about it popping open. This might change over time as the plastic gets worn but that can happen to all well used plastic buckles (and why I generally dont like them).
The belt itself is also adjustable.

The waterbottles are an odd size and really the only ones you can use with the belt, if you tried to replace with bigger ones they would either topple out or not fit at all. Theres little cords that just about reach the spouts of these to keep them in place (so no chance of losing them). They sit nicely on the hips so will be one for me and one for my dog.

Overally Im far more impressed with this than I thought I'd be. For my intended use, warm day dog walking, this is ideal and looking forward to using it. I fully expect it would be useful for anyone out walking that needs to take water and prefers not to use back packs for it.

Inoltre, le aperture per gli ingressi e gli altoparlanti non sono ben allineate, rendendo difficile l'accesso a connettori e pulsanti. Questo compromette l'ergonomia e crea fastidi quando cerco di caricare il telefono o utilizzare le cuffie.

Infine, la custodia sembra trattenere sporco e polvere, rendendo necessaria una pulizia frequente. Nel complesso, questa custodia si è dimostrata una scelta poco soddisfacente, offrendo una protezione scadente e compromettendo l'esperienza d'uso generale del mio iPhone.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Ein Solides Unterhemd für Aktive Männer
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
🌟🌟🌟🌟

Als jemand, der regelmäßig Sport treibt und Wert auf Qualität legt, habe ich mich für das TCA Herren HyperFusion Kompressions-Baselayer Unterhemd entschieden, um meine Trainingseinheiten zu unterstützen. Hier ist meine ehrliche Bewertung:

Passform und Komfort:

Die Kompressionspassform dieses Unterhemdes ist wirklich bemerkenswert. Es bietet eine unterstützende Passform, die meine Muskeln während des Trainings stützt, ohne einzuengen. Das Material ist angenehm auf der Haut und fühlt sich leicht an, was besonders während intensiver Workouts wichtig ist. Die Größenempfehlung für mich war genau richtig, und ich finde, dass die Passform wirklich gut zu meinem Körperbau passt.

Material und Atmungsaktivität:

Das Material besteht aus 88% Polyester und 12% Elasthan, was eine gute Mischung für sportliche Aktivitäten ist. Die Flachnähte verhindern Hautirritationen, was für mich ein großer Pluspunkt ist, da ich oft Probleme mit Scheuerstellen habe. Die 3DAirMesh-Panels sorgen für eine ausgezeichnete Belüftung, besonders in den Bereichen, die während des Trainings stark beansprucht werden. Ich habe festgestellt, dass das Unterhemd meine Körpertemperatur gut reguliert und mich auch bei anstrengenden Workouts angenehm kühl hält.

Leistung und Haltbarkeit:

In Bezug auf die Leistung hat mich dieses Unterhemd nicht enttäuscht. Ich fühle mich energiegeladen und unterstützt, während ich es trage, und habe das Gefühl, dass es mir hilft, meine Ausdauer während des Trainings zu verbessern. Die Qualität des Materials und die solide Verarbeitung lassen auch auf eine lange Haltbarkeit schließen, was für mich als aktiver Sportler wichtig ist.

Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis:

Der Preis für dieses Unterhemd ist meiner Meinung nach fair, besonders wenn man die Qualität und Leistung berücksichtigt, die man dafür erhält. Die TCA Qualitätsgarantie und das großzügige 365-Tage-Rückgaberecht bieten zusätzliche Sicherheit und machen den Kauf für mich noch attraktiver.

Insgesamt bin ich mit dem TCA Herren HyperFusion Kompressions-Baselayer Unterhemd sehr zufrieden und kann es anderen aktiven Männern wärmstens empfehlen. Es ist ein solides Produkt, das seinen Zweck erfüllt und gleichzeitig Komfort und Leistung bietet.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: One bottle does BOTH brand name Podcoffee and espresso machines
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Use every 90 days or so for both my brand name K-cup machine and small Espresso (original line) machines - split one descaler bottle about 3/5 to 2/5, respectively. Run through Brew cycle once or twice then walk away for a while and go back to finish the “brew” cycles with descaler water that’s still sitting in water tanks, rinse both receptacles then fill with clear water and run through both machines several times to get the solution totally flushed through the systems on each machine. Wash the water receptacles with washing soda or baking soda mixed with water (skip the vinegar or soap!) and wipe dry on the insides of water receptacles with paper towel - gets the teeny crud off inside of your water receptacle. Fill with fresh water and good to go! This stiff rocks! ☕️

The required sizes listed in this product size are correct; you cannot 'hack' this to work with larger handles.

This feels like high density plastic and is sturdy. Simply undo the plastic clip, wrap this around a weight, and tighten the clip. This takes a bit of force with a 1.25 inch handle. I appreciate that, however, because the weight is very securely held. I have zero concerns about the handle giving out and the weight falling. Considering we'll use this with adjustable weights, we'll clamp this on once and never take it off again.

Overall I like this and will probably pick up a second one. If anything goes wrong, I'll update this review.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: TOURTURE/PILLOW FROM HELL - do NOT buy!!!!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: This pillow caused clinical chronic insomnia to the degree that it damaged my health really badly. It is the most uncomfortable pillow ever and God knows how it has got the positive reviews that it has. Furthermore, it doesn’t even work because the space in the middle for your head is too big, so it’s completely pointless. It will age you by 20 years from sleep deprivation and the chronic stress that insomnia causes. I hope this pillow burns in hell. Seriously. It’s true what they say - but cheap buy twice. This is a cheap version of ‘The Aula’ by ‘Sleep and Glow’, which is £180. If you care about your mental and physical health, don’t worry about sleep wrinkles and just get your sleep or wait until you can get the Aula by sleep and glow. I now have the Aula and it works, the space between the bolsters is just right so it’s impossible for either side of your face to turn and fall smooshed in the pillow and the bolsters are nice and high. It also has a removable piece to make it higher if needed. This YourFace pillow is also too low. Furthermore it caused me to develop severe sleep apnea: on the rare occasion that I feel asleep for maybe 2 or 3 hours due to exhaustion I couldn’t breathe bc the design of the pillow stopped me breathing properly. I never ever snore when I sleep but my sleep tracker showed I was not only snoring but I wasn’t breathing for up to 30s multiple times, so even though I may have fallen asleep for a couple of hours, it wasn’t even deep sleep. I was so happy and well before I bought this pillow. Now I am trying to recover from the illness it caused to my physical and mental health. Please do NOT buy this pillow. Like I said, wait until you can get The Aula by Sleep and Glow. I hope this helps to prevent someone from going through the sheer hell I have been through all because of this pillow from hell.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Sofa Caddy, der mit Sprungfedern an der Sofalehne festgeklemmt wird ✅ ✅ ✅
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Als Vine-Club-Tester bewerte ich die Produkte, die ich testen darf, nach bestem Wissen und Gewissen ✅
Ich vergebe 1-5 Sterne und begründe auch warum 🙂 Ich bin vollkommen frei in meiner Bewertung und versuche mit meinen Bewertungen anderen Käufern zu helfen ☺️

➕ Das Positive:
- Der Sofa Candy kommt sehr gut verpackt an.
- Man bekommt den Caddy, die Halterung fürs Handy inkl. Schraube und 2 Moosgummiteile in Form der beiden Seitenteile des Caddys.
- Die Seitenteile werden mit Sprungfedern nach innern gezogen. Damit passt sich der Caddy an verschiedene Lehnenbreiten an.
- Durch das Moosgummi rutschen die Seitenteile nicht so schnell vom Stoff weg. Der Caddy hält sicherer.
- Das Tablett oben ist groß genug, dass man Glas und kleinen Teller abstellen kann.
- Das Holz ist schön wertig, gleichmäßig und sauber gearbeitet. Keine rauen Stellen oder gar welche, mit denen die Couchlehnen zerkratzt werden könnte.
- Die Handyhalterung ist eine schöne Ergänzung.

➖ Das Negative:
- Das mitgelieferte Moosgummi muss man selbst aufkleben. Ich habe mein Bestes versucht. Aber nachdem ja die Sprungfeder das Seitenteil ranzieht, hat man leider nicht beide Hände für das Aufkleben frei. Deswegen wurde es auf beiden Seiten leicht schief. Ich musste das überstehende Moosgummi mit einer Nagelschere an mehreren Stellen wegschneiden.
- Was ich auch etwas schwierig finde: Die Holzoberfläche ist schön glatt. Optisch toll, aber für den Grip für mein Glas oder auch den Teller würde ich mir schon eine gummierte oder rauere Beschichtung wünschen.

FAZIT:
Eine tolle Idee, die aber noch etwas optimiert werden könnte. Das Moosgummi sollte schon angebracht sein. Die Oberfläche des Tabletts könnte eine leichte Beschichtung haben. Deswegen 1 Stern Abzug. Aber an sich funktioniert der Caddy sehr gut.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Morbido e simpatico tappeto quadrato, versatile, non impermeabile, lavabile, antiscivolo
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ho deciso di testare questo modello di tappeto per la mia nipotina. L’ho scelto per le dimensioni, la morbidezza e la funzionalità.
La mia nipotina non è una neonata, quindi, non lo usa per gattonare ma per sdraiarsi o sedersi sopra.
Il tappeto è contenuto in una robusta busta in plastica aperta, non personalizzata, piegato ma non sottovuoto. Il packaging è essenziale; andrebbe migliorato per renderlo adatto come confezione regalo. All’interno troviamo un cartoncino informativo utile.
Il tappeto è fabbricato in Cina per conto della marca tedesca Luka&Lily.
Ha un prezzo piuttosto alto; a fine gennaio 2024 è di € 39,99.
Il tappeto ha una forma quadrata con lato di 100 cm e spessore di 1,5 cm.
Ha un design originale, raffigurante simpatiche forme arcuate ad arcobaleno su sfondo grigio. I colori sono spenti.
Ha una struttura a doppia faccia: la base inferiore, anch’essa a tinta unita grigia è ricoperta da puntini in silicone in rilievo che rende la superficie antiscivolo, garantendo maggiore aderenza durante l'uso e proteggendo da movimenti bruschi che potrebbero provocare cadute.
Ha un peso leggero che, unito alla possibilità di piegarlo, favorisce il trasporto da una stanza all’altra.
Da piegato, inoltre, occupa poco spazio e può essere facilmente riposto col minimo ingombro, anche sottovuoto.
È realizzato in 100% poliestere, traspirante, con morbida imbottitura anch’essa in poliestere, in grado di attutire i rumori, di proteggere i piedi e il corpo dei bambini dal pavimento umido o freddo. Al tatto il tessuto è liscio con un’adeguata consistenza che garantisce una durata nel tempo e una certa resistenza a strappi e sollecitazioni. Grazie alla base antiscivolo è adatto per camminarci sopra, per gattonare, per stare comodamente seduti o come scendiletto.
Lungo il perimetro è dotato di un bordino di rinforzo grigio.
Non è impermeabile, quindi, prestare attenzione in caso di versamento di liquidi sopra, per evitare di macchiarlo.
Si lava facilmente in lavatrice a basse/medie temperature (consigliato a 40°); si può mettere in asciugatrice o far asciugare all’aria. Non candeggiare. Si può stirare con ferro tiepido.
Per i neonati può essere usato come sfondo per foto.
La mia nipotina lo utilizza stando seduta a gambe incrociate per leggere, per guardare la TV o per ascoltare storie.
4 ⭐Sono soddisfatta di questo tappeto per le dimensioni, la qualità dei materiali e la versatilità. Ne consiglio l'acquisto. Rappresenta una simpatica e utile idea regalo.

Quiero compartir mi experiencia con la botella de agua BELLE VOUS. En general, estoy bastante satisfecho con este producto.

Empecemos con los puntos positivos. Me encanta el diseño de la botella. El color rosa es muy bonito y le da un toque femenino y elegante. Además, la capacidad de 380 ml es perfecta para llevarla al gimnasio o a la oficina.

La tapa antigoteo es genial. Me asegura que no se va a derramar agua en mi bolso o mochila, lo cual es muy conveniente. Y la pajita es muy práctica, ya que puedo beber sin tener que abrir la tapa constantemente.

La correa que trae la botella es muy útil. Me permite llevarla colgada de la muñeca o engancharla en mi mochila, lo cual es muy cómodo cuando tengo las manos ocupadas.

Ahora, pasemos a los puntos negativos. En ocasiones, la tapa puede ser un poco difícil de abrir y cerrar. A veces tengo que hacer un poco de fuerza para asegurarme de que está bien cerrada y no vaya a derramar líquido.

Además, me gustaría que la botella fuera un poco más grande. A veces siento que la capacidad de 380 ml se queda corta, especialmente cuando estoy haciendo ejercicio intenso y necesito beber más agua.

En resumen, la botella de agua BELLE VOUS es un producto de buena calidad y con un diseño atractivo. Aunque tiene algunos pequeños inconvenientes, estoy contenta con mi compra y la recomendaría a otras personas.

¡Gracias por leer mi valoración! 😊

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: I toast non sono buoni come quelli del tostapane. Il pane resta un poco molle. Prezzo troppo alto.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Questa è una griglia realizzata appositamente per i forni a microonde e pertanto non contiene metallo ma solamente silicone. Il concetto è semplice, c'è un pezzo inferiore ed uno superiore. Si inserisce all'interno il toast e si tiene due minuti nel forno selezionando il wattaggio più indicato. A questo punto si gira e si fa rimanere in forno altri due minuti. Il toast è pronto.

Sembra tutto molto facile e veloce, non è vero? I risultati, però, non sono proprio tra i migliori. Innanzitutto i forni a microonde sono tutti diversi, hanno una potenza massima (espressa in watt) diversa tra loro ed i valori intermedi possono essere il più delle volte molto ma molto diversi tra loro. Non c'è inoltre una vera e propria indicazione su come partire quindi diciamo che i primi toast saranno più delle prove per capire per il vostro forno quale sarà la regolazione migliore da utilizzare.

Ho fatto diverse prove ed alcuni sono venuti anche buoni. Il problema è l'esistenza in casa mia di un comunissimo forno oltre che di un tostapane ed una toastiera. Questa griglia da microonde, come risultato per quanto riguarda il cibo, si classifica secondo me all'ultimo posto tra i miei accessori. Il pane non viene fuori bello croccante nonostante una doratura ed i segni della griglia siano evidenti ed i risultati variano molto in base al tipo di pane utilizzato ed alla marca. Se non avete altro in casa non è una soluzione da escludere per realizzare i toast ma vedendo il prezzo, attualmente 27 euro, mi chiedo perché dovremmo preferire investire così il nostro denaro invece di spendere 30-35 euro per una piccola piastra elettrica che dà risultati di gran lunga superiori.

Essendo realizzata completamente in silicone questa griglia si lava davvero facilmente, e questo è forse l'unico grande pregio. Per me il prezzo non dovrebbe arrivare neanche a 20 euro, quindi siamo abbastanza distanti, ed anche se costasse poco resta comunque il fatto che è vero che è molto semplice da utilizzare e non ingombra troppo spazio ma che i risultati sono abbastanza altalenanti e richiedono diverse prove prima di raggiungere un risultato migliore che però è difficile da paragonare ad altri sistemi più convenzionali. E' per me un prodotto sufficiente, perché poi alla fine funziona pure e fa quello che promette, per alcuni magari potrebbe essere perfino discreto ma è difficile pensare che si possa andare oltre. A meno che i toast che preparate con questa griglia in silicone non siano i primi toast che mangiate in tutta la vostra vita: non avendo un metro di paragone sono anche buoni seppur un po' flosci. Tre stelle.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: La sencillez partiendo de algo natural…
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Un producto que con creces ha cumplido mis expectativas por su desconsideración con la normativa estándar y su excelente realismo sobre todo para los que estén convencidos entre no diferenciar sueño y pensamiento basándose todo en una prolongación breve del delirio existencial.Como la felicidad humana siempre tiene su base en aquello que no se puede conseguir para alimentar el alma, estas plantas son un cebo de irrealidad para motivar las sensaciones de avance hacia la conquista de la brevedad sin tener que vivir por encima de las posibilidades que hipotequen nuestra libertad.
Disponen de un tarro de metal color cobrizo los cuales vienen etiquetados pudiéndoles quitar el rótulo o bien crearles uno a mayores como he hecho yo, para ponérselo por la parte trasera y aportar mayormente un poco de información de manera natural.Es una forma de respetar la luz del sol, pero no por ello la luz artificial es menos importante para poder vivir y nos ayuda también a ver sombras allí en donde no había claridad….
Como la realidad solo podría nacer cuando no hubiesen dudas , me conformo de que mi alteración por la percepción de todo lo que reciben mis sentidos hable el mismo idioma de la mayoría social y que a través del arte nos podamos recluir en la reflexión de algo como en la meditación de la nada, cuando la vida ya no tenga importancia para poder seguir creando y el placer te pueda seguir alimentando.
Estas apariencias vegetales con piedras pegadas que como la Justicia mantienen su ornamentación basada en la artificialidad, pero por muy aburrido que eso pueda parecer genera pasiones allí en donde la razón se queda a ciegas cuando la subjetividad apaga la luz para irse a descansar.Encendiendo una vela solo lo puedo recomendar….

Le pareti laterali infatti sono molto trasparenti e non alterano i colori del contenuto inoltre su ognuna di esse è presente una pellicola che la protegge da eventuali graffi nel confezionamento o nel trasporto quindi una volta tolta la pellicola la parete trasparente sarà veramente perfetta, al contrario ad esempio di molte teche espositive in acrilico che arrivano già con numerosi graffi da fabbrica. La qualità dei materiali l'ho trovata veramente buona, anche la base è fatta bene seppur tutta di carta e il tappo trasparente permette di poter guardare all'interno anche da sopra senza alterare la vista, inoltre si incastra piuttosto bene impedendo di far entrare la polvere all'interno. Il fatto poi che si adagi sulla base senza andarsi a fissare definitivamente permette anche di sollevarla in un attimo per spostare o sostituire il contenuto, proprio comoda.

🏃‍♂️ Riassumendo in breve:
👍 PRO: i pannelli trasparenti arrivano con una pellicola protettiva sopra per evitare i graffi durante il trasporto, sono presenti ben due scatole all'interno della confezione
👎 CONTRO: arrivano del tutto smontate quindi ci vuole un po' di manualità e tempo per raddrizzarle e dar loro la forma per bene

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Used to secure a horse trailer cover-held up to 30 MPH winds with 50 MPH gusts in a torrential storm
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I have a 3-horse steel gooseneck horse trailer that has a leaky tack area. It's carpeted, and makes for good place to overnight if necessary, but it has a leak somewhere.

I had purchased a trailer cover for it, which worked well and lasted three years, but in that third year we had a pretty good windstorm that tore it to shreds. Replacement of that cover is over $400, and I didn't want to invest that kind of money if another wind storm will just tear it up. When taking the trailer in for service didn't solve the leak problem, I had to find another solution that didn't cost $400.

I have a good amount of cheap-but-high-quality Costco tarps on hand, and I thought if I could get some heavy duty bungee cords, that might just do the trick. I liked the look of this company, reviews were good, they seem to stand behind their product, so I went for it.

As soon as the rains started coming, I put my tarp over the tack area windows and door, used almost all the larger bungee cords in this kit to secure it, and waiting for the storms.

They've been on there about a month now, and through rain and sun, they've stayed in place. Then came the torrential 4-day storm that hit the California coast in February 2024. For 24 hours straight, we had 30MPH average wind speed with 50 MPH wind gusts that tore apart other tarps, and bent up a Costco steel frame canopy, downed trees, etc. And these bungees held, the tarp DIDN'T MOVE and was perfectly fine BECAUSE the bungees held. And my trailer is dry inside.

I am so very pleased with these. I just bought another set with the ratcheting straps, because I know I can trust the quality of their product. It's proven itself.

Die Verwendung von tragbaren Bidets kann eine willkommene Alternative zu Toilettenpapier sein und kann zur Förderung der allgemeinen Hygiene und des Komforts im Wochenbett beitragen.

Insgesamt ist das Cynpel Mobiles Bidet eine sinnvolle Investition für Frauen im Wochenbett, die nach einer praktischen Lösung für eine schonende und effektive Reinigung suchen. Es bietet eine komfortable und hygienische Option, um sich während dieser besonderen Zeit bestens versorgt zu fühlen.

Ho aspettato circa una settimana per l'arrivo, e l'ho provato subito. Perfetto. Avevo lo scarico del water bloccato da non capisco cosa; ho provato di tutto, utilizzando tutti i disgorganti più aggressivi senza effetto alcuno. Confesso che ero un poco dubbioso, anche se avevo letto recensioni molto positive. Ho pensato che il costo di 19,99 non era poi eccessivo, se davvero avesse funzionato. Sicuramente molto meno di quanto avrei speso chiedendo l'intervento di un idraulico. L'ho provato subito appena arrivato, mettendo in pratica alcuni accorgimenti "antischizzi" che altri utenti avevano dichiarato (guanti, stracci sul pavimento attorno al water). Non ho avuto alcun problema. Ho solo riempito a metà il water, ho infilato il soffietto fin oltre la metà dello stesso e ho premuto inizialmente con un po di forza, ma senza stantuffare, in maniera lenta ma continua; poi ho tolto il soffietto e ho sentito come una specie di risucchio. Ho quindi ri-infilato il soffietto ed ho nuovamente spinto fino in fondo. A quel punto ho visto che l'acqua veniva risucchiata dallo scarico, liberandolo. Ho adesso, un attimo, che tutta l'acqua defluisse e ho provato nuovamente,ma non era più necessario: lo scarico si era sbloccato. Ho allora riempito un secchio grande (quasi 10 litri) e ho versato tutta l'acqua in una sola volta. Nessun problema. Non contento, ho fatto scorrere per un paio di volte la cassetta del water. Nessun problema. L'attrezzo ha funzionato perfettamente, senza schizzi. Sono completamente soddisfatto.

Vous retrouverez dans le paquet 3 protection souple, avec une pochette ou il y aura une lingette imbibé pour nettoyer votre téléphone avant la pose, un chiffon microfibre (similaire que les chiffons pour lunettes) pour essuyer votre téléphone, et une étiquette collante pour enlever les poussières que vous pouvez apercevoir après la pose de la protection sur votre téléphone (suffit de décoller la protection, et coller les poussières avec l'étiquette).

Alors OUI effectivement, c'est pas simple de poser parfaitement le film protecteur, il faut prendre son temps, mais si moi j'ai réussi, alors tout le monde peut réussir (je suis pas le plus adroit).

En tout cas pour moi c'est un sans faute, 3 protections souple, qui font tout autant le taff que du verre à mon humble avis (peut encaisser des petits coups de clés sans abimer l'écran), un kit de nettoyage, et le plus important : aucun problème avec les empreintes !!! (et je sais que c'est ce que les gens vont rechercher en premier pour un article comme ca).

CONTENIDO:
1 caja (medidas aproximadas: 39,5 x 24 x 3 cm) que incluye en su interior:

-Empaque simple pero adecuado al producto.

-Los bordes de plástico son afilados, no romos ni de corte recto.
-El elemento metálico que se extrae de la pinza para poder colgar el portapapeles es cortante.
-El precio actual de venta (25,99€) no me resulta adecuado teniendo en cuenta la calidad general del producto.

EN DEFINITIVA:
El producto es lo que necesito, pero los he tenido de mejor calidad por precio similar.

Durch die hochwertigen Antihaftbeschichtung bleiben die Baguettes und Brötchen nicht am Blech kleben und lassen sich sehr leicht lösen. Es wird somit auch kein Backpapier benötigt :-)

Das Baguette-Backlech hat eine Größe von 38,5 x 28,5 x 3,5 cm und passt optimal in jeden gängigen Backofen. Bei jedem Backgang können bis zu 3 Baguettes gebacken werden.

Das Baguette-Backblech lässt sich sehr einfach mit einem feuchten, weichen Lappen und etwas Spülmittel reinigen.
VORSICHT: Für die Reinigung in der Spülmaschine ist das Blech nicht geeignet, da dadurch die Anti-Haft Beschichtung beschädigt wird.

Fazit: Wir können dieses Baguette-Backblech nur empfehlen! Für das Backen mit diesem Baguette-Backblech benötigt man kein Backpapier und es passt in jeden gängigen Backofen. Mit diesem Backblech und dem beigelegten Rezeptbüchlein gelingen die Backwaren auf Anhieb ohne anzukleben. Anschließend sehr leicht mit einem Tuch und einem bisschen Spülmittel zu säubern.

I recently ordered these fleece-lined socks wondering what I'll get for just $9.95 (at time of this writing) and now they've pretty much become my go-to for warm and comfy feet for these winter days & nights. The only thing I didn't care for so much is that , since my hands are dry, the material has that kind of weird feel to it... At the same time though, once I get them on my feet they feel great! So, all in all, these fleece lined socks are great for wearing around the house etc, they're anti-slip, cozy & warm and actually look real nice too... I needed a good low profile caster to use on an under-bed storage project and these worked out perfectly. The two main requirements I had was low-profile to avoid losing valuable storage space and ball bearings to make sure that the storage unit would be very smooth and easy to pull out from under the bed and push back under. These caster checked both of those boxes and have worked well. You only add about an inch to the height of whatever you mount them to and the bearing allow them to roll extremely smoothly almost gliding, which is also helped along by the good grip to the floor from the rubber wheels compared to cheaper plastic wheels. Also worth noting that despite being small wheels, they do also roll very well on carpet. Highly recommended if your project requires a small in-line caster.
