CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Difficile da manipolare, prodotto ordinato due volte per errata consegna
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ho ordinato il prodotto 2 volte: la prima volta per errore mi è stato recapitato un altro articolo (onestamente non ho nemmeno capito cosa fosse...). Il reso non è stato agevole: causa periodo natalizio, la coda in posta è stata lunghissima, e onestamente, poiché il reso è stata una conseguenza di un errore del venditore, mi è un po' pesato...

Il prodotto in sé è fatto bene, in legno, anche i colori sono belli esteticamente e sembrano ben applicati e ben aderenti al legno, però i cubetti sono davvero piccolini e molto ravvicinati, quindi la mia bimba di 2 elementare fa un po' fatica ad estrarli... questo rende "noioso" e difficile un metodo che in realtà dovrebbe stimolare l'apprendimento.
L'idea è ottima, infatti la bimba è entusiasta, peccato che per ora non riesca ad utilizzare lo strumento in autonomia, a meno di ribaltare la tavoletta e poi reinserire i cubetti man mano che si dà la risposta corretta...
Sottolineo che la bimba non ha alcun problema di motricità fine, sono proprio i cubetti ad essere molto piccoli e ravvicinati... magari qualche centimetro in più non avrebbe guastato e avrebbe agevolato l'utilizzo dello strumento!!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Belle da vedere ma poco pratiche da usare
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ho ordinato queste bottiglie in plastica BELLE VOUS perché ero rimasto affascinato dal loro design pulito e moderno.

Il Set è composto da 12 bottiglie in plastica trasparente e tappo nero opaco, ogni bottiglia ha una capacità massima di 500 ml.
Ogni bottiglia è lunga 21,3cm ed ha un diametro di 5,8 cm, per un peso pari a 43 grammi, sono davvero molto leggere.

La plastica trasparente con cui sono realizzate presenta diverse imperfezioni, non è molto spessa e si piega facilmente.

Come potete vedere dal video che ho realizzato, anche se a prima vista il tappo si chiude perfettamente è sufficiente una leggera pressione per sentire l'aria che fuoriesce, purtroppo questo particolare va a vanificare la funzione principale della bottiglia, ovvero trattenere i liquidi senza farli uscire, infatti basta stringerle leggermente e il liquido contenuto all'interno fuoriesce anche con il tappo chiuso creando un effetto simile ad un tubo che perde acqua.
Inizialmente pensavo che fossero solo una o due bottiglie a perdere, ma sfortunatamente questa particolarità è comune a tutte e dodici.

Impossibile trasportarle in uno zaino, il contatto con altri oggetti potrebbe piegarle e in un attimo vi troverete lo zaino bagnato.

Assegno due stelle e non una a queste bottiglie solo perché sono belle da vedere, le userò come soprammobili per la cucina.

Al momento dell'ordine il prezzo di 24,49 euro è competitivo perché ogni bottiglia viene a costare solo 2,04 Euro, peccato che perdano liquido dal tappo.

What you don’t see clearly on the image is the self assembly needed of this; easy enough as you slot all the pieces together…. Which is great until the pieces do not fit together. I understand they have to be snug, removed all the film and put the first piece in, all good… then the next piece all good, or so I thought as I realised one of the slots had snapped… no big drama, a bit of glue will fix… until the slot snapped on the two pieces with slots and then the base; thought okay I will live with it, but on fitting the top the whole thing would not slot together properly. Push the top down and one side pops out, hold it all together and push all bits together and then lo and behold a second after releasing, corner of top pops out. As the actual parts are probably 1/2mm to wide for the slots and not bevelled, you push them together and my breaking point for returning was when one of the actual slats to go in to the slot snapped at the corner.

A ver simple fix - bevel the edges for the slats slightly as the whole thing would be much easier. I have returned and will get a pre-assembled one as even when put together, with all the snapped pieces, it just fell apart and always had one corner at least pop out. Gave up and returned very brittle, weak and flimsy which is understandable for acrylic but yeah, won’t be trying it again!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Gutes Fassungsvermögen, aber unpraktisch im Alltag
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich habe die Flasche schon seit einem Jahr im Einsatz.
Positiv: Sie hält gut, die Tragelasche ist praktisch, sie ist auch Metall statt Kunststoff somit keine Weichmacher im Wasser (außer der Deckel).
Negativ: es fehlt ein Griff, damit könnte man sie gut tragen und man bräuchte die Lasche nicht, aber vor allem könnte man dann mit nur einer Hand trinken! Die volle Flasche mit nur einer Hand beim Trinken zu halten ist fast unmöglich, besonders wenn die Griffkraft nach einem anstrengenden Training nachgelassen hat, das nervt ziemlich (es sei denn man hat so große Hände wie Hulk). Auch die Trinköffnung ist nicht optimal, manchmal kommt kein Wasser und dann plötzlich ein Schwall, den man dann auf dem Shirt hat. In der praktischen Nutzung finde ich sie also eher untauglich. Da gibt es besser durchdachte Trinkflaschen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Soft and cozy material; not a true balaclava
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
As you can tell from the photos, this isn't a true balaclava, it's a knit hood with a bit of a neck to tuck into a neckline. I used my eyes to see what I was getting, so I'm not disappointed at all. It's incredibly soft and feels wonderful, not static-y at all. (Always a concern for me when putting something on my baby-fine hair!)
The fit, however, is on the tighter side for my average/small ladies head. It does stretch, but not comfortably over my bun or ponytail...an issue with most actual balaclavas as well, they just don't accommodate much else other than a head and hair.
It's also fairly short, so it doesn't stay tucked into the neck of anything if you're moving at all.
I was able to purchase this through Vine for a discount so I can't return it, but I think I would simply because I don't think I'm going to get as much use out of this as I initially thought.

Sadly I was a little disappointed when I received this mug. The packaging was basic which is fine but there were no care instructions so it’s not clear what materials it’s made from or if it is dishwasher safe etc (although it does give materials and say hand wash on the listing, but if I were gifting this I would like at least a basic info leaflet).
I was expecting the mug to have a flat a light pink, gloss finish but it does in fact have a holographic glitter finish (my photos don’t pick this up but you can see a bit of shimmer and the glitter flecks). Unfortunately though the finish is a little rough as if the paint has not been applied correctly, so it does not feel smooth to the touch and therefore the holographic glitter does not show up well on much of the surface (I have another tumbler style insulated cup with the same finish and is much more sparkly) but perhaps I was just unlucky to get one that wasn’t up to standard.
The lid supplied fits well, has a little bung that can be opened for use with a straw and a flip up bit for drinking directly from the cup, however it’s not the most comfortable to drink from. The deep square lip all round the lid is not comfortable for your mouth and the flip back bit gets in the way, it’s not unusable but I have other insulate cups that have easier lids to drink from, it’s probably easier to use with a straw but as I use my insulated cups for coffee and tea this isn’t really an option.
The lid makes it spill proof but not leak proof although you would have a good few seconds if the cup went over and the lid seals were down before your drink started dripping out. It also helps keep the heat in and I find it keeps my coffee at a good drinkable temperature for an hour or two which is exactly what I want, I’ve not tested it to see if it will stay hot for ‘up to 6 hours’ as suggested but I’ve never had one of these style insulated mugs that has been able to do so, so would have my doubts but they are usually good at keeping cold drinks cold for a long period of time so I am confident this one will too.
This is the first insulated mug I’ve had with a handle and I have to say I like it, the whole construction of the mug is good and it seems sturdy and is easy to clean and is just the right size for a regular cup of coffee.
The addition of a straw and cleaning brush is nice, however, the ends of the straw where it has been machined are sharp so will need a little filing to make usable.
Overall I’m mostly pleased with the mug, I like the colour, shape and that it keeps my drink hot but the finish could be better.

EDIT - I’ve only been using the cup for 4 days and the vacuum seal has gone and water (from when the cup has been washed) has got in to the void between the walls. The cup no longer keeps drinks hot and leaks water from the base. Very disappointed with the poor quality.

Our toilet was blocked and taking over an hour to drain after each flush. Nothing else we tried would shift the problem (which we suspect was a mix of wet-wipes, an accidentally flushed anti-bac cleaning wipe and the usual human output). Bought this item after reading reviews of various other similar looking items. Unlike the grey coloured version, the title for the blue/green one does not mention that it comes with a caddy (storage pot) but in fact it does.

Other reviewers mentioned it might take a while to work, that you need there to be at least some water in the pan and that one should put down plastic sheeting on the floor in case of splashing. I can confirm all three points!

I poured some water into the pan from a bucket until it was maybe 1/4 full - I didn't want to use the flush to put water in because, well, I didn't want it to fill to the top and find myself with my hands under water when pumping... I started off pumping slowly, fearful of the dreaded splashback. There was lots of turbulance and sloshing of water in the pan but after a couple of minutes no good result. Due to being careful there was minimal splashing, but still some splashes made their way to the floor so I was glad of the plastic I had put down first.

I was getting a bit despondent at this point, and for some reason changed from long slow pumps to doing shorter but much quicker and more frequent pumps, like 2 or 3 per second. This really seemed to drive the water down the hole with more power, churning the water much better and was accompanied by some loud gurgling noises and suddenly the blockage was gone and all the water disappeared. Result!

The manufacturer says one can clean it by pumping it in a clean loo, but that didn't seem to do much (not enough water now there is no blockage) so I think I'll take it outside and hose it off in the drain then bleach it. This thing should be called Loo-easy, not Luigi's, it works!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Las ruedas son del tipo skate, y son de gran calidad y de excelentes acabados.

Llegan en una caja perfectamente protegidas individualmente mediante una bolsita de plástico para evitar roces entre ellas.

Una vez que cambié las ruedas de mi silla por estas, el cambio en el deslizamiento en el suelo es totalmente suave, se hace muy cómo desplazarte con la silla de un lado a otro o para salir de tu puesto de trabajo.

La cobertura de goma de las ruedas evitan que puedan arañar el suelo, y se notan que son blanditas.

Yo escogí estas por tener bloqueo de ruedas, frenos también se podrían llamar. Esto me ayuda a fijarme en el sitio sin que se mueva la silla, y son realmente fáciles de accionar y desactivar.

La única pega que les pongo es que a veces puedes golpear con los pies la palanca de accionamiento del bloqueo de las ruedas, y si no llevas un calzado pueden llegar a hacer daño.

No entiendo como no traen estas ruedas todas las sillas del mercado, al menos las de alta gama, compré una Secret Lab hace un año y leí que trae buenas ruedas y son muy muy parecidas a las del resto de sillas, no digo que sean algo mejores pero nada que ver con la suavidad de este tipo, de estas las hay de varias marcas, imagino que mismo fabricante y cambian la marca por lo que te recomiendo que mires ofertas, yo las he comprado para 4 sillas distintas en casa y las que más tiempo las tenemos cerca de 3 años y van como el primer día, nada de ruido, muy robustas y ligeras, y el parket donde yo me siento que uso la silla diariamente está perfecto, ni una sola marca, ni de roce, ni de haberlo chafado ni nada, son perfectas.

Die Navaris LED Deckenleuchte in Blumenform bekommt von mir 3 Sterne, sie verspricht ein vielseitiges Lichterlebnis mit dimmbaren Optionen und verstellbarer Farbtemperatur. Das Blumen-Design gibt jedem Raum eine charmante Note. Die weiße Farbe ermöglicht eine einfache Einführung in unterschiedliche Einrichtungsstile. Die dimmbaren Funktionen, gesteuert durch die Fernbedienung, bieten Anpassungsmöglichkeiten für verschiedene Lichtverhältnisse und Stimmungen im Raum. Von warmem Gelbton bis zu kühlerem Tageslicht, es gibt viele Optionen zur Anpassung des Lichts.

Der Aufbau ist relativ einfach, und die Anleitung taugt was. Das Design der Leuchte erfordert eine präzise Installation, damit nichts schief hängt. Vorallem in größeren Räumen kann die Helligkeit unausreichend sein. Ein zusätzliches Licht könnte erforderlich sein, um ausreichende Helligkeit zu bekommen. Die Verarbeitung ist gut, jedoch könnte die Qualität der Schrauben verbessert werden, um die Installation einfacher zu gestalten. Die Energieeffizienz der LEDs sorgt für eine kostengünstige Langzeitnutzung, ein klarer Pluspunkt.

Alles in allem bietet die Navaris LED Deckenleuchte ein ansprechendes Design und gute Funktionen. Verbesserungen bei der Helligkeit und den Installationsmaterialien könnten das Gesamterlebnis verbessern.

The bike looks like it would be a good product for transitioning your young one to pedal bikes or even dirt bikes. However during assembly I started to develop some concerns. First the neck holds the lower forks center via plastic bushings not bearings or even poly bushings, so I expect failure there first. Second the seat and handle bars are held in place by cheap bolt through clamps. While tightening the bars down the supplied bolt snapped before the bars were even properly held in place, fortunately I have several bolts lying about my shop and I was able to fix in house. Even with the new bolt installed however the camp fails to provide sufficient clamping force to confidently keep the bars inline and elevated. The seat adjustment uses the same clamp as well, so similar failure can be expected. The only thing good I can say about this bike is that it looks nice. Lastly I am a certified motorcycle mechanic by trade, more than confident and capable of assembling anything with two wheels, this is a quality issue plain and simple.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I like these, they are nice and heavy (1.2 kg each), but even though I read they were 4.8 cm across, I'm not sure I truly understood how wide that is and how far that intrudes on the doorway gap.

It's fine if you got a door that goes back further than 90° from the hinge point, chances are it won't really be that noticeable in that case.

But if you want to keep a door open that only goes to 90°, these things sit right where you are going to step/trip/fall over them. Not a problem for the doorstops themselves, you just need to check.

As far as doorstops go, they are great, they are heavy which means they don't get blown by the wind, they got rubber bases and a rubber ring round the side which means they are grippy and do what they are supposed to do.

Just be sure your doorway is wide enough that these won't get in your way.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Decent safety specs for the money
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
There are various versions and packaging options for these safety glasses - the ones I got were in a pack of 6, which arrived in a box containing six individually plastic-wrapped pairs of glasses. Some reviews complain about glasses arriving scratched - mine, I wouldn't say they were utterly unblemished but the *extremely* minimal bit of occasional micro-scratching on the surface was something you would really have to go out of your way to see, and I would imagine is more or less impossible to avoid on any polycarbonate lens that's been hand-packed unless it has a super-hard specialist coating and/or you never even breath on it.

I wouldn't expect these to last as well as more expensive glasses, because I think they do scratch fairly easily, but for the money I paid (thirteen pounds for the pack of six) I have no complaints, and I would happily buy these again.

I have not tested them for strength, UV-protection, etc. They are not advertised as bullet-proof or anything like that. From the look and feel of them I would expect them to safely deflect mild splashes, low-speed debris and so on. I would use them when operating typical domestic power tools. They wrap around but don't provide huge amounts of side protection. If you work with something extremely hazardous and need a certified level of protection, then obviously you will want to buy specialist eye protection, not generic budget safety specs.

Our bathroom door opens on to the shower enclosure - if we don't have something to stop it then the handle bangs into the glass wall. You can see how this might not be an entirely good idea!

I like that it has a rubber buffer ring to the door bounces back, I also like that there's two in the pack - it's always useful to have a spare, and the other can be utilised elsewhere in the house. I dare say these could even be used as paperweights - they're good, solid lumps of metal and rubber, but take care not to drop one on a toe!

At £15.99 for two (as at 6 December 2023) I think these are an excellent buy, and certainly cheaper than replacing a shower enclosure. Would recommend.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Warm! A Must Have for a Hooded Winter Coat
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I bought a knit hood similar to this decades ago and haven't found another until now. This is a close-fitting hood that you can wear pushed back a little to show your hair or pulled forward to block wind, falling snow and rain. You can also push it all the way back and wear it like a scarf (with no loose tails). To me, this is essential if you're wearing a hooded parka because the hoods never seem to cinch tight enough to keep out the cold. IMO it is not designed as a true balaclava - the neck part of the hood is too short to be able to keep your neck warm if you pull up the front to cover your mouth and nose. Also it is made of an acrylic yarn, not wool so if you are in really, really cold areas, you might need to supplement your headwear or use the hood of an insulated parka-type coat/jacket. I'm off to buy another.
Recommended!

Coppia di cornici in cartoncino da assemblare autonomamente, senza l’ausilio di istruzioni non presenti.

Il montaggio è però abbastanza facile e intuitivo, ed è un’operazione molto rapida. Le cornici risultano composte da un parallelepipedo forato in cui inserire una scatola in cartoncino più leggero.

Seguendo le pieghe del cartone è facile montarle, ma la scarsa consistenza dei materiali si presta a strappi e facili danneggiamenti.

La parte frontale delle cornici si solleva ed ha un meccanismo di aggancio e sgancio calamitato. Consente quindi di sostituire rapidamente il foglio A4 da esporre, ma non è presente alcuna protezione trasparente che lo tuteli.

Nella scatola inserita lateralmente , possono essere conservati numerosi fogli sempre in formato A4 o minore.

Si tratta di un sistema abbastanza originale per archiviare e custodire i disegni dei più piccoli che, soprattutto in età prescolare, si dilettano quotidianamente in vere e proprie opere d’arte.

Il foglio che si espone può essere cambiato quotidianamente con grande facilità, anche dal bambino stesso, ma la qualità dei materiali di queste cornici non le rende degli accessori destinati a durare nel tempo.

Die Sendung kam pünktlich und gut verpackt an.
Da wir ein bequemes Bingospiel gesucht haben (kein ständiges Nummernziehen aus einem Beutel) und dieses Set schon auf dem Bild sehr attraktiv fanden, wurde dies ausgesucht.

Es ist sehr wertig verarbeitet und sieht edel aus.

Das Drehen der Nummernkugel ist leichtgängig und auch kleinere Kinder können dies wunderbar übernehmen (auch zum Üben der Zahlen nützlich).

Inkludiert sind 90 Nummernkugeln, ein Ablagebrett für die gezogenen Nummern (praktisch zum nochmals Vorlesen), 12 Bingokarten (die doppelseitig bedruckt sind), 300 Abdeckblättchen, die Spielanleitung und natürlich das Drehgerät.

Das Drehgerät funktioniert so, daß bei Kurbeldrehung eine Kugel in den Rollkanal fällt und nach vorne rollt.

Alles ist gut verarbeitet und nichts ist wackelig oder leiert.

Der originale Spielkarton läßt auch ein bequemes Wiedereinpacken und Aufbewahren zu. (muß also nicht, wie bei anderen Spieleverpackungen, nach dem ersten Auspacken entsorgt werden). Der Platzbedarf aufgrund des Drehgerätes ist allerdings größer als bei herkömmlichen Bingospielen.

So ist Bingospielen wirklich lustig und geht schnell.

Absolute Kaufempfehlung!

Zwei Verbesserungsvorschläge an die Hersteller:
- Die Ablagemulde auf dem Zahlenbrett könnte etwas tiefer sein, damit die Kugeln fester sitzen. Für Männerhände ziemlich eng abzulegen.
- Eventuell noch ein paar Bingokarten mehr für größere Spielrunden.

First off, this is lovely. It's soft and silky smooth and the gold moons and stars in the design are really elegant.

But I misunderstood what this is. I thought it was a shower cap. I don't use shower caps for showers. I use them as bowl covers for protecting bread dough as it rises, or to cover food in the fridge. My previous ones had lived their long useful lives, so I ordered this to replace them. My first test showed that this is not useful for keeping dough or food from drying out. Take one star off me for my mistake.

Then I ran it under the faucet to see if it is a good water barrier, and it is not. It is "just" soft and pretty fabric. Two stars off me for really not getting it.

Then I tried using it as a kind of bonnet to protect my hair on Pacific Northwest damp days, and discovered that this really is a child's bonnet. Too small.

Bottom line: five stars for this delightful item, three stars off me for being such a goof.

Non sono plastica e metallo, ma solo plastica. Quasi trasparenti. Risolvono con una sola cosa il doppio problema della porta che sbatte al muro od ai mobili se troppo aperta o che si chiude di botto per una corrente d'aria. Se sotto la punta della porta non hai almeno 2 millimetri di vuoto (o non li crei mettendo anellini di spessore sui cardini) non si possono usare. L'adesivo è forte quindi (pavimento pulito e asciutto) decidete bene prima il punto esatto di collocazione del cilindro più grosso (quello che fa da perno di rotazione) senza togliere la pellicola che copre l'adesivo, ed appoggiate qualcosa a terra per indicare il punto. Così poi da incollarlo giusto al primo tentativo perché non sarebbe facile staccarlo e ricollocarlo. Io poi ci ho tenuto un piede sopra per un minuto per fare incollare bene con la pressione, ma tenendo il mio peso più sull'altro piede per non rovinarli con troppo peso. Per avere un movimento apri e chiudi comodo è meglio che il braccino fra i cilindri sia lungo. Le mie porte sono spesse cm.4,5 e con questi ci sono andato comodo. Il materiale è plastica economica, e quindi la quasi trasparenza è esteticamente la scelta giusta. Sto valutando se smaltare la cima dei cilindri di bianco per non inciamparci nella penombra, ma per ora aspetto. C'è ne sono di migliori, ma questi hanno un ottimo rapporto qualità prezzo e per il poco che li ho pagati sono molto soddisfatto e li ho consigliati ad altre persone.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Preis ist happig, aber sie liefern
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich betreibe Gewichtheben im Homegym. Bei vielen Übungen fällt mir daher auf, dass meine Beweglichkeit im Knöchelgelenk eher eingeschränkt ist, was mich bei einigen Übungen (primär Squats) stark einschränkt.

Als ich die Chance gesehen hatte, diese Blöcke testen zu dürfen, habe ich also zugeschlagen.

Durch die Kombination aus zwei flachen und einem höheren Keil, kann man seine Steigung relativ frei einstellen oder man steckt sich die Keile zu einem Block zusammen, der zum Beispiel auch als recht stabile Erhöhung für Negative Deadlifts verwendet werden kann. Ich nutze die Blöcke in flachen Sportschuhen, da sie ansonsten sehr rutschig sind, trotz leicht angerauter Oberfläche.
Ich dehne meine Waden statisch und dynamisch mit einem vor mir gehaltenen Gewicht, um mein Gleichgewicht abzusichern. Dafür sind sie prima geeignet.

Mein Hauptkritikpunkt ist, dass die Belastbarleit der Wadendehner nur als "durable" angegeben wird, aber nicht wie widerstandsfähig sie eigentlich sind. Ich habe die Wadendehner bereits einmal verkehrt herum als Erhöhung meines Absatzes genutzt, um mich bei Deepsquats zu unterstützen. Dabei kam ich auf rund 145kg Gesamtlast, was zumindest die flachen Keile ohne Ermüdungszeichen verkraftet hatten. Ob sie das lange aushalten würden, ob die hohen Keile das aushalten und ob zei gestapelte Keile dabei noch stabil bleiben würden weiß ich nicht, aber ich würde meinen, dass die Dehner wohl mindestens 150kg Last aushalten dürften.

Wer aber nicht plant mit Zusatzgewichten auf die Klötze zu steigen, sollte sich hier wahrscheinlich keine Sorgen machen müssen.

Ive been getting Bright Day planners for a couple of years. This one has a different style. But I really like the improvement. The previous datebooks were a bit smaller and on the month view one page would be shiny card stock, the other would be paper. Anytime you would write on the shiny card stock, the pen ink would smudge. So you were limited on which pens to use. The new date planners month view is paper on both sides. The date boxes are smaller, but it's nice because it's more spread out and not so cramped. The daily view has full length columns for each day with the week spanning over two pages, giving you lots of room to write and add multiple errands or appointments for that day. CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: All the curly girls need this
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
It took me years to realize that a satin or silk sleeping bonnet is essential to keeping the curls that I worked so hard to get perfect look like wash day one on day four. Here's the truth: curly heads shouldn't wash their hair every day, we work up to having clean hair without washing it for up to a week (I'm a 4-day girl myself.) Sleeping with a cap like this one on keeps those curls and shine intact and keeps the frizzies away so refreshing in the morning is very easy. BUT not all caps are created equal. For me, this is the cap I like (and I've tried several styles.)

This sleeping cap has two layers, and this reversible dual-layer color creates a thicker cap than others and a little style variety with my jammies. I don't care for a ruffle or wide band, they end up slipping down my forehead overnight but this cap has an adjustable elastic at the very edge to give a custom fit and keep it on and in place all night. With a lot of caps I tried, if I woke up in the middle of the night I could feel them on my head and ripped them off. Not this one- I would love to tell you why, maybe the weight or the size or the elastic placement? Doesn't matter. This is my new favorite sleeping cap.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Als die Hülle bei mir angekommen ist war ich leider von der Farbe enntäuscht. Ich hatte ein richtig schönes Metallicpetrol erwartet. Anders als auf dem Produktbild zu sehen fehlt der Metalliceffekt fast gänzlich. Die Hülle ist leider flacher als das Display und schützt dieses gar nicht. Schon bei kleinsten Unachtsamkeiten wird das Display beschädigt. Der erhöhte Rand, wie bei anderen Hüllen ist hier nicht vorhanden.

Ich habe die Hülle etwa 1,5 Monate verwendet als die ersten Farbabblätterungen losgegangen sind. Das Petrol ist nur aufgetragen als art dünne Beschichtung. Es lässt sich (wenn es einmal zu blättern begonnen hat) leicht abkratzen/ziehen. Besonders die Ecken und auch dem Ladebuchsenausschnitt sieht man die tägliche Nutzung an. Nach 3 Monaten habe ich die Hülle leider entsorgt, da sie einfach nur noch grässlich ausgesehen hat. Das transparente Grundgerüst hat sich auch schnell gelblich verfärbt.
Erfüllt seine Funktion, allerdings halten die Schrauben nicht lange fest. Danach muss mit Kleber angebracht werden.

Che dire la board funziona se è alimentata tramite USB. Il problema sorge quando si ha intenzione di alimentarla con i cinque volte tramite il pin Vin oppure tramite i 3,3v.
In poche parole se si alimenta attraverso questi due pin lo sketch non viene eseguito e si blocca.
Quindi utilizzabile esclusivamente a Oggi solo tramite USB.
Inoltre un altro problema da tenere in considerazione che potrebbe anche non essere un problema ma per me lo è è il fatto che avendo due file di pin in parallelo,non è compatibile con le breadboard,quindi difficile da integrare in un progetto di prototipazione.
Comunque ripeto se non si ha intenzione di alimentarle tramite PIN o di inserirle in una breadboard quindi una millefori, ma collegarla tramite dei cavetti può funzionare e potete sperimentare i vostri programmi.

They are way more comfortable than ice packs, just nice and cool. I found both ways to provide instant cooling, but I think that wearing one directly on my neck was more effective.

Of course, the drawback is that you have to make the time to put them in the freezer. But if you, like me, tend to get overheated at the merest hint of exercise, then these are great items to put in your gym back before going out the door. CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ho comprato questa custodia perché volevo qualcosa leggermente più ecocompatibile che non quelle tutte in plastica. Bene, la parte in sughero c'è e fa bella figura, è anche molto piacevole al tatto. Il prezzo era giusto.
La parte in sughero è incollata a una base in plastica (o silicone, non so), quest'ultima è quella che avvolge effettivamente e protegge il corpo del telefono.
Sul retro della custodia, il sughero non ricopre completamente la parte in plastica, manca nell'angolo in alto, sopra le telecamere posteriori (questo non è una sorpresa, si vede sulle foto fornite dal venditore) – non si tratta solamente di una questione estetica: proprio lì ci vorrebbe la protezione maggiore. Questo "vuoto", inoltre, fa sì che i pezzi dove finisce la parte in sughero possono facilmente ripiegarsi.
Ho dato tre stelle perché la custodia era bella e piacevole, finché è durata: dopo un anno e mezzo il sughero ha cominciato a sgretolarsi sul dorso (all'esterno ma anche all'interno nello stesso punto) e sulla linguetta di chiusura magnetica, quindi per me merita una valutazione "media".

The table is good looking and well-made and its description says for outdoors and picnics and the photos show that type of the table. Unfortunately, that what I received it’s not for outdoor and picnics. The seller’s photos show the table with twist and lock fully adjustable legs whereas that what I did received is a table with push button with two pre-set holes. The pre-set holes allowing adjustment only in two positions which on very uneven surface would make it impossible to balance the table. I can understand that pre-set holes and push bottoms make process of setting up and levelling the table much faster but the same effect could be achieved by placing some type of measurement system (like some sort of ruler) on the twist and pull legs which wouldn’t remove functionality from the table. Of course, the table has screw system to balance it but the screws allow only 3 to 4 cm adjustment. Therefore, when outdoor, on very uneven surface balancing table would require use of rocks, pieces of wood or other materials. The table will work perfectly only on fairly even surface which make it not fit for purpose for most of the outdoors or picnics. Setting and levelling the table on surface like on the photo ( rocks and sand) would be nightmare. Therefore, I am asking what happened with the original design which we could see on the photos and why with the change in design the description wasn’t changed? If the seller has table with original design (twist and pull legs) I would be happy to buy it since its vell made and nice table but with pin type legs it doesn’t fit the outdoor purpose and unfortunately, I will be returning the table.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: As my bathroom sink kept getting blocked, I used unblocking gels from the supermarket a few times. Pushing the water in my sink down the drain seems to have cleansed the pipes. It's been a few weeks now, and I haven't experienced any issues with my sink any more.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Let's get the good stuff out of the way first:
- It looks sleek and is well made, especially for the price
- There's no installation, you just snap it on and go
- A raised lip over the rear camera means your lenses won't get scratched
- It's very grippy

Now the cons:
- The pictures and description are a bit deceptive. The back is not wood or carbon fiber, it's a wood grain paper, and carbon fiber texture.
- Feels weird to list this as a con, but the fit is almost too perfect. If you're using a screen protector, I'd recommend placing it on *after* you have your phone in the case, as the edges of the case are pretty precise, and will lift your screen protector off.

All in all, it's a solid purchase, as long as you're not expecting anything too luxurious.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: I had to sand it down to get rid of splinters
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I wanted to get this hammock from The Cat Ladies for my youngest cat, who weighs 7.5 lbs. Since it's a well-known brand, I thought it would be perfect for her and even big enough for her to share with her brothers if she felt like it. I expected a standard of safety and quality that often comes with reputable brands, but it seems they might be facing the same quality control challenges as others when it comes to wooden pet items.

Although the hammock is sturdy and well-balanced, I noticed that the edges on the pieces were splintered and sharp. I was concerned that they could easily scratch my cats' faces, especially since they all tend to mark things with their cheeks. For their safety, I had to sand down the frame with some 220 grit sandpaper to make it smoother and rounder.

Despite this issue, I'm overall happy with it as a whole, as well as my handy work; to have been given the opportunity to review this. The mini hammock is sturdy, and my little cat is starting to warm up to it.

Just want to add that the bottom bed is not really going to hold most adult cats since their weight would drop it to the floor. I just laid it over the hammock to make it softer. I didn't want to tie it to the top because I was worried my cats could trap their legs. It does add a nice comfy layer to the bed.

I hope "The Cat Ladies" read reviews and deals with the splinter issues.

My main reason for getting these test strips was for the pH value, which is very clear and easy to read on the strip. The other measurement were a bonus. The packaging is good and the color chart on the canister is coated so that you can rest the wet strip on the can for comparison without damaging the chart.
However, Both the product write up and the actual product container and instruction sheet says there are 13 tests on each strip. WRONG. There are 15 test pads. So, reading the results is quite confusing. The two extra pads are quite a different color reaction that is nowhere on the chart, so you can rule them out after studying it awhile. The instructions state an incubation time of 15 seconds (60 seconds for Nitrate & Nitrite) but it does not state how long the color is stable for, such as "Read results with x minutes". A bad omission.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Stylish and Practical for Everyday Use
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Having just tried out the BELLE VOUS Set of 2 Small Waste Bins with Lid, I’m excited to share my thoughts based on my personal experience using them. I received these bins through the Amazon Vine Program, and I’ve had the chance to integrate them into my daily life, so I can offer an honest and firsthand review.

From the moment I unpacked these bins, I was struck by their modern design. The clear plastic body, complemented by a chic rose gold trim, makes them a stylish addition to my space. I’ve placed the larger 2.2-liter bin in my kitchen, where it serves as the perfect spot for food scraps and wrappers. Every time I make a snack, whether it's peeling an apple or unwrapping a granola bar, I find it incredibly convenient to toss the waste into this bin without worrying about lingering odors. The lid seals tightly, so even when I toss in some used citrus peels, I never notice any unpleasant smells wafting around my kitchen.

Meanwhile, the smaller 1.4-liter bin has become a staple on my desk. I often find myself surrounded by random papers and packaging while I work, and having this little bin within arm's reach makes it easy to keep my workspace tidy. I love that I can just push the lid open with one hand while holding a handful of paper scraps in the other—no fuss, no mess! This has been especially helpful during busy days when I’m rushing to meet deadlines; I can quickly clear away clutter and focus on what matters.

One of my favorite moments with these bins was during a recent cleaning spree. I tackled my beauty cabinet and found a mountain of empty product containers and used cotton pads. I filled the larger bin with the discarded items, and it was so satisfying to see everything neatly contained. The lids not only keep the contents hidden but also keep any lingering beauty product smells contained. I could clean up without worrying about any unsightly mess lingering around.

I’ve also used the bins in my bathroom. The larger one is great for throwing away used tissues and personal care items, while the smaller bin is ideal for keeping on the counter for quick access when I'm applying makeup or doing my skincare routine. It holds the used cotton rounds and q-tips perfectly, and I appreciate how easy it is to empty when it’s full. Just lift the inner section out, and I can take it to the trash without making a mess.

One detail that stands out is how easy it is to operate the lids. A simple press on the front allows the lid to pop open smoothly, which is a huge plus when my hands are busy or messy. I remember a day when I was prepping food and my hands were covered in flour; I could easily dispose of the waste without getting flour everywhere. It’s these little conveniences that have made these bins a great addition to my routine.

While I genuinely love these bins, I want to share a couple of considerations for anyone thinking of purchasing them. The size is fantastic for small waste, but if you're someone who generates a lot of trash, like packaging from meal prep or larger kitchen items, you may find yourself emptying them more frequently than you'd like. However, for my needs—keeping things tidy in my kitchen, bathroom, and workspace—they are just the right size.

In conclusion, the BELLE VOUS Set of 2 Small Waste Bins with Lid has truly enhanced my daily life. Their stylish design, coupled with their practicality, makes them perfect for managing small waste in a way that feels organized and effortless. If you’re looking for cute and functional bins to elevate your space, I highly recommend giving these a try. My personal experience has been nothing short of positive, and they’ve quickly become indispensable in my home!

Ich habe das Bewässerungssystem von Belle Vous nun seit einigen Wochen im Einsatz und bin soweit zufrieden. Das Set ist wirklich umfassend und bietet eine Vielzahl an Möglichkeiten, meine Pflanzen optimal mit Wasser zu versorgen.

Die Installation war unkompliziert, und die Materialien machen einen hochwertigen Eindruck. Besonders praktisch finde ich die verstellbaren Tropfer, mit denen ich den Wasserfluss für jede Pflanze individuell anpassen kann. Das spart Wasser und sorgt dafür, dass meine Pflanzen immer die richtige Menge erhalten.

Ein kleiner Kritikpunkt, den ich teilen möchte, ist das Fehlen eines Druckminderers. Bei meinem Wasseranschluss war der Druck zu hoch, sodass ich einige Anpassungen vornehmen musste, um ein gleichmäßiges tropfen zu gewährleisten. Dies könnte für andere Nutzer ebenfalls relevant sein.

Fazit:
Alles in allem bin ich begeistert von diesem Bewässerungssystem. Es ist eine lohnende Investition für jeden Gartenbesitzer, der seine Pflanzen automatisch und effizient bewässern möchte. Mit ein wenig handwerklichem Geschick lässt sich auch das Problem des fehlenden Druckminderers lösen. Ich kann dieses Produkt empfehlen.

Aber sie funktioniert und für den Preis möchte ich mich nicht beschweren, aber besser montiert, macht mehr Freude.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Schön fürs Servieren, aber rauer Boden
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Die Tapas-Schälchen machen optisch richtig was her. Sie bringen mit ihren traditionellen Designs das Flair Spaniens direkt auf den Tisch, und auch als Dekoration sind sie ein echter Hingucker. Ich mag, dass sie vielseitig einsetzbar sind, egal ob für Dips, Desserts oder kleine Snacks. Die Verarbeitung wirkt solide, und die Schälchen fühlen sich robust an. Ein Nachteil ist allerdings, dass die Böden ziemlich rau sind. Das könnte empfindliche Oberflächen leicht zerkratzen, was ich etwas schade finde. Da hilft es, eine Unterlage zu verwenden, um den Tisch zu schützen. Insgesamt gefallen mir die Schälchen gut, besonders weil sie Spülmaschine, Mikrowelle und Ofen problemlos überstehen. Für den Preis finde ich das Set gelungen, auch wenn der raue Boden besser verarbeitet sein könnte. Wer rustikalen Charme mag und darauf achtet, den Tisch zu schützen, wird hier sicher seine Freude haben.

Fantastic product and service from the company too. I bought these reading rules to help my son with learning from home.
My youngest son is 5 years old and in year 1 - he is a summer baby so the youngest child in his year group which hadn't been a problem in nursery or reception years. However after starting year 1 in September he began to really struggle with the work because he described the letters as "wobbly" and "dancing" and said it was too hard - I asked in October for a dyslexia screening but his teacher said he couldn't have dyslexia at his age and was just lazy and could do the work if he tried. Over the months since I've done my best to help him without causing him additional stress as he was certainly getting enough of that at school so we have done lots of play based activities to help which he understands and does well in but when it comes to his reading books or work from school he struggles reading the words by muddling up the letters e.g 'dog'>'god'
I have persisted with my concern that dyslexia is in fact the root of this problem and his teacher said she would only put him forward for screening if his sight and hearing had been checked first (which we did and were both clear in February)
An appointment was due to be made for him before the easter break which didn't happen due to the school closing in the current pandemic.
Now as a parent trying to support my son with his learning at home until school is re-opened I chose to buy a dyslexia aid - these reading rulers, to see if they might help him and reduce the stress involved in convincing him to try to read himself as I do not have the means or knowledge to test him myself I thought providing him the tools that may help him would be the best strategy - to support and ease his difficulty rather than focus on or wait for 'diagnosis'.
The rulers were an immediate hit - they are well made, a good size, have a variety of colours and the line to support guiding which line of text he is on is really helpful. He has a preference for the green but has found that if reading in the garden in the sun he likes to change to a darker colour like dark blue or red. He is now able to read the whole sentence without all the jumbling up or upset using the phonics knowledge he has already secured.
Thank you so much!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Schöne Becher, einer davon leicht mängelbehaftet
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Offenbar habe ich als Produkttester in der vergangenen Zeit zu viele Rezensionen geschrieben, es will mir partout nichts mehr einfallen.
Einer dieser vier blauen Becher steht nun vor mir, mein Blick ruht beinahe hypnotisierend auf ihm, ich starre ihn an und sage: „Komm schon, erzähl mir deine Story, was lässt sich über dich schreiben?“
Dass er hübsch aussieht, daran besteht kein Zweifel. Mit einem Fassungsvermögen von 375 ml gehört er zu den größeren seiner Art, wenn wir sein Tassenformat berücksichtigen.
Ich kann mir vorstellen, daraus eine heiße Hühnerbrühe zu trinken, sobald mich wieder eine Erkältung erwischt hat. Für den großen Kaffeedurst am frühen Morgen ist er ebenfalls gut zu verwenden.
Drehen wir ihn mal um, dann können wir auf dem Becherboden lesen, dass er für die Mikrowelle genauso geeignet ist wie für die Spülmaschine. „Oven safe“, steht zusätzlich da. Was soll das nun wieder heißen? Backofenfest?
Ein jeder Kunde wird selber wissen, was er mit einem solchen Becher bzw. gleich vieren davon anfangen soll. Sie sind gut und sicher verpackt bei mir eingetroffen, bei einem der Becher sticht außen etwas wie ein Dorn hervor, was mit dem Brennverfahren zu tun haben dürfte. Eine Unebenheit und einem Stachel fast gleichzusetzen, den hätten sie bei der Endkontrolle mal rausnehmen sollen. Dürfte sich wegschmirgeln lassen, sorgt jedoch – so streng müssen wir sein – für einen Punkt Abzug.
Ansonsten sind das vier schöne taubenblaue Becher, die ich gerne weiterempfehlen möchte.
Ich bedanke mich für die Zusendung.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Attractive, adjustable but really only suitable for the smaller to medium sized dog.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I recently received the Belle Vous Raised Dog Bowl Feeder Stand for reviewing purposes, and after using it for a few weeks, I feel it deserves a three star review.

On the positive side, the bamboo design is aesthetically pleasing and blends well with my home decor. The adjustable height feature is quite convenient, as I can easily unscrew the food holders to set them at the perfect level for my dog, who is a medium-sized breed.

However, there are a few drawbacks that prevented me from giving it a higher rating. While the stainless steel bowls are easy to clean, I found that they can sometimes slip out of the holders if not secured tightly.

Additionally, despite the stand being marketed for both small and large pets, I think it would work best for smaller dogs or cats, as the size and depth of the food bowls are definitely on the smaller side, meaning they probably wouldn't hold enough food or water for larger breeds.

All in all, it's a good product with a stylish design, but a few tweaks would enhance its usability. If you have a smaller pet and are looking for an attractive elevated feeder, this might be a good choice, but larger pet owners might want to consider other options.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Great Little Roller Set for Smooth, Even Coverage
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I picked up this foam roller set from Luigi’s to tackle a few smaller paint jobs around the house, like touching up doors and skirting boards. The 4-inch size is ideal for these kinds of detail work, as it’s much easier to control in tight spaces compared to a full-sized roller. The set comes with six foam covers, a sturdy steel handle, and a tray, so it’s pretty much ready to go straight out of the box.

The foam rollers provide a lovely, even finish, especially with gloss and satin paints. I was impressed by how smoothly the paint went on without leaving streaks or bubbles, which can sometimes be an issue with foam rollers. The coverage was consistent, and it didn’t soak up too much paint, which made it efficient and mess-free. The tray is a good size for dipping the roller and has enough depth to hold a decent amount of paint without overflowing.

Swapping out the roller covers is easy, and the handle feels solid in the hand – no wobbling or bending even with firm pressure. The only minor downside is that, since it’s foam, it’s best suited to smooth surfaces; it doesn’t work quite as well on rougher textures. I’d also recommend washing the rollers immediately after use to get the most life out of them, as dried paint can make them stiff and less effective.

All in all, this is a great value set for smaller paint projects. It’s quick, effective, and perfect for achieving a clean, professional look without the fuss. Highly recommended for DIY touch-ups around the home.

Having used a large roller for most of the wall, the part painted with a brush did not look so good. Thanks to Amazon, I ordered this little paint roller set and it is brilliant. Easy to use, gives a great finish and easy to clean. It is really brilliant and makes decorating so much easier.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: It is fine, but with flaws
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
So these are supposed to be frozen, and put around your neck for those hot summer days. And it works fine for that purpose. Some issues are that it is a block of ice, so getting it to "flex" around your neck when frozen is a bit hard to do sometimes. Also, it is straight up plastic against your skin, which means sometimes that cold can be TOO cold and really irritate. Also, once it is melted, it will do nothing and now you have a plastic tube around your neck that doesn't cool you off.

So if I was doing some work in the backyard and wanted to keep cool, this will be great. You use it for a short bit in a controlled environment and it is fine. Would I take it with me to the park or a music festival? No. Once it is warmed up, it is now worthless and you have to carry it around all the time. I prefer those cooling towels for outdoor festivals since you can re-wet them and they take up almost no storage space.

In short, pretty good in practice, but require a pretty specific use case to make it worth it.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Hard to the touch and too cold when frozen. Should feel great in the summer.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Within the simple cardboard packaging, you will find two neck cooling rings. The rings already feel cool to the touch even without placing in a fridge or freezer. I was expecting the rings to be a little softer on the neck but they are hard and smooth, although still remain comfortable and sit well on the neck. They are slightly flexible to allow for wider or narrower necks.

The weather is a little cool at the moment but I tested this out by placing it in the freezer for a few hours. After taking out, I placed this on my neck and found it to be a little too cool. The hard plastic material probably doesn't help comfort after freezing to -18°C. I decided to allow it to warm up a little and it then felt fine. I can imagine this would be rather refreshing during warm summer months.

Placing it in the fridge was enough to make it icy cool for my liking so I do not think it is necessary to put it in the freezer. These rings would make a nice alternative to the neck fans which tend to be quite bulky, require charging and make a significant amount of noise around the ears. However, if this was covered with a softer material, it could possibly feel a lot more comfortable. I am looking forward to whipping these out when summer comes around once again.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Definitely pile-free foam rollers. Higher quality than most and give excellent results.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Most of the product photos for this set are incorrect in that they depict rollers with a short fabric pile. These are actually foam rollers, with no pile whatsoever - and all the better for that!

I always use small foam rollers when applying water-based gloss to my interior woodwork as I like the almost 'sprayed-on' effect you can achieve with them. I've always bought sets similar to this from the retail sheds, admittedly for a wee bit less than the tenner this set is currently sold for. However, there are some key differences.

Firstly, the paint tray is a good bit deeper and holds about enough paint to apply a thin coat over an entire panel door surface. The roller handle has a nice, comfortable silicone grip and the foam sleeves are denser than average and have tapered edges to cut down on tramlines. These small enhancements make all the difference.

With the deep tray, excellent handle and six decent sleeves, I'd say that this set is good value for money and I'd definitely recommend it. Bravissimo!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Stylish and Practical, But Not Exactly Premium
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I like the way it looks—clean and rustic with that wooden design, and it fits in with almost any kitchen style. The three tiers help keep everything visible and easy to grab, so no more digging through cupboards to find the right spice! The set also comes with two large oil dispenser bottles, which is a plus if you’re like me and love to keep olive oil and vinegar on hand. The glass jars are a nice touch too, adding a more elevated look compared to typical plastic containers. They’re just the right size for everyday spices, and having them on display in a sleek, coordinated set makes cooking feel a bit more organized and enjoyable. The oil dispensers are functional and have a solid feel to them, though I’d recommend handling them gently, as they aren’t the sturdiest.

As for quality, I’d say it’s a solid mid-range piece—not flimsy, but it doesn’t quite have that premium feel either. The wood has a bit of a lightweight feel, so it’s not the kind of rack that can take heavy bumps or be moved around a lot. For its price point, though, it’s functional and looks nice on the counter, and the minor downsides don’t take away too much from its overall appeal. If you’re after a stylish, affordable spice rack and aren’t too concerned about luxury-grade quality, this one does the trick nicely.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Stylish and Sturdy Tea Infuser for All-Day Sipping
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
With a generous 900ml capacity, it’s perfect for anyone who loves sipping tea throughout the day or wants a sizable drink bottle for both hot and cold infusions. The double-wall design is a lifesaver—it keeps my tea hot longer than I expected while keeping the outer glass cool to the touch, which is such a thoughtful detail for comfortable handling. The borosilicate glass feels high-quality and durable, even when used daily. I’ve had no issues with cracking or overheating, and it’s handled both boiling water and ice-cold brews without any fuss. The strainer is especially useful for loose leaf tea lovers. It’s easy to remove and clean, plus it keeps the leaves contained so I’m not fishing for bits at the bottom of the bottle. For tea enthusiasts, this detail alone makes it worth the investment.

One of the unexpected highlights is the sleeve—it’s not just about aesthetics. It offers extra grip, which is perfect when I’m on the go, and it adds a bit of insulation to help keep drinks at the right temperature even longer. This bottle has made both work commutes and long drives more enjoyable, with hot tea in winter and refreshing cold brews in summer. For anyone looking for a stylish and functional tea infuser, this bottle is worth every penny.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Le système n'est pas parfait, mais c'est quand même pas mal.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
la qualité de fabrication de ces roulettes est vraiment bonne. L'ensemble est massif, lourd, on sent bien que c'est conçu pour des charges importantes.

L'intérêt de ce système est double. Déjà, il va rendre mobile à la demande un objet sous lequel on l'aura fixé. Pouvoir déplacer un meuble chargé de 100 ou 200 kilos grâce à 4 roulettes est déjà en soit un argument de vente important. Enfin, on va également pouvoir l'utiliser pour rattraper jusqu'à 15 millimètres de différence de niveau. On va donc pouvoir caler une charge lourde sur un sol en pente, ou sur un sol dont les éléments ne sont pas tous au même niveau, comme les vieilles terres cuites. L'opération se fait grâce à un levier à cliquet qui facilite le réglage précis.

La seule limite du système, c'est qu'on agit sur une seule roulette à la fois. Donc, pour ne pas déformer l'objet sous lequel les roulettes sont fixées, on va progresser doucement, en tournant, roulette par roulette.

Au final, je suis satisfait de ce lot. Il va supporter des charges importantes tout en permettant de les caler et de les déplacer. Vendu 55€, le rapport qualité/prix me semble correct au regard du service qu'il va rendre.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Great Beach Tote Bag - My Wife Loves It!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This Sun Ninja tote bag is great! The EVA rubber/plastic is very good quality and the color is spot on with the pictures. Most of these EVA totes have a ton of holes in them (I guess to let moisture or sand out) which ends up letting all kinds of stuff into you bag (like sand). This bag is solid EVA rubber and helps protect your contents much better than a bag with 50 holes in it!

It requires some very basic assembly (the rope handles have to be inserted into the bag and then you screw a small cap onto the end of each rope to keep it from pulling out of the side of the bag) when it arrives, but it took about 3 minutes to put the handles on and the bag was ready to use. I also like the rope handles instead of the EVA handles that many of the other bags out there offer, as I think the EVA handles will eventually wear out and break.

There is a ton of room to take everything you need to the beach or anywhere else for a fun day out. We used it to take a bunch of stuff to our daughter's swim meet today and it worked out great!

I would definitely recommend this Sun Ninja bag!

Built with strong 500D vinyl-coated woven polyester, it’s fully waterproof, leak-proof, and tear-resistant. It can be fully submerged without any issues, which has been a huge advantage for keeping our drinks and snacks cool on kayak trips and beach outings.
One standout feature is that it floats. Thanks to the insulation and an adjustable air valve, I can inflate it just enough to keep it buoyant and add some extra insulating air for those hotter days. This setup keeps everything nice and chilled, even when it’s bobbing around on the water.
The backpack design is another thoughtful touch, allowing hands-free carrying with its padded shoulder straps, which are comfortable enough even for longer hikes. It’s lightweight, but with a 20L capacity, there’s plenty of room to pack what we need without weighing us down. We’ve been really satisfied with how practical and user-friendly it is; it’s clearly made for the outdoors.

I tested these strips with water from 3 different sources...filtered tap, filtered refrigerator, and outdoor garden fish pond that stays filled via rainwater. I didn't expect much of a difference with the filtered water sources, but I thought for sure the pond would have different readings since it is not filtered and I don't do anything to it except add beneficial bacteria. All 3 strips looked exactly the same except for a slight difference in the carbonate of my pond vs filtered drinking water. However, I tried the strips in a dirty puddle and in rain water on my pool cover before I drained it. Many of the readings were the same as the other strips, but they did show a significant difference the last 5 test areas on the strips (cyanuric acid, bromine, total alkalinity, carbonate, and ph). I'm not sure how confident I feel about these, but I'm pretty sure my filtered sources and pond are in good shape. So, just using them to test your drinking water might not hurt.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: atmungsaktiv mit Lichtschutzfaktor und Antirutsch - aber achte drauf die richtige Größe zu bestellen
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich wollte so cool aussehen, wie die Radfahrer in den Videos, also habe ich mir die TCA Armärmel bestellt. Aber die Größe L, die ich eigentlich wollte, kam nicht zu mir – stattdessen hatte ich die Mütze der Verwirrung auf, so daß ich wohl die Größe S orderte. Das bedeutet, ich habe jetzt die "kinderfreundliche" Version. Der Eindruck, den ich hinterlasse, könnte die Erinnerung an einen Superhelden mit Kompressionsärmel oder einen Hefeteig, der aus dem Backblech heraus quillt, hervorrufen. Wenn ich also beim Radfahren mit diesen schmalen Ärmelchen aufkreuze, sieht es sicher für alle recht lustig, aus.

Aber hey, der UPF 50+ ist super! So kann ich weiterhin die Sonne anstrahlen, während ich versuche, meinen Arm durch den Ärmel zu zwängen. Und das Anti-Rutsch-Design? Ein echter Lebensretter! Es hilft, dass die Ärmel an Ort und Stelle bleiben, während ich wild herumfuchtel, um sie anzupassen. Am Ende habe ich zwar die passende Größe nicht bekommen, aber ich habe immer noch meinen coolen Look – auch wenn ich ein bisschen mehr wie ein menschlicher Würstchen-Bastler aussehe.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Kleine Punkte bedenkend durchaus eine Bestellung wert!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Bei schwachem Licht reflektiert der Druck hier zwar von Anfang an nicht sonderlich und nach der zweiten Wäsche dann schon gar nicht mehr, aber das ist für mich kein großer Kritikpunkt, da das Trikot hier tatsächlich nur zum Sportunterricht bzw. zum offiziellen Training genutzt wird und nicht als Laufshirt für nebligere Herbstnachmittage oder Ähnliches gedacht ist. "Schwaches Licht" ist in unserem Fall da also nicht zutreffend; als Laufshirt in der Dämmerung und bei Dunkelheit würde ich es sonst auch nicht empfehlen: dazu ist es zu unscheinbar. Für mich ist dies ein Trikot für beleuchtete Innenräume, Sporthallen und Fitnessstudios, oder für beflutlichtete Außenanlagen.

Es selbst als kostenloses Testprodukt via Vine erhalten habend finde ich den gegenwärtigen Kaufpreis von 17€ aber auch absolut in Ordnung; alles unter 20€ ist hier sicherlich noch angemessen genug. Bei einem höheren Preis würde ich aber auch ein wenig zögern, zumal TCA sich inzwischen zwar als jüngere Marke im Bereich der Sportbekleidung bereits relativ bewährt hat, aber dennoch noch nicht zu den ganz Großen da zählt und wenn mir dazu einfällt, dass ein zuletzt von mir bezogenes Kinder-Shirt der riesigen Marke mit den drei Streifen preislich nun bei 22€ liegt... Eventuell würde ich nach meinem Zögern zwar auch für dieses Jungentrikot von TCA jenen Preis bezahlen, aber wie gesagt: bei 17€ bis rauf zu 20€ würde ich gar nicht erst hadern. ;)

Das Trikot ist, typisch für ein Trikot, eher schmal und gerade geschnitten; die Größe "12-14 Jahre" ist da, bei athletischeren Körpern, relativ gleichbedeutend mit dem Größenbereich 156 (mit etwas mehr "Luft") bis 162 (mit deutlich weniger Spiel). Bei etwas Übergewicht, oder auch einfach nur schon muskulöseren Oberarmen, würde ich hier vom Kauf aber eher abraten; da ist der Schnitt im Bereich der Ärmelöffnungen sicherlich zu eng und wird unter den Achseln eher einschneiden, was bei einem Sportshirt die Bewegungsfreiheit natürlich konterkariert.

Ansonsten ist es einfach ein gewöhnliches Sportshirt, über dessen Qualität man nicht meckern kann, und dass das Kind auch völlig ausgepowert und verschwitzt noch gerne trägt. Gut, dann stinkt es zwar wie ein Iltis (Kind sowie Trikot), aber auch im Stoff des Trikots verfängt der Schweißgestank nicht dauerhaft und lässt sich mit einer Runde in der Waschmaschine schnell beseitigen; da läuft auch weder das Schwarz aus noch läuft das Trikot ein. Von der Qualität her stimmt das so also auch.

Replacing a whole dead bolt and door lock/latch assembly can easily run 2-3 times more than this one costs and probably even more, depending on the brand. And this one is a good quality assembly and well-made.

Everything you need to replace an existing dead bolt and door latch is included in the box, including two keys. It's a very easy installation - just remove your old locks and replace with these. All you'll need is a Phillips-head screwdriver and basic skills. If you're installing this in a new door that has not been cut or drilled for locks, it will take a little more time, skills and tools. But the product does come with templates for cutting the holes, etc. From start to finish, it took me roughly 12 minutes and that was taking my time to ensure everything was installed and working properly the first time.

A few of points of advice I want to mention is, when screwing the plates on which attach to the dead bolt and lower lock assembly, DO NOT overtighten the screws as you can distort the plates. Just get them snug enough that the locks do not move and that should do. If you overtighten the bottom assembly, the handle may not operate smoothly and might not return fully. If this happens with your install, just loosen the two screws holding the assembly in place a bit and the handle will operate as it should. Lastly, the outside lever which you depress to open the door may seem to hang or be a little stubborn to press. I found out this is likely due to the door being tightly closed because of thick weatherstripping or some other issue like the striker plate not adjusted properly, etc. In my case, as I depress the lever, I found that if I pull out on the door slightly, it's not hard to press the lever at all. None of these are major issues, I just wanted to mention what I encountered during my install.

This new lock assembly has a traditional sort of look but also has a modern appeal. My old lock assembly was dated and was showing a lot of weathering affects so it was time to replace it all. I'm happy with how this one looks and how easily everything was to install. And I'm REALLY happy with the quality and value of this one.

Overall, I recommend this product if you're looking to replace an older assembly or if you're installing in a new door.

I'm essentially 80 years old but trying to keep feeling like I'm 35. So I ride a fat-tire bike out into the countryside to commune with nature, often stripping down to tan as much of me as I dare. I can end up overheating some days. The Sun Ninja is a simple solution, and it rests nicely in the cargo deck behind my seat, provided I strap it down to prevent sudden shifts (easy). I can carry almost anything, including much heavier things than the sprayer full of water.

Likes: decent price. Plastic-like construct is lightweight and rugged, easy to keep clean - looks good and it actually color coordinates with my black and orange bike. I can put insect repellant (checking ingredients/warnings to insure they are not caustic to oil-based plastics and similar) in the sprayer on day one, if it's that time of year, and pre-prepare an area where I might wish to 'camp', and on day two, after cleaning and flushing, take hot water, which will still be plenty warm if I want something akin to a hot shower, or use cold water if I want a cooling mist. Actually, hot/warm water necessarily feels cooler if using the mist mode, dependent upon breeze and ambient levels, but it is often preferable to have even cooler spray. You will figure out what you prefer soon enough. The coiled hose has good stretch, which comes in handy when I want to wash my motorhome or car... giving me the option to use hot soapy water, or hot rinse water, with two separate fills.

Dislikes: The coiled hose is hard to work with when simply transporting, and more so in storage, but is well appreciated when in use. It is possible to get tangled, and if tangled, it can take a bit of care to untangle, in really bad tangles. I'm surprised it does not have some provision to better manage the hose. Amazon sells hook and loop straps and other solutions, some of which I have laying around, in storage, but as I was coming back inside from taking the pictures, I saw an old shoulder strap laying unused in a crevice beneath a chair... from I know not what... and it happens to easily slip onto the pump handle, so I just run it through the coil for transport/storage, and disconnect the sprayer end for use. Easy.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Hmmmm... pH is more than 2 full points off and comes with a disclaimer
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
BOSIKE 13in1 Drinking Water pH Test Strips - Accurate Water pH Testing Kit - Easy Water pH Level Balance Tester - Easy-to-Read pH Paper Test Strips Kit for Safe Water - 100 Strips

I got these to test the pH in my water for hydroponics. But first I tested it with my tap water. My tap water measured a pH of 7.2 with these strips. Not a bad level. Except... it's wrong. A few days earlier I tested the same tap water (municipality water) in an agriculture lab at a local university, using their electronic equipment. The pH of the water measured 9.4. This is a huge difference, and highlights the problems with these strips.

First of all, the strip doesn't even measure to 9.4. The range for pH on these strips is only 6.0-9.0, a range that gives no meaningful information for anyone trying to grow a plant. Anything measuring pH should provide the entire range, from 0-14, for useful results. Second, a disclaimer notice included in the box says that the results may be wrong due to the test's results for iron and copper. This makes the tests useless for anyone who needs real information.

I cannot attest to any of the individual mineral results in the water since I didn't test that with university equipment and I have nothing but this test strip results to rely upon. If I realized these strips were going to arrive with a disclaimer that says "Intended for personal use and initial screening only. Consult professionals for comprehensive water testing" I never would have ordered them. See photos for details.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: What the heck is going on?
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Weird.

(1) There are extra little test blocks on the strip that don't correspond to the chart on the bottle. I think I counted at least two extra squares that don't line up to anything.

(2) I used four of these strips so far. Two to test unfiltered water straight out of the tap. Two others to test water out of a filtration unit with a 2-day-old filter installed. The strips showed higher levels of chlorine from the filtered water than from the tap. The strips also showed differing results between the two strips from the unfiltered tap.

I am not particularly inclined to trust these strips. I am not even particularly sure how to read them, with the extra blocks! Mysteries...

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Sleek Tool That Does the Job!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
There are a few options out there when it comes to clearing your coffee grounds out of your nespresso original pods, and most of them are either tedious, or way oversized for most counter tops.
This handy device is small, sleek and inconspicuous. It looks like a thin shaker bottle. When you're done with your pod, place it upside down in the inverter, put the lid on, and press with steady pressure until you feel the pod give way. Once it's all the way depressed, give the tool a few quick taps on your counter to shake off most of the coffee grounds still stuck to the pod, and then you can take the pod out and rinse off any residual grounds before placing it direcly in the recycling bin.
Before this tool, I was using a knife and slowly cutting the foil lid off, and scooping the grounds out, which took a long time. With this handy tool, it takes about ten seconds to clear the grounds, and recycle the pod each morning.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Schöne Aufbewahrungsboxen, zu schade, um als Mülleimer verwendet zu werden.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich habe die Boxen hauptsächlich als Aufbewahrungsoption bestellt. Die Idee, sie als Müllereimer zu verwenden, kam für mich nicht in Frage – sie sind einfach zu schön dafür! Außerdem möchte ich den Müll nicht sehen.
Die Verarbeitung der Boxen macht einen soliden Eindruck. Die Aufhängung des Deckels scheint stabil zu sein und ich habe das Gefühl, dass sie auch bei Belastung nicht schnell abbrechen wird. Der Druckverschluss funktioniert ebenfalls einwandfrei.
Der vergoldete Rahmen ist sicherlich Geschmacksache, aber ich finde, dass er zu den Boxen passt. Der Korpus ist durchsichtig und hat ein schönes Karomuster, wobei jedes zweite Feld wie Milchglas aussieht. Die Abdichtung ist gut, jedoch habe ich Bedenken, dass Gerüche trotzdem entweichen könnten.
Die Aussage des Händlers, dass das Wechseln der Müllsäcke sehr einfach sei, hat mich zum Schmunzeln gebracht. Ich habe das Gefühl, dass hier etwas übertrieben wurde. Es könnte eine Herausforderung sein, passende Müllsäcke für den Tischmülleimer zu finden.
Insgesamt bin ich mit meiner Bestellung zufrieden und hoffe, dass die Boxen langlebig sind – für 20,00 Euro sind sie schließlich kein Schnäppchen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Schicke Möbelfüße für ein DIY-Projekt - aber Vorarbeiten notwendig!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich habe die Möbelfüße bestellt, um ein kleines Kallax-Regal etwas erhöht aufzustellen.

Geliefert wurde eine Kunstofftüte, darin 4 einzeln in Luftpolsterfolie verpackte Füße, sauber verarbeitet, lackierte Buche, Montageplatten aus Metall und Schrauben.

Laut Anleitung / Bildbeschreibung kann man die Möbelfüße mit 3 Schrauben an den Montageplatten befestigen und diese dann am gewünschten Möbelstück mit 4 weiteren Schrauben festschrauben.

Hier sehe ich ein kleines Problem: geht man wirklich so vor, ohne etwas Vorarbeit zu investieren, besteht die Gefahr, dass die mitgelieferten dicken Schrauben das Holz der Möbelfüße aufgrund der Spaltwirkung reissen lassen. Die Schrauben befinden sich, nutzt man wirklich 3 Schrauben, relativ nah am Rand der Möbelfüße. Beim Einschrauben der relativ dicken Schrauben könnte das Holz reissen / aufplatzen.

Ich empfehle daher, die Stellen, an denen die Schrauben in den Möbelfuß eingebracht werden, mit einem dünnen Holzbohrer vorzubohren oder direkt selbstschneidende Holzschrauben in einem passenden Format zu verwenden. Dies minimiert das Risiko.

Man kann jedoch auch nur das mittlere Loch der Montageplatten nutzen, um die Möbelfüße an den Montageplatten zu befestigen. Hier reduziert sich die Gefahr der Spaltung des Holzes, jedoch würde ich auch hier kurz zum Holzbohrer greifen wollen, um ein kleines Loch vorzubohren.

Alles in allem sehr schicke Möbelfüße, für jedes heimische DIY-Projekt geeignet.

✔️ PROS ✔️

✔️ Tejido ligero y transpirable: El material técnico ayuda a mantener frescos a los niños durante el ejercicio, ideal para días calurosos.

✔️ Bolsillos con cremallera: Los bolsillos laterales son útiles para guardar objetos pequeños con seguridad.

❌ CONTRAS ❌

❌ Ajuste incómodo: Los shorts no tienen tanto espacio para piernas de niños que las tengan mas anchas, lo que puede hacer que sean incómodos para algunos niños.

❌ Cintura elástica solo en la parte delantera: Este diseño puede no proporcionar el ajuste adecuado, afectando la comodidad general.

❌ Costo elevado: Considerando la calidad y el ajuste, el precio parece desproporcionado, lo que los hace menos atractivos en comparación con otras opciones en el mercado.

👍vs👎 Conclusión personal, ¿vale la pena adquirirlo?

NO 👎 Aunque estos shorts tienen algunas características prácticas, el costo elevado y el ajuste incómodo hacen que no sean una compra recomendable. Hay mejores opciones disponibles que ofrecen más comodidad y valor por el dinero.

Contrairement à de nombreux vendeurs, AZ Delivery a recours à des composants d'origine, ici ASAIR, comme on peut le vérifier avec le marquage règlementaire sur le dos du composant.
Celui-ci inclut la plage de fonctionnement de T° et d'humidité garantie, qui, contrairement au descriptif du produit par AZ Delivery, est donc la suivante :
- T° : -20° -> +60°
- RH : 5 -> 95%
Ces spécifications sont également disponibles sur le site du constructeur ASAIR / AOSONG
Une plage bien plus large donc et beaucoup plus intéressante que le descriptif !
En revanche la documentation ASAIR fournie par AZ Delivery est affreusement mal traduite, et surtout lacunaire, et ne permet pas d'exploiter tout le potentiel de ce composant. Aussi pour info :
- la partie décimale des données humidité sera toujours zéro ;
- en revanche la partie décimale des données température est supportée et donne des infos utiles ;
- une température négative est indiquée par le MSB de la partie décimale à 1 ; pour les température positive, le MSB est à 0.
Voilà :-) ; ceci n'est valable QUE pour les DHT11 d'origine, c-à-d avec le marquage identifié au dos du composant. Les autres pseudo DHT11 mal clonés effectivement ne supportent que 0 - 50 ° etc.

I stumbled across these on Amazon and they were a really clever solution - they cover the holes neatly, but leave freedom for the cables to be moved, replaced more easily and even to add new cables without drilling any additional holes! Definitely recommend for a neater solution to your cabling.

Wanted to post my honest opinions on the silicon case, after purchasing many different phone cases and owning myself the official silicone case from Google. I really feel like this product could be made a lot more better and quite frankly, I think a lot people would pay a little bit more of a premium price to get some of these additional features. Magsafe should be a standard addition for any phone case that's made out there and this one doesn't have it and that is a pretty big deal breaker for me (I knew this beforehand but loved the blue color) There is also this continuous line around the entire case and you can see the line in the pictures. I'm not really sure what it's for but it is a little bit of an imperfection that you can feel and I kind of takes away from the premium feel of the silicon material. The case also is a little bit loose on the device. It's not falling off by any means, but it's definitely not the tightest fit and I would preference maybe something a little bit tighter that grips the entire phone. If this brand corrected all of these recommendations I wouldn't mind spending $15-20 for the case. Maybe in th future ?

There's so much to like about this Sun Ninja XL Canvas Beach Tote. I ordered the blue stripe and it has a really fun nautical vibe to it, making it perfect for hauling stuff back and for to our house on the coast or trips to the beach. They aren't kidding when they say XL because this bag is huge! I love that it holds so much, but I have to be super careful about how much weight I put in it because the rope handles are just held in by knots, so I'm afraid if I put too much in it, the ropes will pull right through the holes since there isn't any kind of reinforcement to keep them from slipping through. Also, the knots on both handles were very loosely tied, so I untied them all and retied up a little higher to get the knots a little more strength so hopefully I won't have any issue with them, but I'm still careful not to put too much heavy stuff in the bag. I do love the outer pockets on the bag for easy access to things I need to get to right away and the big zippered pocket inside is the bomb, providing a safe and secure place to keep my phone, keys, wallet, etc so they don't get lost inside the depths of the rest of the bag. The canvas material is sturdy, giving it just a bit of structure which I like and the water resistant lining inside make it nice for transporting wet towel back home from the beach.
